const BUILD_SALT = "vendor-a3a301f0";
const mixKey = (data) => {
  // Simple XOR-based mix for packet encryption
  let result = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
    result.push(data[i] ^ (i % 256));
  }
  return new Uint8Array(result);
};
const PACKET_PADDING = 6;

const clientToServerArr = [];
const serverToClientArr = [];
for (const key in PacketMap.CLIENT_TO_SERVER) {
  clientToServerArr.push(PacketMap.CLIENT_TO_SERVER[key]);
}
for (const key in PacketMap.SERVER_TO_CLIENT) {
  const val = PacketMap.SERVER_TO_CLIENT[key];
  if (val !== "io-init") {
    serverToClientArr.push(val);
  }
}
function createPRNG(initialSeed) {
  let seed = initialSeed | 0;
  return function nextRandom() {
    seed = seed + 1831565813 | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(seed ^ seed >>> 15, seed | 1);
    t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, t | 61) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}
function createCipherMap(charArray, seed) {
  const length = charArray.length;
  const indices = charArray.map((_, index) => index);
  const nextRandom = createPRNG(seed >>> 0);
  for (let i = length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const randomIndex = Math.floor(nextRandom() * (i + 1));
    const temp = indices[i];
    indices[i] = indices[randomIndex];
    indices[randomIndex] = temp;
  }
  const encryptMap = {};
  const decryptMap = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
    const char = charArray[i];
    const shuffledIndex = indices[i];
    encryptMap[char] = shuffledIndex;
    decryptMap[shuffledIndex] = char;
  }
  return {
    encrypt: encryptMap,
    decrypt: decryptMap
  };
}
function initTable(seed) {
  const c2sSeedBase = (seed ^ Math.imul(1, 2654435761)) >>> 0;
  const s2cSeedBase = (c2sSeedBase ^ -2048144789) >>> 0;
  return {
    c2s: createCipherMap(clientToServerArr, c2sSeedBase),
    s2c: createCipherMap(serverToClientArr, s2cSeedBase)
  };
}
function hexToBytes(hexString) {
  const buffer = new Uint8Array(hexString.length / 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < buffer.length; i++) {
    const index = i * 2;
    const slice = hexString.slice(index, index + 2);
    buffer[i] = parseInt(slice, 16);
  }
  return buffer;
}
async function getPacketSignature(salt, data) {
  const cryptoKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey("raw", salt, {
    name: "HMAC",
    hash: "SHA-256"
  }, false, ["sign"]);
  const signature = await crypto.subtle.sign("HMAC", cryptoKey, data);
  return new Uint8Array(signature).subarray(0, PACKET_PADDING);
}
// --- WebSocket interception: simple robust version ---
const OriginalWebSocket = window.WebSocket;

class FakeWebsocket {
  constructor(url, protocols) {
    this.url = url;
    this.protocols = protocols;
    this.listeners = {};

    this.readyState = OriginalWebSocket.CONNECTING;
    this.packetQueue = [];
    this.hasInit = false;

    this._onopen = null;
    this._onmessage = null;
    this._onclose = null;
    this._onerror = null;

    this.setupEventHooks();

    if (url.includes("token=alt")) {
      this.useTurnstile(url);
    } else {
      this.openRealSocket(url, true);
    }
  }

  async useTurnstile(oldUrl) {
    const elem = document.createElement("div");
    elem.style.position = "absolute";
    elem.style.top = "20px";
    elem.style.left = "20px";
    document.body.append(elem);

    const token = await new Promise((res) => {
      if (!window.turnstile || typeof window.turnstile.render !== "function") {
        // can't show turnstile UI: fall back to reload so game may handle it
        return res(undefined);
      }
      window.turnstile.render(elem, {
        sitekey: "0x4AAAAAAAMYHI96GFiJzMmp",
        theme: "light",
        "error-callback": () => res(undefined),
        callback: (e) => res(e)
      });
    });

    if (!token) return location.reload();

    const wsAddress = oldUrl.split("?token=")[0];
    const newURL = `${wsAddress}?token=cf:${encodeURIComponent(token)}`;
    this.openRealSocket(newURL, false, elem);
  }

  setupEventHooks() {
    const events = ["onopen", "onmessage", "onclose", "onerror"];
    events.forEach(evt => {
      Object.defineProperty(this, evt, {
        get: () => this[`_${evt}`],
        set: (listener) => { this[`_${evt}`] = listener; },
        configurable: true
      });
    });
  }

  openRealSocket(url, didntUseTurnstile, elem) {
    // Use the captured original WebSocket implementation
    this.realSocket = new OriginalWebSocket(url, this.protocols);
    this.realSocket.binaryType = "arraybuffer";

    if (elem) elem.style.display = "none";

    // expose for debugging (same as before)
    document.ws = this;
    window.ws = this;

    // wire native events -> fake wrapper events
    this.realSocket.onopen = (ev) => {
      this.readyState = this.realSocket.readyState;
      if (this._onopen) this._onopen.call(this, ev);
    };

    this.realSocket.onmessage = (ev) => {
      // translate server packets to mod-friendly format
      const binary = this.translateMessage(ev.data);

      if (didntUseTurnstile) {
        // If connecting without turnstile we want to forward the original raw message
        if (this._onmessage) this._onmessage.call(this, ev);
        return;
      }

      if (binary && this._onmessage) {
        this._onmessage.call(this, { ...ev, data: binary });
      }
    };

    this.realSocket.onclose = (ev) => {
      this.readyState = this.realSocket.readyState;
      if (this._onclose) this._onclose.call(this, ev);
    };

    this.realSocket.onerror = (ev) => {
      this.readyState = this.realSocket.readyState;
      if (this._onerror) this._onerror.call(this, ev);
    };

    // flush/attach any event listeners that were added via addEventListener() before real socket ready
    for (const key in this.listeners) {
      for (const cb of this.listeners[key]) {
        try { this.realSocket.addEventListener(key, cb); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
      }
    }
  }

  translateMessage(msgData) {
    try {
      const parsed = msgpack.decode(new Uint8Array(msgData));
      const data = parsed[1];

      if (!this.hasInit && parsed[0] === "io-init") {
        const [id, seed, salt] = data;
        this.sequence = 0;
        this.tables = initTable(seed >>> 0);
        this.key = hexToBytes(salt);
        this.hasInit = true;

        if (this.packetQueue.length) {
          this.packetQueue.forEach(packet => this.send(packet));
          this.packetQueue.length = 0;
        }
        return null;
      }

      if (this.tables && typeof parsed[0] === "number") {
        parsed[0] = this.tables.s2c.decrypt[parsed[0]];
        if (parsed[0] === undefined) return null;
      }

      return msgpack.encode(parsed);
    } catch (e) {
      // If decode fails (including BUFFER_SHORTAGE), don't crash: return null so caller ignores packet
      console.warn("MooVisuals: Failed to decode message:", e);
      return null;
    }
  }

  // leave send reroute mechanism in place so the game's saved reference will still work
  sendMethodRerouted = false;

  send(raw) {
    // If this.send was replaced later by the page's monkeypatch logic we need to call
    // the new send method once to ensure the game's stored reference is hooked.
    const CurrentSend = FakeWebsocket.prototype.send;
    if (CurrentSend !== OriginalFakeSend && typeof this.send === "function" && !this.sendMethodRerouted) {
      this.sendMethodRerouted = true;
      // call the new send with a flag to avoid infinite recursion
      return this.send(raw, true);
    }

    if (!this.hasInit) {
      this.packetQueue.push(raw);
      return;
    }

    this.sendEncrypted(raw);
  }

  async updateRawToMatch(raw) {
    try {
      const parsed = msgpack.decode(raw.slice(PACKET_PADDING));
      if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        this.sequence++;
        return raw;
      }
      if (parsed.length < 3) {
        parsed[2] = this.sequence;
      } else {
        parsed[2] = this.sequence;
      }
      const packetData = msgpack.encode(parsed);
      const binary = new Uint8Array(PACKET_PADDING + packetData.length);
      const signature = await getPacketSignature(this.key, packetData);
      binary.set(signature, 0);
      binary.set(packetData, PACKET_PADDING);
      return binary;
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("MooVisuals: Failed to update raw packet:", e);
      this.sequence++;
      return raw;
    }
  }

  async sendEncrypted(raw) {
    try {
      // Try to decode with PACKET_PADDING (old format)
      let parsed;
      try {
        parsed = msgpack.decode(raw.slice(PACKET_PADDING));
      } catch (e) {
        // Try without padding (new 2026 format)
        try {
          parsed = msgpack.decode(raw);
        } catch (e2) {
          // If both fail, send raw data
          this.realSocket.send(raw);
          this.sequence++;
          return;
        }
      }

      if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        this.sequence++;
        this.realSocket.send(raw);
        return;
      }

      if (parsed.length < 3) {
        parsed[2] = this.sequence;
      } else {
        parsed[2] = this.sequence;
      }

      const newRaw = msgpack.encode(parsed);
      this.realSocket.send(newRaw);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("MooVisuals: Failed to encrypt packet:", e);
      // Fallback to sending original raw data if encryption fails
      try {
        this.realSocket.send(raw);
      } catch (fallbackError) {
        console.warn("MooVisuals: Fallback send failed:", fallbackError);
      }
    }
    this.sequence++;
  }

  addEventListener(type, callback) {
    const callbackWrapper = (ev) => {
      if (type === "message") {
        const binary = this.translateMessage(ev.data);
        if (binary) callback({ ...ev, data: binary });
      } else {
        callback(ev);
      }
    };

    // if real socket already open attach directly
    if (this.realSocket && this.realSocket.readyState === OriginalWebSocket.OPEN) {
      this.realSocket.addEventListener(type, callbackWrapper);
      return;
    }

    if (!this.listeners[type]) this.listeners[type] = [];
    this.listeners[type].push(callbackWrapper);
  }

  close() {
    if (this.realSocket && typeof this.realSocket.close === "function") this.realSocket.close();
  }
}
// Re-enabled WebSocket interception with 2026 compatibility

            }
          }
          var value = value2 + (value1 - value2) * amount;
          if (value >= 0 && value <= mathPI2) {
            return value;
          }
          return value % mathPI2;
        }; // REOUNDED RECTANGLE:
        CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect = function (x, y, w, h, r) {
          if (w < r * 2) {
            r = w / 2;
          }
          if (h < r * 2) {
            r = h / 2;
          }
          if (r < 0) {
            r = 0;
          }
          this.beginPath();
          this.moveTo(x + r, y);
          this.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
          this.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
          this.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
          this.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
          this.closePath();
          return this;
        }; // STORAGE:
        var canStore;
        if (typeof Storage !== "undefined") {
          canStore = true;
        }
        function saveVal(name, val) {
          if (canStore) {
            localStorage.setItem(name, val);
          }
        }
        function deleteVal(name) {
          if (canStore) {
            localStorage.removeItem(name);
          }
        }
        function getSavedVal(name) {
          if (canStore) {
            return localStorage.getItem(name);
          }
          return null;
        } // GLOBAL VALUES:

        const settingsMap = Object.entries(settings);
        function setVisualSetting(key, value) {
          settings[key] = value;
          localStorage.setItem("visual-settings", JSON.stringify(settings));
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < settingsMap.length; i++) {
          const visualSettings = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("visual-settings") || null);
          if (!visualSettings) {
            localStorage.setItem("visual-settings", JSON.stringify(settings));
            break;
          }
          if (!visualSettings.hasOwnProperty(settingsMap[i][0])) {
            setVisualSetting(settingsMap[i][0], settingsMap[i][1]);
          }
        }

        window.togglePingDisplay = function () {
          const pingDisplay = document.getElementById("pingDisplay");
          if (menu.getModelActive("show-stats")) {
            if (pingDisplay.style.display === "none" || !pingDisplay.style.display) {
              pingDisplay.style.display = "block";
            }
          } else if (pingDisplay.style.display === "block" || !pingDisplay.style.display) {
            pingDisplay.style.display = "none";
          }
        };
        window.togglePingDisplay();
        menu.getModel("show-stats").on("click", window.togglePingDisplay);
        menu.getModel("pet-amount").on("input", () => {
          pets.forEach(pet => {
            pet.infinityAttack = false;
            pet.stopAttackAnimation();
          });
        });
        function eachIcons(callback) {
          const icons = [...document.querySelectorAll(".header-icon")];
          for (const icon of icons) {
            callback(icon);
          }
        }
        eachIcons(icon => {
          icon.setAttribute("draggable", false);
        });
        window.hideMenuIcons = function (state) {
          state = state ? "none" : "block";
          eachIcons(icon => {
            icon.style.display = state;
          });
        };
        menu.getModel("hide-menu-icons").on("click", window.hideMenuIcons);
        window.hideMenuIcons();
        window.toggleItemCounts = function () {
          const itemCounts = Object.values(document.querySelectorAll(".item-count"));
          for (const itemCount of itemCounts) {
            if (menu.getModelActive("item-counts")) {
              itemCount.style.display = "block";
              continue;
            }
            itemCount.style.display = "none";
          }
        };
        menu.getModel("item-counts").on("click", window.toggleItemCounts);
        function toggleHiddenClass(state, elements) {
          elements.forEach(element => {
            if (state) {
              return element.classList.add("hidden");
            }
            element.classList.remove("hidden");
          });
        }
        window.toggleLeaderboard = function (state) {
          const leaderboard = document.getElementById("leaderboard");
          const killCounter = document.getElementById("killCounter");
          killCounter.style.marginTop = state ? "0px" : "10px";
          toggleHiddenClass(state, [leaderboard]);
        };
        window.toggleLeaderboard(menu.getModelActive("hide-leaderboard"));
        menu.getModel("hide-leaderboard").on("click", window.toggleLeaderboard);
        window.toggleResources = function (state) {
          const killCounter = document.getElementById("killCounter");
          const resDisplay = document.getElementById("resDisplay");
          toggleHiddenClass(state, [killCounter, resDisplay]);
        };
        window.toggleResources(menu.getModelActive("hide-resources"));
        menu.getModel("hide-resources").on("click", window.toggleResources);
        window.toggleAgeBar = function (state) {
          const ageText = document.getElementById("ageText");
          const ageBar = document.getElementById("ageBarContainer");
          toggleHiddenClass(state, [ageText, ageBar]);
        };
        window.toggleAgeBar(menu.getModelActive("hide-agebar"));
        menu.getModel("hide-agebar").on("click", window.toggleAgeBar);
        window.toggleMinimap = function (state) {

        };
        window.toggleMinimap(menu.getModelActive("hide-minimap"));

        window.toggleButtons = function (state) {
          const allianceButton = document.getElementById("allianceButton");
          const storeButton = document.getElementById("storeButton");
          const chatButton = document.getElementById("chatButton");
          toggleHiddenClass(state, [allianceButton, storeButton, chatButton]);
        };
        window.toggleButtons(menu.getModelActive("hide-buttons"));
        menu.getModel("hide-buttons").on("click", window.toggleButtons);
        window.toggleActionBar = function (state) {
          const actionBar = document.getElementById("actionBar");
          const ageText = document.getElementById("ageText");
          const ageBar = document.getElementById("ageBarContainer");
          ageText.style.bottom = state ? "42px" : "118px";
          ageBar.style.bottom = state ? "17px" : "93px";
          toggleHiddenClass(state, [actionBar]);
        };
        window.toggleActionBar(menu.getModelActive("hide-actionbar"));
        menu.getModel("hide-actionbar").on("click", window.toggleActionBar);
        window.hideGUI = function (state) {
          window.toggleLeaderboard(state);
          window.toggleResources(state);
          window.toggleAgeBar(state);
          window.toggleMinimap(state);
          window.toggleButtons(state);
          window.toggleActionBar(state);
        };
        menu.getModel("hide-gui").on("click", window.hideGUI);
        document.body.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", `<style>
    .hidden {
        display: none !important;
    }

    .header-icon {
        width: 30px;
        user-select: none;
    }
    </style>`);
        window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
          window.hideGUI(menu.getModelActive("hide-gui"));
        });
        touchControls.addEventListener("wheel", event => {
          const storeMenu = document.getElementById("storeMenu");
          const allianceMenu = document.getElementById("allianceMenu"); // const player = player;
          if (storeMenu.style.display && storeMenu.style.display !== "none" || allianceMenu.style.display && allianceMenu.style.display !== "none") {
            return;
          }
          if (!menu.getModelActive("wheel-zoom") || !player?.alive || document.activeElement.tagName === "INPUT") {
            return;
          }
          const power = 1.01;
          if (event.deltaY > 0) {
            if (maxScreenWidth <= 50000) {
              for (let i = 0; i < 25; i += 1) {
                setTimeout(() => {
                  if (maxScreenWidth > 50000) {
                    return;
                  }
                  maxScreenWidth *= power;
                  maxScreenHeight *= power;
                  resize();
                }, i * 5);
              }
            }
          } else if (maxScreenWidth >= 500) {
            for (let i = 0; i < 25; i += 1) {
              setTimeout(() => {
                if (maxScreenWidth < 500) {
                  return;
                }
                maxScreenWidth /= power;
                maxScreenHeight /= power;
                resize();
              }, i * 5);
            }
          }
        });
        var outlineWidth = 5.5; // SET INIT DATA:
        function setInitData(data) {
          alliances = data.teams;
        } // ON LOAD:
        var inWindow = true;
        var didLoad = false;
        window.onblur = function () {
          inWindow = false;
        };
        window.onfocus = function () {
          inWindow = true;
          if (player && player.alive) {
            resetMoveDir();
          }
        };
        window.onload = function () {
          window.follmoo();
          const shameImg = new Image();
          shameImg.onload = function () {
            this.isLoaded = true;
            this.onload = null;
          };
          shameImg.onerror = function () {
            console.warn("Failed to load shame hat image");
            this.isLoaded = false;
          };
          const shameHat = hats.filter(hat => hat.name === "Shame!")[0];
          if (shameHat) {
            shameImg.src = `./img/hats/hat_${shameHat.id}.png`;
            shameImg.scale = shameHat.scale;
            if (skinSprites) {
              skinSprites.shameImg = shameImg;
            }
          }
          didLoad = true;
          const removeCookie = setInterval(() => {
            const cookie = document.getElementById("onetrust-consent-sdk");
            if (!cookie?.style) {
              return;
            }
            if (cookie.style.display === "none") {
              return clearInterval(removeCookie);
            }
            cookie.style.display = "none";
          });
        };
        gameCanvas.oncontextmenu = function () {
          return false;
        };
        function disconnect(reason) {
          connected = false;
          io.close();
          showLoadingText(reason);
        }
        function showLoadingText(text) {
          mainMenu.style.display = "block";
          gameUI.style.display = "none";
          menuCardHolder.style.display = "none";
          diedText.style.display = "none";
          loadingText.style.display = "block";
          loadingText.innerHTML = text + "<a href='javascript:window.location.href=window.location.href' class='ytLink'>reload</a>";
        } // BUTTON EVENTS:
        function bindEvents() {
          promoImageButton.onclick = UTILS.checkTrusted(function () {
            openLink("https://krunker.io/?play=SquidGame_KB");
          });
          UTILS.hookTouchEvents(promoImageButton);
          joinPartyButton.onclick = UTILS.checkTrusted(function () {
            setTimeout(function () {
              joinParty();
            }, 10);
          });
          UTILS.hookTouchEvents(joinPartyButton);
          settingsButton.onclick = UTILS.checkTrusted(function () {
            toggleSettings();
          });
          UTILS.hookTouchEvents(settingsButton);
          allianceButton.onclick = UTILS.checkTrusted(function () {
            toggleAllianceMenu();
          });
          UTILS.hookTouchEvents(allianceButton);
          storeButton.onclick = UTILS.checkTrusted(function () {
            toggleStoreMenu();
          });
          UTILS.hookTouchEvents(storeButton);
          chatButton.onclick = UTILS.checkTrusted(function () {
            toggleChat();
          });
          UTILS.hookTouchEvents(chatButton);
          mapDisplay.onclick = UTILS.checkTrusted(function () {
            sendMapPing();
          });
          UTILS.hookTouchEvents(mapDisplay);
        } // SHOW ITEM INFO:
        var showItemInfo = window.showItemInfo; // SHOW ALLIANCE MENU:
        var allianceNotifications = [];
        var alliancePlayers = [];
        function allianceNotification(sid, name) {
          const requests = allianceNotifications.filter(request => request.sid === e);
          if (requests.length === 0) {
            pets.forEach(pet => {
              pet.addMessage(`${name} wants to join our clan 📝`, "rgba(155, 165, 18, 0.5)");
            });
          }
          allianceNotifications.push({
            sid: sid,
            name: name
          });
          updateNotifications();
        }
        function updateNotifications() {
          if (allianceNotifications[0]) {
            var tmpN = allianceNotifications[0];
            UTILS.removeAllChildren(noticationDisplay);
            noticationDisplay.style.display = "block";
            UTILS.generateElement({
              class: "notificationText",
              text: tmpN.name,
              parent: noticationDisplay
            });
            UTILS.generateElement({
              class: "notifButton",
              html: "<i class='material-icons' style='font-size:28px;color:#cc5151;'>&#xE14C;</i>",
              parent: noticationDisplay,
              onclick: function () {
                aJoinReq(0);
              },
              hookTouch: true
            });
            UTILS.generateElement({
              class: "notifButton",
              html: "<i class='material-icons' style='font-size:28px;color:#8ecc51;'>&#xE876;</i>",
              parent: noticationDisplay,
              onclick: function () {
                aJoinReq(1);
              },
              hookTouch: true
            });
          } else {
            noticationDisplay.style.display = "none";
          }
        }
        function addAlliance(data) {
          alliances.push(data);
          if (allianceMenu.style.display == "block") {
            showAllianceMenu();
          }
        }
        function setPlayerTeam(team, isOwner) {
          if (player) {
            player.team = team;
            player.isOwner = isOwner;
            if (allianceMenu.style.display == "block") {
              showAllianceMenu();
            }
          }
        }
        function setAlliancePlayers(data) {
          alliancePlayers = data;
          if (allianceMenu.style.display == "block") {
            showAllianceMenu();
          }
        }
        function deleteAlliance(sid) {
          for (var i = alliances.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (alliances[i].sid == sid) {
              alliances.splice(i, 1);
            }
          }
          if (allianceMenu.style.display == "block") {
            showAllianceMenu();
          }
        }
        function toggleAllianceMenu() {
          resetMoveDir();
          if (allianceMenu.style.display != "block") {
            showAllianceMenu();
          } else {
            allianceMenu.style.display = "none";
          }
        }
        function showAllianceMenu() {
          if (player && player.alive) {
            closeChat();
            storeMenu.style.display = "none";
            allianceMenu.style.display = "block";
            UTILS.removeAllChildren(allianceHolder);
            if (player.team) {
              for (var i = 0; i < alliancePlayers.length; i += 2) {
                (function (i) {
                  var tmp = UTILS.generateElement({
                    class: "allianceItem",
                    style: "color:" + (alliancePlayers[i] == player.sid ? "#fff" : "rgba(255,255,255,0.6)"),
                    text: alliancePlayers[i + 1],
                    parent: allianceHolder
                  });
                  if (player.isOwner && alliancePlayers[i] != player.sid) {
                    UTILS.generateElement({
                      class: "joinAlBtn",
                      text: "Kick",
                      onclick: function () {
                        kickFromClan(alliancePlayers[i]);
                      },
                      hookTouch: true,
                      parent: tmp
                    });
                  }
                })(i);
              }
            } else if (alliances.length) {
              for (var i = 0; i < alliances.length; ++i) {
                (function (i) {
                  var tmp = UTILS.generateElement({
                    class: "allianceItem",
                    style: "color:" + (alliances[i].sid == player.team ? "#fff" : "rgba(255,255,255,0.6)"),
                    text: alliances[i].sid,
                    parent: allianceHolder
                  });
                  UTILS.generateElement({
                    class: "joinAlBtn",
                    text: "Join",
                    onclick: function () {
                      sendJoin(i);
                    },
                    hookTouch: true,
                    parent: tmp
                  });
                })(i);
              }
            } else {
              UTILS.generateElement({
                class: "allianceItem",
                text: "No Tribes Yet",
                parent: allianceHolder
              });
            }
            UTILS.removeAllChildren(allianceManager);
            if (player.team) {
              UTILS.generateElement({
                class: "allianceButtonM",
                style: "width: 360px",
                text: player.isOwner ? "Delete Tribe" : "Leave Tribe",
                onclick: function () {
                  leaveAlliance();
                },
                hookTouch: true,
                parent: allianceManager
              });
            } else {
              UTILS.generateElement({
                tag: "input",
                type: "text",
                id: "allianceInput",
                maxLength: 7,
                placeholder: "unique name",
                ontouchstart: function (ev) {
                  ev.preventDefault();
                  var newValue = prompt("unique name", ev.currentTarget.value);
                  ev.currentTarget.value = newValue.slice(0, 7);
                },
                parent: allianceManager
              });
              UTILS.generateElement({
                tag: "div",
                class: "allianceButtonM",
                style: "width: 140px;",
                text: "Create",
                onclick: function () {
                  createAlliance();
                },
                hookTouch: true,
                parent: allianceManager
              });
            }
          }
        }

        window.socket = io; // MINIMAP:
        var lastDeath;
        var minimapData;
        var mapMarker;
        var mapPings = [];
        var tmpPing;
        function MapPing() {
          this.init = function (x, y) {
            this.scale = 0;
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.active = true;
          };
          this.update = function (ctxt, delta) {
            if (this.active) {
              this.scale += delta * 0.05;
              if (this.scale >= config.mapPingScale) {
                this.active = false;
              } else {
                ctxt.globalAlpha = 1 - Math.max(0, this.scale / config.mapPingScale);
                ctxt.beginPath();
                ctxt.arc(this.x / config.mapScale * mapDisplay.width, this.y / config.mapScale * mapDisplay.width, this.scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctxt.stroke();
              }
            }
          };
        }
        function pingMap(x, y) {
          for (var i = 0; i < mapPings.length; ++i) {
            if (!mapPings[i].active) {
              tmpPing = mapPings[i];
              break;
            }
          }
          if (!tmpPing) {
            tmpPing = new MapPing();
            mapPings.push(tmpPing);
          }
          tmpPing.init(x, y);
        }
        function updateMapMarker() {
          if (!mapMarker) {
            mapMarker = {};
          }
          mapMarker.x = player.x;
          mapMarker.y = player.y;
        }
        function updateMinimap(data) {
          minimapData = data;
        }
        function renderMinimap(e) {
          if (!menu.getModelActive("minimap")) {
            if (mapDisplay.style.display !== "none") {
              mapDisplay.style.display = "none";
            }
            return;
          } else if (mapDisplay.style.display === "none" || !mapDisplay.style.display) {
            mapDisplay.style.display = "block";
          }
          if (player && player.alive) {
            mapContext.clearRect(0, 0, mapDisplay.width, mapDisplay.height); // RENDER BIOMES:
            if (menu.getModelActive("minimap-biomes")) {
              function getBiomePosition(position, diviser = 1) {
                return position / config.mapScale * ((mapDisplay.width + mapDisplay.height) / 2 / diviser);
              }
              mapContext.save();
              mapContext.globalAlpha = 0.5;
              mapContext.fillStyle = "#fff";
              mapContext.fillRect(0, 0, mapDisplay.width, getBiomePosition(2400));
              mapContext.fillStyle = "#91b2db";
              mapContext.fillRect(0, getBiomePosition(config.mapScale / 2 - 362), mapDisplay.width, getBiomePosition(config.mapScale / 2 + 362, 10));
              mapContext.fillStyle = "#dbc666";
              mapContext.fillRect(0, getBiomePosition(config.mapScale - 2400), mapDisplay.width, mapDisplay.height);
              mapContext.restore();
            }
            if (menu.getModelActive("minimap-resources")) {
              minimapResources.forEach(resource => {
                resource.render(mapContext, d, f);
              });
            } // RENDER PINGS:
            mapContext.strokeStyle = "#fff";
            mapContext.lineWidth = 4;
            for (let t = 0; t < mapPings.length; ++t) {
              tmpPing = mapPings[t];
              tmpPing.update(mapContext, e);
            } // RENDER PLAYERS:
            mapContext.globalAlpha = 1;
            mapContext.fillStyle = "#fff";
            renderCircle(player.x / config.mapScale * mapDisplay.width, player.y / config.mapScale * mapDisplay.height, 7, mapContext, true);
            mapContext.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
            if (player.team && minimapData) {
              for (let t = 0; t < minimapData.length;) {
                renderCircle(minimapData[t] / config.mapScale * mapDisplay.width, minimapData[t + 1] / config.mapScale * mapDisplay.height, 7, mapContext, true);
                t += 2;
              }
            } // DEATH LOCATION:
            if (lastDeath) {
              mapContext.fillStyle = "#fc5553";
              mapContext.font = "34px Hammersmith One";
              mapContext.textBaseline = "middle";
              mapContext.textAlign = "center";
              mapContext.fillText("x", lastDeath.x / config.mapScale * mapDisplay.width, lastDeath.y / config.mapScale * mapDisplay.height);
            } // MAP MARKER:
            if (mapMarker) {
              mapContext.fillStyle = "#fff";
              mapContext.font = "34px Hammersmith One";
              mapContext.textBaseline = "middle";
              mapContext.textAlign = "center";
              mapContext.fillText("x", mapMarker.x / config.mapScale * mapDisplay.width, mapMarker.y / config.mapScale * mapDisplay.height);
            }
          }
        } // STORE MENU:
        var currentStoreIndex = 0;

        function toggleStoreMenu() {
          if (storeMenu.style.display != "block") {

        function updateStoreItems(type, id, index) {
          if (index) {
            if (!type) {
              player.tails[id] = 1;
            } else {
              player.tailIndex = id;
            }
          } else if (!type) {
            player.skins[id] = 1;
          } else {
            player.skinIndex = id;
          }
          if (storeMenu.style.display == "block") {
            generateStoreList();
          }
        }
        function generateStoreList() {
          if (player) {
            UTILS.removeAllChildren(storeHolder);
            var index = currentStoreIndex;
            var tmpArray = index ? accessories : hats;
            for (var i = 0; i < tmpArray.length; ++i) {
              if (!tmpArray[i].dontSell) {
                (function (i) {
                  var tmp = UTILS.generateElement({
                    id: "storeDisplay" + i,
                    class: "storeItem",
                    onmouseout: function () {
                      showItemInfo();
                    },
                    onmouseover: function () {
                      showItemInfo(tmpArray[i], false, true);
                    },
                    parent: storeHolder
                  });
                  UTILS.hookTouchEvents(tmp, true);
                  UTILS.generateElement({
                    tag: "img",
                    class: "hatPreview",
                    src: "./img/" + (index ? "accessories/access_" : "hats/hat_") + tmpArray[i].id + (tmpArray[i].topSprite ? "_p" : "") + ".png",
                    parent: tmp
                  });
                  UTILS.generateElement({
                    tag: "span",
                    text: tmpArray[i].name,
                    parent: tmp
                  });
                  if (index ? !player.tails[tmpArray[i].id] : !player.skins[tmpArray[i].id]) {
                    UTILS.generateElement({
                      class: "joinAlBtn",
                      style: "margin-top: 5px",
                      text: "Buy",
                      onclick: function () {
                        storeBuy(tmpArray[i].id, index);
                      },
                      hookTouch: true,
                      parent: tmp
                    });
                    UTILS.generateElement({
                      tag: "span",
                      class: "itemPrice",
                      text: tmpArray[i].price,
                      parent: tmp
                    });
                  } else if ((index ? player.tailIndex : player.skinIndex) == tmpArray[i].id) {
                    UTILS.generateElement({
                      class: "joinAlBtn",
                      style: "margin-top: 5px",
                      text: "Unequip",
                      onclick: function () {
                        storeEquip(0, index);
                      },
                      hookTouch: true,
                      parent: tmp
                    });
                  } else {
                    UTILS.generateElement({
                      class: "joinAlBtn",
                      style: "margin-top: 5px",
                      text: "Equip",
                      onclick: function () {
                        storeEquip(tmpArray[i].id, index);
                      },
                      hookTouch: true,
                      parent: tmp
                    });
                  }
                })(i);
              }
            }
          }
        }

        function prepareUI() {
          // NATIVE RESOLUTION:
          var savedNativeValue = getSavedVal("native_resolution");
          if (!savedNativeValue) {
            setUseNativeResolution(typeof cordova !== "undefined"); // Only default to native if on mobile
          } else {
            setUseNativeResolution(savedNativeValue == "true");
          } // SHOW PING:
          showPing = getSavedVal("show_ping") == "true";
          pingDisplay.hidden = !showPing; // SKIN COLOR PICKER:
          updateSkinColorPicker(); // ACTION BAR:
          UTILS.removeAllChildren(actionBar);
          for (var i = 0; i < items.weapons.length + items.list.length; ++i) {
            (function (i) {
              UTILS.generateElement({
                id: "actionBarItem" + i,
                class: "actionBarItem",
                style: "display:none",
                onmouseout: function () {
                  showItemInfo();
                },
                parent: actionBar
              });
            })(i);
          }
          for (var i = 0; i < items.list.length + items.weapons.length; ++i) {
            (function (i) {
              var tmpCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
              tmpCanvas.width = tmpCanvas.height = 66;
              var tmpContext = tmpCanvas.getContext("2d");
              tmpContext.translate(tmpCanvas.width / 2, tmpCanvas.height / 2);
              tmpContext.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
              tmpContext.webkitImageSmoothingEnabled = false;
              tmpContext.mozImageSmoothingEnabled = false;
              if (items.weapons[i]) {
                tmpContext.rotate(Math.PI / 4 + Math.PI);
                var tmpSprite = new Image();
                toolSprites[items.weapons[i].src] = tmpSprite;
                tmpSprite.onload = function () {
                  this.isLoaded = true;
                  var tmpPad = 1 / (this.height / this.width);
                  var tmpMlt = items.weapons[i].iPad || 1;
                  tmpContext.drawImage(this, -(tmpCanvas.width * tmpMlt * config.iconPad * tmpPad) / 2, -(tmpCanvas.height * tmpMlt * config.iconPad) / 2, tmpCanvas.width * tmpMlt * tmpPad * config.iconPad, tmpCanvas.height * tmpMlt * config.iconPad);
                  tmpContext.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 70, 0.1)";
                  tmpContext.globalCompositeOperation = "source-atop";
                  tmpContext.fillRect(-tmpCanvas.width / 2, -tmpCanvas.height / 2, tmpCanvas.width, tmpCanvas.height);
                  document.getElementById("actionBarItem" + i).style.backgroundImage = "url(" + tmpCanvas.toDataURL() + ")";
                };
                tmpSprite.src = ".././img/weapons/" + items.weapons[i].src + ".png";
                var tmpUnit = document.getElementById("actionBarItem" + i);
                tmpUnit.onmouseover = UTILS.checkTrusted(function () {
                  showItemInfo(items.weapons[i], true);
                });
                tmpUnit.onclick = UTILS.checkTrusted(function () {
                  selectToBuild(i, true);
                });
                UTILS.hookTouchEvents(tmpUnit);
              } else {
                var tmpSprite = getItemSprite(items.list[i - items.weapons.length], true);
                var tmpScale = Math.min(tmpCanvas.width - config.iconPadding, tmpSprite.width);
                tmpContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                tmpContext.drawImage(tmpSprite, -tmpScale / 2, -tmpScale / 2, tmpScale, tmpScale);
                tmpContext.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 70, 0.1)";
                tmpContext.globalCompositeOperation = "source-atop";
                tmpContext.fillRect(-tmpScale / 2, -tmpScale / 2, tmpScale, tmpScale);
                document.getElementById("actionBarItem" + i).style.backgroundImage = "url(" + tmpCanvas.toDataURL() + ")";
                var tmpUnit = document.getElementById("actionBarItem" + i);
                tmpUnit.onmouseover = UTILS.checkTrusted(function () {
                  showItemInfo(items.list[i - items.weapons.length]);
                });
                tmpUnit.onclick = UTILS.checkTrusted(function () {
                  selectToBuild(i - items.weapons.length);
                });
                UTILS.hookTouchEvents(tmpUnit);
              }
            })(i);
          } // MOBILE NAME INPUT:
          nameInput.ontouchstart = UTILS.checkTrusted(function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            var newValue = prompt("enter name", e.currentTarget.value);
            e.currentTarget.value = newValue.slice(0, 15);
          }); // SETTINGS:
          nativeResolutionCheckbox.checked = useNativeResolution;
          nativeResolutionCheckbox.onchange = UTILS.checkTrusted(function (e) {
            setUseNativeResolution(e.target.checked);
          });
          showPingCheckbox.checked = showPing;
          showPingCheckbox.onchange = UTILS.checkTrusted(function (e) {
            showPing = showPingCheckbox.checked;
            pingDisplay.hidden = !showPing;
            saveVal("show_ping", showPing ? "true" : "false");
          });
        }
        function updateItems(data, wpn) {
          if (data) {
            if (wpn) {
              player.weapons = data;
            } else {
              player.items = data;
            }
          }
          for (var i = 0; i < items.list.length; ++i) {
            var tmpI = items.weapons.length + i;
            document.getElementById("actionBarItem" + tmpI).style.display = player.items.indexOf(items.list[i].id) >= 0 ? "inline-block" : "none";
          }
          for (var i = 0; i < items.weapons.length; ++i) {
            document.getElementById("actionBarItem" + i).style.display = player.weapons[items.weapons[i].type] == items.weapons[i].id ? "inline-block" : "none";
          }
        }
        function setUseNativeResolution(useNative) {
          useNativeResolution = useNative;
          pixelDensity = useNative ? window.devicePixelRatio || 1 : 1;
          nativeResolutionCheckbox.checked = useNative;
          saveVal("native_resolution", useNative.toString());
          resize();
        }
        function updateGuide() {
          if (usingTouch) {
            guideCard.classList.add("touch");
          } else {
            guideCard.classList.remove("touch");
          }
        } // SETTINGS STUFF:
        function toggleSettings() {
          if (guideCard.classList.contains("showing")) {
            guideCard.classList.remove("showing");
            settingsButtonTitle.innerText = "Settings";
          } else {
            guideCard.classList.add("showing");
            settingsButtonTitle.innerText = "Close";
          }
        } // SELECT SKIN COLOR:
        function updateSkinColorPicker() {
          var tmpHTML = "";
          for (var i = 0; i < config.skinColors.length; ++i) {
            if (i == skinColor) {
              tmpHTML += "<div class='skinColorItem activeSkin' style='background-color:" + config.skinColors[i] + "' onclick='selectSkinColor(" + i + ")'></div>";
            } else {
              tmpHTML += "<div class='skinColorItem' style='background-color:" + config.skinColors[i] + "' onclick='selectSkinColor(" + i + ")'></div>";
            }
          }
          skinColorHolder.innerHTML = tmpHTML;
        }
        var selectSkinColor = selectSkinColor; // CHAT STUFF:
        var chatBox = document.getElementById("chatBox");
        var chatHolder = document.getElementById("chatHolder");
        function toggleChat() {
          if (!usingTouch) {
            if (chatHolder.style.display == "block") {
              if (chatBox.value) {
                sendChat(chatBox.value);
              }
              closeChat();
            } else {
              storeMenu.style.display = "none";
              allianceMenu.style.display = "none";
              chatHolder.style.display = "block";
              chatBox.focus();
              resetMoveDir();
            }
          } else {
            setTimeout(function () {
              // Timeout lets the `hookTouchEvents` function exit
              var chatMessage = prompt("chat message");
              if (chatMessage) {
                sendChat(chatMessage);
              }
            }, 1);
          }
          chatBox.value = "";
        }
        function sendChat(message) {
          io.send("6", message.slice(0, 30));
        }
        function closeChat() {
          chatBox.value = "";
          chatHolder.style.display = "none";
        } // SEND MESSAGE:
        var profanityList = ["cunt", "whore", "fuck", "shit", "faggot", "nigger", "nigga", "dick", "vagina", "minge", "cock", "rape", "cum", "sex", "tits", "penis", "clit", "pussy", "meatcurtain", "jizz", "prune", "douche", "wanker", "damn", "bitch", "dick", "fag", "bastard"];
        function checkProfanityString(text) {
          var tmpString;
          for (var i = 0; i < profanityList.length; ++i) {
            if (text.indexOf(profanityList[i]) > -1) {
              tmpString = "";
              for (var y = 0; y < profanityList[i].length; ++y) {
                tmpString += tmpString.length ? "o" : "M";
              }
              var re = new RegExp(profanityList[i], "g");
              text = text.replace(re, tmpString);
            }
          }
          return text;
        }
        function receiveChat(sid, message) {
          var tmpPlayer = findPlayerBySID(sid);
          if (tmpPlayer) {
            tmpPlayer.chatMessage = checkProfanityString(message);
            tmpPlayer.chatCountdown = config.chatCountdown;
          }
        } // RESIZE:
        window.addEventListener("resize", UTILS.checkTrusted(resize));
        function resize() {
          screenWidth = window.innerWidth;
          screenHeight = window.innerHeight;
          const scale = Math.max(screenWidth / maxScreenWidth, screenHeight / maxScreenHeight) * pixelDensity;
          gameCanvas.width = screenWidth * pixelDensity;
          gameCanvas.height = screenHeight * pixelDensity;
          gameCanvas.style.width = screenWidth + "px";
          gameCanvas.style.height = screenHeight + "px";
          if (mainContext) {
            mainContext.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, (screenWidth * pixelDensity - maxScreenWidth * scale) / 2, (screenHeight * pixelDensity - maxScreenHeight * scale) / 2);
          }
          window._maxScreenWidth = maxScreenWidth;
          window._maxScreenHeight = maxScreenHeight;
        }
        resize(); // TOUCH INPUT:
        var usingTouch;
        setUsingTouch(false);
        function setUsingTouch(using) {
          usingTouch = using;
          updateGuide(); // if (using) {
          //     chatButton.classList.add("mobile");
          // } else {
          //     chatButton.classList.remove("mobile");
          // }
        }
        window.setUsingTouch = setUsingTouch;
        touchControls.addEventListener("touchmove", UTILS.checkTrusted(touchMove), false);
        function touchMove(ev) {
          ev.preventDefault();
          ev.stopPropagation();
          setUsingTouch(true);
          for (var i = 0; i < ev.changedTouches.length; i++) {
            var t = ev.changedTouches[i];
            if (t.identifier == controllingTouch.id) {
              controllingTouch.currentX = t.pageX;
              controllingTouch.currentY = t.pageY;
              sendMoveDir();
            } else if (t.identifier == attackingTouch.id) {
              attackingTouch.currentX = t.pageX;
              attackingTouch.currentY = t.pageY;
              attackState = 1;
            }
          }
        }
        touchControls.addEventListener("touchstart", UTILS.checkTrusted(touchStart), false);
        function touchStart(ev) {
          ev.preventDefault();
          ev.stopPropagation();
          setUsingTouch(true);
          for (var i = 0; i < ev.changedTouches.length; i++) {
            var t = ev.changedTouches[i];
            if (t.pageX < document.body.scrollWidth / 2 && controllingTouch.id == -1) {
              controllingTouch.id = t.identifier;
              controllingTouch.startX = controllingTouch.currentX = t.pageX;
              controllingTouch.startY = controllingTouch.currentY = t.pageY;
              sendMoveDir();
            } else if (t.pageX > document.body.scrollWidth / 2 && attackingTouch.id == -1) {
              attackingTouch.id = t.identifier;
              attackingTouch.startX = attackingTouch.currentX = t.pageX;
              attackingTouch.startY = attackingTouch.currentY = t.pageY;
              if (player.buildIndex < 0) {
                attackState = 1;
                sendAtckState();
              }
            }
          }
        }
        touchControls.addEventListener("touchend", UTILS.checkTrusted(touchEnd), false);
        touchControls.addEventListener("touchcancel", UTILS.checkTrusted(touchEnd), false);
        touchControls.addEventListener("touchleave", UTILS.checkTrusted(touchEnd), false);
        function touchEnd(ev) {
          ev.preventDefault();
          ev.stopPropagation();
          setUsingTouch(true);
          for (var i = 0; i < ev.changedTouches.length; i++) {
            var t = ev.changedTouches[i];
            if (t.identifier == controllingTouch.id) {
              controllingTouch.id = -1;
              sendMoveDir();
            } else if (t.identifier == attackingTouch.id) {
              attackingTouch.id = -1;
              if (player.buildIndex >= 0) {
                attackState = 1;
                sendAtckState();
              }
              attackState = 0;
              sendAtckState();
            }
          }
        } // MOUSE INPUT:
        touchControls.addEventListener("mousemove", gameInput, false);
        function gameInput(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          setUsingTouch(false);
          mouseX = e.clientX;
          mouseY = e.clientY;
        }
        touchControls.addEventListener("mousedown", mouseDown, false);
        function mouseDown(e) {
          setUsingTouch(false);
          if (attackState != 1) {
            attackState = 1;
            sendAtckState();
          }
        }
        touchControls.addEventListener("mouseup", mouseUp, false);
        function mouseUp(e) {
          setUsingTouch(false);
          if (attackState != 0) {
            attackState = 0;
            sendAtckState();
          }
        } // INPUT UTILS:
        function getMoveDir() {
          var dx = 0;
          var dy = 0;
          if (controllingTouch.id != -1) {
            dx += controllingTouch.currentX - controllingTouch.startX;
            dy += controllingTouch.currentY - controllingTouch.startY;
          } else {
            for (var key in moveKeys) {
              var tmpDir = moveKeys[key];
              dx += !!keys[key] * tmpDir[0];
              dy += !!keys[key] * tmpDir[1];
            }
          }
          if (dx == 0 && dy == 0) {
            return undefined;
          } else {
            return UTILS.fixTo(Math.atan2(dy, dx), 2);
          }
        }
        var lastDir;
        function getAttackDir() {
          if (!player) {
            return 0;
          }
          if (attackingTouch.id != -1) {
            lastDir = Math.atan2(attackingTouch.currentY - attackingTouch.startY, attackingTouch.currentX - attackingTouch.startX);
          } else if (!player.lockDir && !usingTouch) {
            lastDir = Math.atan2(mouseY - screenHeight / 2, mouseX - screenWidth / 2);
          }
          return UTILS.fixTo(lastDir || 0, 2);
        } // KEYS:
        var keys = {};
        var moveKeys = {
          87: [0, -1],
          38: [0, -1],
          83: [0, 1],
          40: [0, 1],
          65: [-1, 0],
          37: [-1, 0],
          68: [1, 0],
          39: [1, 0]
        };
        function resetMoveDir() {
          keys = {};
          io.send("e");
        }
        function keysActive() {
          return allianceMenu.style.display != "block" && chatHolder.style.display != "block";
        }
        window.isAutoAttackActive = 0;
        function keyDown(event) {
          if (document.activeElement.tagName === "INPUT" && event.keyCode !== 13 && event.keyCode !== 27) {
            return;
          }
          var keyNum = event.which || event.keyCode || 0;
          if (keyNum === 69) {
            window.isAutoAttackActive = Number(!window.isAutoAttackActive);
          }
          if (keyNum == 27) {
            hideAllWindows();
          } else if (player && player.alive && keysActive()) {
            if (!keys[keyNum]) {
              keys[keyNum] = 1;
              if (keyNum == 69) {
                sendAutoGather();
              } else if (keyNum == 67) {
                updateMapMarker();
              } else if (keyNum == 88) {
                sendLockDir();
              } else if (player.weapons[keyNum - 49] != undefined) {
                selectToBuild(player.weapons[keyNum - 49], true);
              } else if (player.items[keyNum - 49 - player.weapons.length] != undefined) {
                selectToBuild(player.items[keyNum - 49 - player.weapons.length]);
              } else if (keyNum == 81) {
                selectToBuild(player.items[0]);
              } else if (keyNum == 82) {
                sendMapPing();
              } else if (moveKeys[keyNum]) {
                sendMoveDir();
              } else if (keyNum == 32) {
                attackState = 1;
                sendAtckState();
              }
            }
          }
        }
        window.addEventListener("keydown", UTILS.checkTrusted(keyDown));
        function keyUp(event) {
          if (document.activeElement.tagName === "INPUT" && event.keyCode !== 13 && event.keyCode !== 27) {
            return;
          }
          if (player && player.alive) {
            var keyNum = event.which || event.keyCode || 0;
            if (keyNum == 13) {
              toggleChat();
            } else if (keysActive()) {
              if (keys[keyNum]) {
                keys[keyNum] = 0;
                if (moveKeys[keyNum]) {
                  sendMoveDir();
                } else if (keyNum == 32) {
                  attackState = 0;
                  sendAtckState();
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
        window.addEventListener("keyup", UTILS.checkTrusted(keyUp));
        function sendAtckState() {
          if (player && player.alive) {
            io.send("F", attackState, player.buildIndex >= 0 ? getAttackDir() : null);
          }
        }
        var lastMoveDir = undefined;
        function sendMoveDir() {
          var newMoveDir = getMoveDir();
          if (lastMoveDir == undefined || newMoveDir == undefined || Math.abs(newMoveDir - lastMoveDir) > 0.3) {
            io.send("9", newMoveDir);
            lastMoveDir = newMoveDir;
          }
        }
        function sendLockDir() {
          player.lockDir = player.lockDir ? 0 : 1;
          io.send("K", 0);
        }
        function sendMapPing() {
          io.send("S", 1);
        }
        function sendAutoGather() {
          io.send("K", 1);
        }
        function selectToBuild(index, wpn) {
          io.send("z", index, wpn);
        } // ENTER GAME:
        function enterGame() {
          saveVal("moo_name", nameInput.value);
          if (!inGame && socketReady()) {
            inGame = true;
            showLoadingText("Loading...");
            io.send("M", {
              name: nameInput.value,
              moofoll: moofoll,
              skin: skinColor
            });
          }
        } // SETUP GAME:
        var firstSetup = true;
        function setupGame(yourSID) {
          loadingText.style.display = "none";
          menuCardHolder.style.display = "block";
          mainMenu.style.display = "none";
          keys = {};
          playerSID = yourSID;
          attackState = 0;
          inGame = true;
          if (firstSetup) {
            firstSetup = false;
            gameObjects.length = 0;
          }
        } // SHOW ANIM TEXT:
        function showText(x, y, value, type) {
          if (menu.getModelActive("disable-animated-text")) {
            return;
          }
          const scale = parseInt(menu.getModelValue("animated-text-scale"));
          const speed = parseFloat(menu.getModelValue("animated-text-speed") / 21);
          const lifeTime = parseInt(menu.getModelValue("animated-text-life-time"));
          const healColor = menu.getModelValue("animated-text-heal-color");
          const damageColor = menu.getModelValue("animated-text-damage-color");
          textManager.showText(x, y, scale, speed, lifeTime, Math.abs(value), value >= 0 ? damageColor : healColor);
        } // KILL PLAYER:
        var deathTextScale = 99999;
        function killPlayer() {
          inGame = false;
          gameUI.style.display = "none";
          hideAllWindows();
          lastDeath = {
            x: player.x,
            y: player.y
          };
          loadingText.style.display = "none";
          diedText.style.display = "block";
          diedText.style.fontSize = "0px";
          deathTextScale = 0;
          setTimeout(() => {
            menuCardHolder.style.display = "block";
            mainMenu.style.display = "block";
            diedText.style.display = "none";
            player.resetHealthAnim();
            for (const player1 of players) {
              player1.resetHealthAnim();
            }
          }, config.deathFadeout);
        } // KILL ALL OBJECTS BY A PLAYER:
        function killObjects(sid) {
          if (player) {
            objectManager.removeAllItems(sid);
          }
        } // KILL OBJECT:
        function killObject(sid) {
          const tmpObject = objectManager.objects.filter(object => object.sid === sid)[0];
          if (!tmpObject) {
            return;
          }
          if (tmpObject.owner?.sid === player.sid) {
            tmpObject.updateItemCount(true);
          }
          if (tmpObject.visibleToPlayer(player) && menu.getModelActive("destroy-animation") && tmpObject.isItem) {
            tmpObject.startDestroyAnimation(objectManager, sid);
          } else {
            objectManager.disableBySid(sid);
          }
        } // UPDATE SCORE DISPLAY:
        const playerResources = {
          wood: 0,
          stone: 0,
          food: 0,
          points: 0,
          kills: 0
        };
        function toDesignText(value, max = 1000) {
          if (value === Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY) {
            return "Infinity";
          } else if (value >= 1000000000000000000 && max <= 1000000000000000000) {
            return value.toExponential(2).replace(/\+/g, "");
          } else if (value >= 1000000000000000 && max <= 1000000000000000) {
            return (value / 1000000000000000).toFixed(2) + "q";
          } else if (value >= 1000000000000 && max <= 1000000000000) {
            return (value / 1000000000000).toFixed(2) + "t";
          } else if (value >= 1000000000 && max <= 1000000000) {
            return (value / 1000000000).toFixed(2) + "b";
          } else if (value >= 1000000 && max <= 1000000) {
            return (value / 1000000).toFixed(2) + "m";
          } else if (value >= 1000 && max <= 1000) {
            return (value / 1000).toFixed(2) + "k";
          } else {
            return value.toString().replace(/\B(?<!\.\d*)(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");
          }
        }
        ;
        function updateStatusDisplay() {
          if (!player?.alive) {
            return;
          }
          playerResources.wood += (player.wood - playerResources.wood) / 15;
          playerResources.stone += (player.stone - playerResources.stone) / 15;
          playerResources.points += (player.points - playerResources.points) / 15;
          playerResources.food += (player.food - playerResources.food) / 15;
          if (menu.getModelActive("smooth-add-resources")) {
            scoreDisplay.innerText = toDesignText(Math.round(playerResources.points), 1000000);
            foodDisplay.innerText = toDesignText(Math.round(playerResources.food), 1000000);
            woodDisplay.innerText = toDesignText(Math.round(playerResources.wood), 1000000);
            stoneDisplay.innerText = toDesignText(Math.round(playerResources.stone), 1000000);
            killCounter.innerText = toDesignText(Math.round(playerResources.kills), 1000000);
          } else {
            scoreDisplay.innerText = player.points;
            foodDisplay.innerText = player.food;
            woodDisplay.innerText = player.wood;
            stoneDisplay.innerText = player.stone;
            killCounter.innerText = player.kills;
          }
        }
        setInterval(() => {
          if (player) {
            updateStatusDisplay();
          }
        }, 10); // ICONS:
        var iconSprites = {};
        var icons = ["crown", "skull"];
        function loadIcons() {
          for (var i = 0; i < icons.length; ++i) {
            var tmpSprite = new Image();
            tmpSprite.onload = function () {
              this.isLoaded = true;
            };
            tmpSprite.src = "./img/icons/" + icons[i] + ".png";
            iconSprites[icons[i]] = tmpSprite;
          }
        } // UPDATE UPGRADES:
        var tmpList = [];
        let oldUpgradesCount = 0;
        function updateUpgrades(points, age) {
          if (typeof age !== "undefined") {
            if (points < oldUpgradesCount) {
              pets.forEach(pet => {
                pet.addMessage(`(=^ ◡ ^=) Nice chose!`);
              });
            }
            oldUpgradesCount = points;
          }
          player.upgradePoints = points;
          player.upgrAge = age;
          if (points > 0) {
            tmpList.length = 0;
            UTILS.removeAllChildren(upgradeHolder);
            for (var i = 0; i < items.weapons.length; ++i) {
              if (items.weapons[i].age == age && (items.weapons[i].pre == undefined || player.weapons.indexOf(items.weapons[i].pre) >= 0)) {
                var e = UTILS.generateElement({
                  id: "upgradeItem" + i,
                  class: "actionBarItem",
                  onmouseout: function () {
                    showItemInfo();
                  },
                  parent: upgradeHolder
                });
                upgradeHolder.style.display = "flex";
                upgradeHolder.style.justifyContent = "center";
                const id = e - 16;
                if (id < 3) {
                  return;
                }
                const actionBarItem = document.getElementById(`actionBarItem${e}`);
                const limit = window.inSandbox ? Math.max(items.list[id].group.limit * 3, 99) : items.list[id].group.limit;
                actionBarItem.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", `<span class="item-count" id="itemCount_${id}" style="display: none; color: #fff; font-size: 14px;">${menu.getModelActive("item-counts") ? `0/${limit}` : ""}</span>`);
                window.toggleItemCounts();
                e.style.backgroundImage = document.getElementById("actionBarItem" + i).style.backgroundImage;
                tmpList.push(i);
              }
            }
            for (var i = 0; i < items.list.length; ++i) {
              if (items.list[i].age == age && (items.list[i].pre == undefined || player.items.indexOf(items.list[i].pre) >= 0)) {
                var tmpI = items.weapons.length + i;
                var e = UTILS.generateElement({
                  id: "upgradeItem" + tmpI,
                  class: "actionBarItem",
                  onmouseout: function () {
                    showItemInfo();
                  },
                  parent: upgradeHolder
                });
                upgradeHolder.style.display = "flex";
                upgradeHolder.style.justifyContent = "center";
                const id = e - 16;
                if (id < 3) {
                  return;
                }
                const actionBarItem = document.getElementById(`actionBarItem${e}`);
                const limit = window.inSandbox ? Math.max(items.list[id].group.limit * 3, 99) : items.list[id].group.limit;
                actionBarItem.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", `<span class="item-count" id="itemCount_${id}" style="display: none; color: #fff; font-size: 14px;">${menu.getModelActive("item-counts") ? `0/${limit}` : ""}</span>`);
                window.toggleItemCounts();
                e.style.backgroundImage = document.getElementById("actionBarItem" + tmpI).style.backgroundImage;
                tmpList.push(tmpI);
              }
            }
            for (var i = 0; i < tmpList.length; i++) {
              (function (i) {
                var tmpItem = document.getElementById("upgradeItem" + i);
                tmpItem.onmouseover = function () {
                  if (items.weapons[i]) {
                    showItemInfo(items.weapons[i], true);
                  } else {
                    showItemInfo(items.list[i - items.weapons.length]);
                  }
                };
                tmpItem.onclick = UTILS.checkTrusted(function () {
                  io.send("H", i);
                });
                UTILS.hookTouchEvents(tmpItem);
              })(tmpList[i]);
            }
            if (tmpList.length) {
              upgradeHolder.style.display = "block";
              upgradeCounter.style.display = "block";
              upgradeCounter.innerHTML = "SELECT ITEMS (" + points + ")";
            } else {
              upgradeHolder.style.display = "none";
              upgradeCounter.style.display = "none";
              showItemInfo();
            }
          } else {
            upgradeHolder.style.display = "none";
            upgradeCounter.style.display = "none";
            showItemInfo();
          }
        }
        function sendUpgrade(index) {
          io.send("H", index);
        } // UPDATE AGE:
        function updateAge(xp, mxp, age) {
          if (age) {
            pets.forEach(pet => {
              pet.addMessage(`˶ᵔ ᵕ ᵔ˶ You got level ${age}!`, "rgba(15, 133, 27, 0.5)");
            });
          }
          if (xp != undefined) {
            player.XP = xp;
          }
          if (mxp != undefined) {
            player.maxXP = mxp;
          }
          if (age != undefined) {
            player.age = age;
          }
          if (age == config.maxAge) {
            ageText.innerHTML = "MAX AGE";
            ageBarBody.style.width = "100%";
          } else {
            ageText.innerHTML = "AGE " + player.age;
            ageBarBody.style.width = player.XP / player.maxXP * 100 + "%";
          }
        } // UPDATE LEADERBOARD:
        function updateLeaderboard(data) {
          UTILS.removeAllChildren(leaderboardData);
          var tmpC = 1;
          for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i += 3) {
            (function (i) {
              UTILS.generateElement({
                class: "leaderHolder",
                parent: leaderboardData,
                children: [UTILS.generateElement({
                  class: "leaderboardItem",
                  style: "color:" + (data[i] == playerSID ? "#fff" : "rgba(255,255,255,0.6)"),
                  text: tmpC + ". " + (data[i + 1] != "" ? data[i + 1] : "unknown")
                }), UTILS.generateElement({
                  class: "leaderScore",
                  text: UTILS.kFormat(data[i + 2]) || "0"
                })]
              });
            })(i);
            tmpC++;
          }
        } // UPDATE GAME:
        let lastAttackDir = null;
        let lineDashOffset = 0;
        function drawTracer(x, y, color, dashLine) {
          mainContext.save();
          mainContext.strokeStyle = color;
          mainContext.lineWidth = 2;
          mainContext.lineJoin = "round";
          mainContext.beginPath();
          if (dashLine) {
            mainContext.setLineDash([10, 10]);
            mainContext.lineDashOffset = lineDashOffset;
          }
          mainContext.moveTo(player.x - window.xOffset, player.y - window.yOffset);
          mainContext.lineTo(x - window.xOffset, y - window.yOffset);
          mainContext.stroke();
          mainContext.closePath();
          mainContext.restore();
        }
        function drawArrow(x, y, arrowWidth, color, angle) {
          mainContext.save();
          mainContext.translate(x - window.xOffset, y - window.yOffset);
          mainContext.rotate(Math.PI / 4);
          mainContext.rotate(angle);
          mainContext.globalAlpha = 0.75;
          mainContext.strokeStyle = color;
          mainContext.lineCap = "round";
          mainContext.lineWidth = 8;
          mainContext.beginPath();
          mainContext.moveTo(-arrowWidth, -arrowWidth);
          mainContext.lineTo(arrowWidth, -arrowWidth);
          mainContext.lineTo(arrowWidth, arrowWidth);
          mainContext.stroke();
          mainContext.closePath();
          mainContext.restore();
        }
        let nightCount = 0;
        let nightState = 0;
        let nightStateTime = Date.now();
        function updateGame() {
          if (true) {
            // UPDATE DIRECTION:
            if (player) {
              if (!lastSent || now - lastSent >= 1000 / config.clientSendRate) {
                lastSent = now;
                const dir = getAttackDir();
                if (lastAttackDir !== dir) {
                  lastAttackDir = dir;
                  io.send("D", dir);
                }
              }
            } // DEATH TEXT:
            if (deathTextScale < 120) {
              deathTextScale += delta * 0.1;
              diedText.style.fontSize = `${Math.min(Math.round(deathTextScale), 120)}px`;
            } // MOVE CAMERA:
            if (player) {
              const distance = UTILS.getDistance(camX, camY, player.x, player.y);
              const angle = UTILS.getDirection(player.x, player.y, camX, camY);
              const tmpSpeed = menu.getModelActive("smooth-camera") ? 0.0045 : 0.01;
              const fixSpeed = Math.min(tmpSpeed * distance * delta, distance);
              if (distance > 0.05) {
                camX += fixSpeed * Math.cos(angle);
                camY += fixSpeed * Math.sin(angle);
              } else {
                camX = player.x;
                camY = player.y;
              }
            } else {
              camX = config.mapScale / 2;
              camY = config.mapScale / 2;
            } // INTERPOLATE PLAYERS AND AI:
            const n = now - 1000 / config.serverUpdateRate;
            for (let a = 0; a < players.length + ais.length; ++a) {
              if ((tmpObj = players[a] || ais[a - players.length]) && tmpObj.visible) {
                if (tmpObj.forcePos) {
                  tmpObj.x = tmpObj.x2;
                  tmpObj.y = tmpObj.y2;
                  tmpObj.dir = tmpObj.d2;
                } else {
                  const c = tmpObj.t2 - tmpObj.t1;
                  const l = (n - tmpObj.t1) / c;
                  tmpObj.dt += delta;
                  const h = Math.min(1.7, tmpObj.dt / 170);
                  let u = tmpObj.x2 - tmpObj.x1;
                  tmpObj.x = tmpObj.x1 + u * h;
                  u = tmpObj.y2 - tmpObj.y1;
                  tmpObj.y = tmpObj.y1 + u * h;
                  tmpObj.dir = Math.lerpAngle(tmpObj.d2, tmpObj.d1, Math.min(1.2, l));
                }
              }
            } // RENDER CORDS:
            const d = camX - maxScreenWidth / 2;
            const f = camY - maxScreenHeight / 2; // RENDER BACKGROUND:
            if (config.snowBiomeTop - f <= 0 && config.mapScale - config.snowBiomeTop - f >= maxScreenHeight) {
              mainContext.fillStyle = menu.getModelValue("grass-biome-color");
              mainContext.fillRect(0, 0, maxScreenWidth, maxScreenHeight);
            } else if (config.mapScale - config.snowBiomeTop - f <= 0) {
              mainContext.fillStyle = menu.getModelValue("desert-biome-color");
              mainContext.fillRect(0, 0, maxScreenWidth, maxScreenHeight);
            } else if (config.snowBiomeTop - f >= maxScreenHeight) {
              mainContext.fillStyle = menu.getModelValue("snow-biome-color");
              mainContext.fillRect(0, 0, maxScreenWidth, maxScreenHeight);
            } else if (config.snowBiomeTop - f >= 0) {
              mainContext.fillStyle = menu.getModelValue("snow-biome-color");
              mainContext.fillRect(0, 0, maxScreenWidth, config.snowBiomeTop - f);
              mainContext.fillStyle = menu.getModelValue("grass-biome-color");
              mainContext.fillRect(0, config.snowBiomeTop - f, maxScreenWidth, maxScreenHeight - (config.snowBiomeTop - f));
              if (menu.getModelActive("coastlines")) {
                if (menu.getModelActive("snow-coast")) {
                  snowPath.render(menu.getModelValue("snow-biome-color"), d, f);
                }
              }
            } else {
              mainContext.fillStyle = menu.getModelValue("grass-biome-color");
              mainContext.fillRect(0, 0, maxScreenWidth, config.mapScale - config.snowBiomeTop - f);
              mainContext.fillStyle = menu.getModelValue("desert-biome-color");
              mainContext.fillRect(0, config.mapScale - config.snowBiomeTop - f, maxScreenWidth, maxScreenHeight - (config.mapScale - config.snowBiomeTop - f));
              if (menu.getModelActive("coastlines")) {
                if (menu.getModelActive("desert-coast")) {
                  desertPath.render(menu.getModelValue("desert-biome-color"), d, f);
                }
              }
            } // RENDER WATER AREAS:
            if (!firstSetup) {
              if (!menu.getModelActive("disable-river-waves")) {
                waterMult += waterPlus * config.waveSpeed * delta;
                if (waterMult >= config.waveMax) {
                  waterMult = config.waveMax;
                  waterPlus = -1;
                } else if (waterMult <= 1) {
                  waterMult = waterPlus = 1;
                }
              } else {
                waterMult = waterPlus = 1;
              }
              mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
              mainContext.fillStyle = menu.getModelValue("beach-biome-color");
              renderWaterBodies(d, f, mainContext, config.riverPadding);
              mainContext.fillStyle = menu.getModelValue("river-biome-color");
              renderWaterBodies(d, f, mainContext, (waterMult - 1) * 250);
            } // RENDER GRID:
            if (!menu.getModelActive("disable-game-grid")) {
              mainContext.save();
              mainContext.lineWidth = 4;
              mainContext.strokeStyle = "#000";
              mainContext.globalAlpha = 0.06;
              mainContext.beginPath();
              for (let x = -camX; x < maxScreenWidth; x += maxScreenHeight / 18) {
                if (x > 0) {
                  mainContext.moveTo(x, 0);
                  mainContext.lineTo(x, maxScreenHeight);
                }
              }
              for (let y = -camY; y < maxScreenHeight; y += maxScreenHeight / 18) {
                if (y > 0) {
                  mainContext.moveTo(0, y);
                  mainContext.lineTo(maxScreenWidth, y);
                }
              }
              mainContext.stroke();
              mainContext.restore();
            }
            if (menu.getModelActive("shadows")) {
              mainContext.shadowColor = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)";
              mainContext.shadowBlur = 10;
              mainContext.shadowOffsetY = 5;
            } // RENDER BOTTOM LAYER:
            mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
            mainContext.strokeStyle = outlineColor;
            renderGameObjects(-1, d, f); // RENDER PROJECTILES:
            mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
            mainContext.lineWidth = 5.5;
            renderProjectiles(0, d, f); // RENDER PLAYERS:
            renderPlayers(d, f, 0); // RENDER AI:
            mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
            for (let a = 0; a < ais.length; ++a) {
              tmpObj = ais[a];
              if (tmpObj.active && tmpObj.visible) {
                tmpObj.animate(delta);
                mainContext.save();
                mainContext.translate(tmpObj.x - d, tmpObj.y - f);
                mainContext.rotate(tmpObj.dir + tmpObj.dirPlus - Math.PI / 2);
                renderAI(tmpObj, mainContext);
                mainContext.restore();
              }
            } // RENDER GAME OBJECTS (LAYERED):
            renderGameObjects(0, d, f);
            renderProjectiles(1, d, f);
            renderGameObjects(1, d, f);
            renderPlayers(d, f, 1);
            backgroundPlayer.update(d, f, delta);
            renderGameObjects(2, d, f);
            renderGameObjects(3, d, f); // MAP BOUNDARIES:
            mainContext.fillStyle = "#000";
            mainContext.globalAlpha = 0.09;
            if (d <= 0) {
              mainContext.fillRect(0, 0, -d, maxScreenHeight);
            }
            if (config.mapScale - d <= maxScreenWidth) {
              const tmpY = Math.max(0, -f);
              mainContext.fillRect(config.mapScale - d, tmpY, maxScreenWidth - (config.mapScale - d), maxScreenHeight - tmpY);
            }
            if (f <= 0) {
              mainContext.fillRect(-d, 0, maxScreenWidth + d, -f);
            }
            if (config.mapScale - f <= maxScreenHeight) {
              const tmpX = Math.max(0, -d);
              let tmpMin = 0;
              if (config.mapScale - d <= maxScreenWidth) {
                tmpMin = maxScreenWidth - (config.mapScale - d);
              }
              mainContext.fillRect(tmpX, config.mapScale - f, maxScreenWidth - tmpX - tmpMin, maxScreenHeight - (config.mapScale - f));
            } // RENDER DAY/NIGHT TIME:
            mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
            mainContext.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 70, 0.35)";
            mainContext.fillRect(0, 0, maxScreenWidth, maxScreenHeight); // RENDER PLAYER AND AI UI:
            mainContext.strokeStyle = darkOutlineColor;
            for (let a = 0; a < players.length + ais.length; ++a) {
              tmpObj = players[a] || ais[a - players.length];
              if (tmpObj.visible) {
                // NAME, HEALTH, TRACERS, ETC:
                if (tmpObj.skinIndex != 10 || tmpObj.isAlly) {
                  const shameCounter = menu.getModelActive("shame-indicators") && menu.getModelActive("shame-counter");
                  const team = tmpObj.team ? "[" + tmpObj.team + "] " : "";
                  const nicknameValue = team + (tmpObj.name || "");
