                  const shameCounterValue = shameCounter ? `  ${tmpObj.shameCount || 0}` : "";
                  if (tmpText != "" && menu.getModelActive("nickname")) {
                    let offsetX = menu.getModelValue("nickname-offset-x");
                    if (menu.getModelActive("nickname-float-left")) {
                      offsetX = -menu.getModelValue("nickname-offset-x");
                    }
                    const offsetY = menu.getModelValue("nickname-offset-y");
                    mainContext.font = `${tmpObj.nameScale || 30}px Hammersmith One`;
                    mainContext.fillStyle = menu.getModelValue("nickname-color");
                    mainContext.textBaseline = "middle";
                    mainContext.textAlign = "center";
                    mainContext.lineWidth = tmpObj.nameScale ? 11 : 8;
                    mainContext.lineJoin = "round";
                    const nicknameWidth = mainContext.measureText(nicknameValue).width;
                    mainContext.strokeText(nicknameValue, tmpObj.x - d + offsetX, tmpObj.y - f - tmpObj.scale - tmpObj.nameY + offsetY);
                    mainContext.fillText(nicknameValue, tmpObj.x - d + offsetX, tmpObj.y - f - tmpObj.scale - config.nameY + offsetY);
                    mainContext.fillStyle = menu.getModelValue("shame-counter-color");
                    mainContext.textAlign = "left";
                    if (tmpObj.isPlayer) {
                      mainContext.strokeText(shameCounterValue, tmpObj.x + nicknameWidth / 2 + (tmpObj.iconIndex == 1 ? config.crownIconScale / 2 + config.crownPad / 2 : 0) - d + offsetX, tmpObj.y - f - tmpObj.scale - config.nameY + offsetY);
                      mainContext.fillText(shameCounterValue, tmpObj.x + nicknameWidth / 2 + (tmpObj.iconIndex == 1 ? config.crownIconScale / 2 + config.crownPad / 2 : 0) - d + offsetX, tmpObj.y - f - tmpObj.scale - config.nameY + offsetY);
                    }
                    if (tmpObj.isLeader && iconSprites.crown.isLoaded) {
                      const b = config.crownIconScale;
                      tmpX = tmpObj.x - d - b / 2 - mainContext.measureText(nicknameValue).width / 2 - config.crownPad;
                      mainContext.drawImage(iconSprites.crown, tmpX + offsetX, tmpObj.y - f + offsetY - tmpObj.scale - config.nameY - b / 2 - 5, b, b);
                    }
                    if (tmpObj.iconIndex == 1 && iconSprites.skull.isLoaded) {
                      tmpS = config.crownIconScale;
                      tmpX = tmpObj.x - d - tmpS / 2 + mainContext.measureText(nicknameValue).width / 2 + config.crownPad;
                      mainContext.drawImage(iconSprites.skull, tmpX + offsetX, tmpObj.y - f + offsetY - tmpObj.scale - config.nameY - tmpS / 2 - 5, tmpS, tmpS);
                    }
                  }
                  window.xOffset = d;
                  window.yOffset = f;
                  window.cameraX = camX;
                  window.cameraY = camY;
                  window.ownPlayer = player;
                  if (menu.getModelActive("attack-animation") && tmpObj.active && tmpObj.alive && tmpObj.isPlayer) {
                    const color = tmpObj.isAlly ? "#8ecc51" : "#cc5151";
                    const magic = magicFactory(tmpObj.x, tmpObj.y, window.weaponsConfig[tmpObj.weaponIndex || 0].range / 1.85, tmpObj);
                    magic.fire(color);
                  }
                  if (tmpObj.isPlayer) {
                    if (tmpObj.alive && tmpObj.active) {
                      if (tmpObj.y <= config.snowBiomeTop) {
                        tmpObj.biomeColor = "#a2c4ec";
                        tmpObj.biome = "snow";
                      } else if (tmpObj.y >= config.mapScale / 2 - config.riverWidth / 2 && tmpObj.y <= config.mapScale / 2 + config.riverWidth / 2) {
                        tmpObj.biomeColor = "#486589";
                        tmpObj.biome = "river";
                      } else if (tmpObj.y > config.snowBiomeTop && tmpObj.y < config.mapScale - config.snowBiomeTop) {
                        tmpObj.biomeColor = "#8cb337";
                        tmpObj.biome = "grass";
                      } else {
                        tmpObj.biomeColor = "#a08e3b";
                        tmpObj.biome = "desert";
                      }
                      if (menu.getModelActive("movement-tail") && menu.getModelActive("movement-tail-all-players")) {
                        const scale = menu.getModelValue("movement-tail-scale");
                        for (let i = 0; i < Math.floor(tmpObj.moveSpeed); i++) {
                          particles.create("movement-tail", tmpObj.x, tmpObj.y, Math.random() * scale + 1, tmpObj.biomeColor, Math.random() * 2 + 1, 600);
                        }
                      }
                      if (tmpObj.sid !== player.sid) {
                        const angle = Math.atan2(tmpObj.y - player.y, tmpObj.x - player.x);
                        const distance = Math.hypot(tmpObj.y - player.y, tmpObj.x - player.x);
                        const offset = Math.min(distance - player.scale, player.scale * 4);
                        const arrowX = player.x + offset * Math.cos(angle);
                        const arrowY = player.y + offset * Math.sin(angle);
                        const color = tmpObj.isAlly ? menu.getModelValue("tracers-color-ally") : menu.getModelValue("tracers-color-enemy");
                        const dashLine = menu.getModelActive("tracers-players-dashline");
                        const arrowWidth = 8;
                        if (menu.getModelActive("tracers-to-players")) {
                          if (menu.getModelActive("tracers-players-use-arrows")) {
                            drawArrow(arrowX, arrowY, arrowWidth, color, angle);
                          } else {
                            drawTracer(U.x, U.y, color, dashLine);
                          }
                        }
                      }
                      if (menu.getModelActive("health-animation")) {
                        tmpObj.updateHealthAnim();
                      } else {
                        tmpObj.resetHealthAnim();
                      }
                    }
                  } else {
                    const angle = Math.atan2(tmpObj.y - player.y, tmpObj.x - player.x);
                    const distance = Math.hypot(tmpObj.y - player.y, tmpObj.x - player.x);
                    const offset = Math.min(distance - player.scale, player.scale * 4);
                    const arrowX = player.x + offset * Math.cos(angle);
                    const arrowY = player.y + offset * Math.sin(angle);
                    const color = menu.getModelValue("tracers-color-animal");
                    const dashLine = menu.getModelActive("tracers-animals-dashline");
                    const arrowWidth = 8;
                    if (menu.getModelActive("tracers-to-animals")) {
                      if (menu.getModelActive("tracers-animals-use-arrows")) {
                        drawArrow(arrowX, arrowY, arrowWidth, color, angle);
                      } else {
                        drawTracer(tmpObj.x, tmpObj.y, color, dashLine);
                      }
                    }
                    if (menu.getModelActive("animals-health-text")) {
                      const x = tmpObj.x - d;
                      const y = tmpObj.y - f + tmpObj.scale + config.nameY * 2;
                      const text = `${~~tmpObj.health}/${~~tmpObj.maxHealth}`;
                      mainContext.save();
                      mainContext.font = "18px Hammersmith One";
                      mainContext.fillStyle = "#fff";
                      mainContext.textBaseline = "middle";
                      mainContext.textAlign = "center";
                      mainContext.lineWidth = 8;
                      mainContext.lineJoin = "round";
                      mainContext.strokeText(text, x, y);
                      mainContext.fillText(text, x, y);
                      mainContext.restore();
                    }
                    const animalConfig = window.aiTypes[tmpObj.index];
                    if (menu.getModelActive("animals-aggression-zone") && tmpObj.chargePlayer && animalConfig.viewRange) {
                      mainContext.save();
                      mainContext.strokeStyle = menu.getModelValue("animals-aggression-zone-color");
                      mainContext.lineWidth = 6;
                      mainContext.lineCap = "round";
                      mainContext.globalAlpha = 0.6;
                      mainContext.beginPath();
                      mainContext.arc(tmpObj.x - d, tmpObj.y - f, animalConfig.viewRange, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                      mainContext.stroke();
                      mainContext.closePath();
                      mainContext.restore();
                      const angle = Math.atan2(tmpObj.y - player.y, tmpObj.x - player.x);
                      const x = tmpObj.x - d - animalConfig.viewRange * Math.cos(angle);
                      const y = tmpObj.y - f - animalConfig.viewRange * Math.sin(angle);
                      mainContext.save();
                      mainContext.font = "22px Hammersmith One";
                      mainContext.fillStyle = "#fff";
                      mainContext.textBaseline = "middle";
                      mainContext.textAlign = "center";
                      mainContext.lineWidth = 8;
                      mainContext.lineJoin = "round";
                      mainContext.strokeText(tmpObj.name, x, y);
                      mainContext.fillText(tmpObj.name, x, y);
                      mainContext.restore();
                    }
                  }
                  if (tmpObj.health > 0) {
                    function renderBar({
                      width,
                      innerWidth,
                      xOffset,
                      yOffset,
                      color
                    }) {
                      const x = tmpObj.x - d - width + (xOffset || 0);
                      const y = tmpObj.y - f + tmpObj.scale + config.nameY + (yOffset || 0);
                      const height = 17;
                      const radius = 8;
                      mainContext.save();
                      mainContext.fillStyle = darkOutlineColor;
                      mainContext.roundRect(x - config.healthBarPad, y, width * 2 + config.healthBarPad * 2, height, radius);
                      mainContext.fill();
                      mainContext.fillStyle = color;
                      mainContext.roundRect(x, y + config.healthBarPad, width * 2 * innerWidth, height - config.healthBarPad * 2, radius - 1);
                      mainContext.fill();
                      mainContext.restore();
                    }
                    renderBar({
                      width: config.healthBarWidth,
                      innerWidth: tmpObj.health / tmpObj.maxHealth,
                      color: tmpObj.isAlly ? "#8ecc51" : "#cc5151"
                    });
                    if (tmpObj.isPlayer && menu.getModelActive("reload-bars")) {
                      if (menu.getModelActive("reload-bars-primary")) {
                        tmpObj.updatePrimaryReload(items.weapons[tmpObj.weaponIndex]);
                      }
                      if (menu.getModelActive("reload-bars-secondary")) {
                        tmpObj.updateSecondaryReload(items.weapons[tmpObj.weaponIndex]);
                      }
                      const color = tmpObj.isAlly ? menu.getModelValue("reload-bars-color-ally") : menu.getModelValue("reload-bars-color-enemy");
                      if (menu.getModelActive("reload-bars-primary")) {
                        renderBar({
                          width: config.healthBarWidth / 2 - config.healthBarPad / 2,
                          innerWidth: tmpObj.primaryReloadCount || 1,
                          color: color,
                          get xOffset() {
                            return -(this.width + config.healthBarPad) * Number(menu.getModelActive("reload-bars-secondary"));
                          },
                          yOffset: -config.nameY / 2
                        });
                      }
                      if (menu.getModelActive("reload-bars-secondary")) {
                        renderBar({
                          width: config.healthBarWidth / 2 - config.healthBarPad / 2,
                          innerWidth: tmpObj.secondaryReloadCount || 1,
                          color: color,
                          get xOffset() {
                            return (this.width + config.healthBarPad) * Number(menu.getModelActive("reload-bars-primary"));
                          },
                          yOffset: -config.nameY / 2
                        });
                      }
                      if (menu.getModelActive("xp-bar") && tmpObj.sid === player.sid) {
                        renderBar({
                          width: config.healthBarWidth,
                          innerWidth: player.XP / player.maxXP,
                          color: menu.getModelValue("xp-bar-color"),
                          yOffset: 17
                        });
                      }
                    }
                    if (!tmpObj.isPlayer && tmpObj.isAI) {
                      if (tmpObj.index === 6 && menu.getModelActive("moostafa-reload-bar")) {
                        const count = Date.now() - tmpObj.reloadWeaponCount;
                        renderBar({
                          width: config.healthBarWidth,
                          innerWidth: Math.min(count, tmpObj.reloadWeaponMax) / tmpObj.reloadWeaponMax || 1,
                          color: menu.getModelValue("moostafa-reload-bar-color"),
                          yOffset: -config.nameY / 2
                        });
                      }
                    }
                  }
                  let downYOffset = menu.getModelActive("xp-bar") ? 17 : 0;
                  if (tmpObj.isPlayer && menu.getModelActive("player-health-text")) {
                    const x = tmpObj.x - d;
                    const y = tmpObj.y - f + tmpObj.scale + config.nameY * 2 + downYOffset;
                    const text = `${~~tmpObj.health}/${~~tmpObj.maxHealth}`;
                    mainContext.save();
                    mainContext.font = "18px Hammersmith One";
                    mainContext.fillStyle = "#fff";
                    mainContext.textBaseline = "middle";
                    mainContext.textAlign = "center";
                    mainContext.lineWidth = 8;
                    mainContext.lineJoin = "round";
                    mainContext.strokeText(text, x, y);
                    mainContext.fillText(text, x, y);
                    mainContext.restore();
                    downYOffset += config.nameY / 2 + 4;
                  }
                  if (tmpObj.isPlayer && menu.getModelActive("player-coords-text")) {
                    const x = tmpObj.x - d;
                    const y = tmpObj.y - f + tmpObj.scale + config.nameY * 2 + downYOffset;
                    const directionX = menu.getModelActive("player-coords-dir-text") ? player.x1 < player.x2 ? " [+X]" : player.x1 === player.x2 ? " [X]" : " [-X]" : "";
                    const directionY = menu.getModelActive("player-coords-dir-text") ? player.y1 < player.y2 ? " [+Y]" : player.y1 === player.y2 ? " [Y]" : " [-Y]" : "";
                    const text = `x: ${~~player.x}${directionX}, y: ${~~player.y}${directionY}`;
                    mainContext.save();
                    mainContext.font = "18px Hammersmith One";
                    mainContext.fillStyle = "#fff";
                    mainContext.textBaseline = "middle";
                    mainContext.textAlign = "center";
                    mainContext.lineWidth = 8;
                    mainContext.lineJoin = "round";
                    mainContext.strokeText(text, x, y);
                    mainContext.fillText(text, x, y);
                    mainContext.restore();
                    downYOffset += config.nameY / 2 + 4;
                  }
                  if (tmpObj.isPlayer && menu.getModelActive("hack-detector")) {
                    const x = tmpObj.x - d;
                    const y = tmpObj.y - f + tmpObj.scale + config.nameY * 2 + downYOffset;
                    const text = `Hack: ${tmpObj.hackCount || 0}%`;
                    mainContext.save();
                    mainContext.font = "18px Hammersmith One";
                    mainContext.fillStyle = "#fff";
                    mainContext.textBaseline = "middle";
                    mainContext.textAlign = "center";
                    mainContext.lineWidth = 8;
                    mainContext.lineJoin = "round";
                    mainContext.strokeText(text, x, y);
                    mainContext.fillText(text, x, y);
                    mainContext.restore();
                    downYOffset += config.nameY / 2 + 4;
                  }
                }
              }
            }
            lineDashOffset -= 0.5;
            particles.update();
            if (player?.alive && player?.active) {
              if (menu.getModelActive("place-helper")) {
                updateBuildPosition();
                if (buildPositions.active) {
                  buildPositions.forEach(buildPosition => {
                    buildPosition.update();
                  });
                }
                renderFreeBuildPositions();
              }
              if (menu.getModelActive("movement-tail") && !menu.getModelActive("movement-tail-all-players")) {
                const scale = menu.getModelValue("movement-tail-scale");
                for (let i = 0; i < Math.floor(player.moveSpeed); i++) {
                  particles.create("movement-tail", player.x, player.y, Math.random() * scale + 1, player.biomeColor, Math.random() * 2 + 1, 600);
                }
              }
            } // RENDER ANIM TEXTS:
            textManager.update(delta, mainContext, d, f); // RENDER CHAT MESSAGES:
            if (player?.alive && player?.active && menu.getModelActive("pet") && !menu.getModelActive("hide-pets")) {
              pets.forEach(pet => {
                let messageIndex = 1;
                pet.messages.forEach(message => {
                  let chatCountdown = Date.now() - message.createdAt;
                  let alpha = 1;
                  if (chatCountdown <= 0) {
                    chatCountdown = alpha = 0;
                  } else if (menu.getModelActive("smooth-chat")) {
                    if (chatCountdown >= message.deleteDelay - 400) {
                      alpha = 1 - (chatCountdown - (message.deleteDelay - 400)) / 400;
                    } else if (chatCountdown <= 400) {
                      alpha = chatCountdown / 400;
                    }
                  }
                  mainContext.save();
                  mainContext.font = "20px Hammersmith One";
                  mainContext.textBaseline = "middle";
                  mainContext.textAlign = "center";
                  mainContext.globalAlpha = alpha;
                  const textSize = mainContext.measureText(message.content);
                  const tmpH = 27;
                  const tmpW = textSize.width + 17;
                  const tmpX = pet.x - window.xOffset;
                  const tmpY = pet.y - pet.scale - window.yOffset - tmpH * messageIndex - messageIndex * 5;
                  mainContext.fillStyle = message.bgColor;
                  mainContext.roundRect(tmpX - tmpW / 2, tmpY - tmpH / 2, tmpW, tmpH, 6);
                  mainContext.fill();
                  mainContext.fillStyle = "#fff";
                  mainContext.fillText(message.content, tmpX, tmpY);
                  mainContext.restore();
                  messageIndex += 1;
                });
              });
            }
            for (let a = 0; a < players.length; ++a) {
              tmpObj = players[a];
              if (tmpObj.visible && tmpObj.chatCountdown > 0) {
                let alpha = 1;
                tmpObj.chatCountdown -= delta;
                if (tmpObj.chatCountdown <= 0) {
                  tmpObj.chatCountdown = alpha = 0;
                } else if (menu.getModelActive("smooth-chat")) {
                  if (tmpObj.chatCountdown >= 2600) {
                    alpha = 1 - (tmpObj.chatCountdown - 2600) / 400;
                  } else if (tmpObj.chatCountdown <= 400) {
                    alpha = tmpObj.chatCountdown / 400;
                  }
                }
                mainContext.save();
                mainContext.font = "32px Hammersmith One";
                let x = mainContext.measureText(tmpObj.chatMessage);
                mainContext.textBaseline = "middle";
                mainContext.textAlign = "center";
                tmpX = tmpObj.x - d;
                tmpY = tmpObj.y - tmpObj.scale - f - 90;
                let S = x.width + 17;
                mainContext.globalAlpha = alpha;
                mainContext.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.2)";
                mainContext.roundRect(tmpX - S / 2, tmpY - 23.5, S, 47, 6);
                mainContext.fill();
                mainContext.fillStyle = "#fff";
                mainContext.fillText(tmpObj.chatMessage, tmpX, tmpY);
                mainContext.restore();
              }
            }
          } // RENDER MINIMAP:
          renderMinimap(delta);
          if (menu.getModelActive("day-night")) {
            if (!nightStateTime || Date.now() - nightStateTime >= 240000) {
              nightState = !nightState;
              nightStateTime = Date.now();
            }
            nightCount += ((nightState ? 1 : 0) - nightCount) / 160;
            const oldTransform = mainContext.getTransform();
            const color = `rgba(${[24, 0, 82, 0.3].map(item => item * nightCount).join(", ")})`;
            mainContext.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
            mainContext.fillStyle = color;
            gameUI.style.backgroundColor = color;
            mainContext.fillRect(0, 0, gameCanvas.width, gameCanvas.height);
            mainContext.setTransform(oldTransform);
          } else {
            nightStateTime = Date.now();
            gameUI.style.backgroundColor = "none";
          } // RENDER CONTROLS:
          if (controllingTouch.id !== -1) {
            renderControl(controllingTouch.startX, controllingTouch.startY, controllingTouch.currentX, controllingTouch.currentY);
          }
          if (attackingTouch.id !== -1) {
            renderControl(attackingTouch.startX, attackingTouch.startY, attackingTouch.currentX, attackingTouch.currentY);
          }
        } // RENDER CONTROL:
        function renderControl(startX, startY, currentX, currentY) {
          mainContext.save();
          mainContext.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0); // mainContext.resetTransform();
          mainContext.scale(pixelDensity, pixelDensity);
          var controlRadius = 50;
          mainContext.beginPath();
          mainContext.arc(startX, startY, controlRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2, false);
          mainContext.closePath();
          mainContext.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)";
          mainContext.fill();
          var controlRadius = 50;
          var offsetX = currentX - startX;
          var offsetY = currentY - startY;
          var mag = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(offsetX, 2) + Math.pow(offsetY, 2));
          var divisor = mag > controlRadius ? mag / controlRadius : 1;
          offsetX /= divisor;
          offsetY /= divisor;
          mainContext.beginPath();
          mainContext.arc(startX + offsetX, startY + offsetY, controlRadius * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2, false);
          mainContext.closePath();
          mainContext.fillStyle = "white";
          mainContext.fill();
          mainContext.restore();
        } // RENDER PROJECTILES:
        function renderProjectiles(layer, xOffset, yOffset) {
          for (var i = 0; i < projectiles.length; ++i) {
            tmpObj = projectiles[i];
            if (tmpObj.active && tmpObj.layer == layer) {
              tmpObj.update(delta);
              if (tmpObj.active && isOnScreen(tmpObj.x - xOffset, tmpObj.y - yOffset, tmpObj.scale)) {
                mainContext.save();
                mainContext.translate(tmpObj.x - xOffset, tmpObj.y - yOffset);
                mainContext.rotate(tmpObj.dir);
                renderProjectile(0, 0, tmpObj, mainContext, 1);
                mainContext.restore();
              }
            }
          }
        } // RENDER PROJECTILE:
        var projectileSprites = {};
        function renderProjectile(x, y, obj, ctxt, debug) {
          if (obj.src) {
            var tmpSrc = items.projectiles[obj.indx].src;
            var tmpSprite = projectileSprites[tmpSrc];
            if (!tmpSprite) {
              tmpSprite = new Image();
              tmpSprite.onload = function () {
                this.isLoaded = true;
              };
              tmpSprite.src = "./img/weapons/" + tmpSrc + ".png";
              projectileSprites[tmpSrc] = tmpSprite;
            }
            if (tmpSprite.isLoaded) {
              ctxt.drawImage(tmpSprite, x - obj.scale / 2, y - obj.scale / 2, obj.scale, obj.scale);
            }
          } else if (obj.indx == 1) {
            ctxt.fillStyle = "#939393";
            renderCircle(x, y, obj.scale, ctxt);
          }
        } // RENDER WATER BODIES:
        function renderWaterBodies(xOffset, yOffset, ctxt, padding) {
          // MIDDLE RIVER:
          var tmpW = config.riverWidth + padding;
          var tmpY = config.mapScale / 2 - yOffset - tmpW / 2;
          if (tmpY < maxScreenHeight && tmpY + tmpW > 0) {
            ctxt.fillRect(0, tmpY, maxScreenWidth, tmpW);
          }
        } // RENDER GAME OBJECTS:
        const minimapResources = new Map();
        function renderGameObjects(layer, xOffset, yOffset) {
          if (layer === 0 && !menu.getModelActive("hide-pets")) {
            if (player?.alive && player?.active) {
              const petsAmount = parseInt(menu.getModelValue("pet-amount"));
              pets.forEach(pet => {
                pet.isActive = false;
              });
              for (let i = 0; i < petsAmount; i++) {
                const pet = pets.get(i);
                pet.isActive = true;
              }
              pets.forEach((pet, i) => {
                if (!menu.getModelActive("pet") || !pet.isActive) {
                  const gameObjects1 = gameObjects.filter(gameObject => !gameObject.isItem);
                  pet.isFollowOwner = false;
                  if (gameObjects1.length >= 20) {
                    if (!pet.rndGameObject) {
                      pet.rndGameObject = gameObjects1[window.randInt(0, gameObjects1.length - 1)];
                      pet.rndGameObject.watchAngle = Math.atan2(pet.rndGameObject.y - pet.y, pet.rndGameObject.x - pet.x);
                    }
                  } else {
                    pet.rndGameObject = null;
                    pet.noFollowOwner = true;
                  }
                  if (pet.rndGameObject) {
                    const distance = Math.hypot(pet.rndGameObject.y - pet.y, pet.rndGameObject.x - pet.x) - (pet.rndGameObject.getScale() || pet.rndGameObject.scale);
                    const attackX = pet.rndGameObject.x + (pet.rndGameObject.scale + pet.scale / 2) * Math.cos(pet.rndGameObject.watchAngle);
                    const attackY = pet.rndGameObject.y + (pet.rndGameObject.scale + pet.scale / 2) * Math.sin(pet.rndGameObject.watchAngle);
                    if (distance <= pet.scale + 30) {
                      pet.startAttackAnimation(attackX, attackY, 0);
                      pet.infinityAttack = true;
                    } else {
                      const followObject = new Vector(pet.rndGameObject.x + pet.rndGameObject.scale / 2, pet.rndGameObject.y + pet.rndGameObject.scale / 2);
                      pet.forceSpeed = 0.85;
                      pet.velocity.add(pet.forceSpeed * Math.cos(pet.angleTo(followObject)), pet.forceSpeed * Math.sin(pet.angleTo(followObject)));
                    }
                    pet.dir = pet.rndGameObject.watchAngle;
                  }
                  pet.messages = new Map();
                } else {
                  pet.forceSpeed = null;
                  pet.rndGameObject = null;
                  pet.infinityAttack = false;
                  pet.noFollowOwner = false;
                }
                pet.update();
              });
            }
          }
          for (let n, s, o, a = 0; a < gameObjects.length; ++a) {
            tmpObj = gameObjects[a];
            if (!tmpObj.active) {
              continue;
            }
            s = tmpObj.x + tmpObj.xWiggle - xOffset;
            o = tmpObj.y + tmpObj.yWiggle - yOffset;
            if (layer == 0) {
              tmpObj.update(delta);
            }
            if (tmpObj.layer == layer && isOnScreen(s, o, tmpObj.scale + (tmpObj.blocker || 0))) {
              const defaultAlpha = tmpObj.hideFromEnemy ? 0.6 : 1;
              mainContext.globalAlpha = menu.getModelActive("destroy-animation") && tmpObj.isDestroying ? 1 - tmpObj.getDestroyAlpha() : defaultAlpha;
              if (player) {
                const distance = Math.hypot(tmpObj.y - player.y, tmpObj.x - player.x);
                const maxDistance = parseInt(menu.getModelValue("building-drawing-target-radius")) * 150;
                if (menu.getModelActive("building-drawing-attenuation")) {
                  const alpha = (distance - (tmpObj.scale || tmpObj.getScale()) + config.collisionDepth) / maxDistance;
                  mainContext.globalAlpha = Math.max(parseFloat(mainContext.globalAlpha) - Math.min(alpha, 1), 0);
                } else if (distance > maxDistance) {
                  continue;
                }
              }
              if (tmpObj.isItem) {
                n = getItemSprite(tmpObj);
                if (tmpObj.name === "turret") {
                  if (menu.getModelActive("turret-range-indicator")) {
                    const turretRange = 700;
                    const range = turretRange + tmpObj.scale * 0.65;
                    const color = isClanMember(tmpObj.owner.sid) ? "#7ad025" : "#cc5151";
                    mainContext.save();
                    mainContext.strokeStyle = color;
                    mainContext.lineWidth = 2;
                    mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                    mainContext.lineCap = "round";
                    mainContext.beginPath();
                    mainContext.moveTo(s, o);
                    mainContext.lineTo(s + range * Math.cos(tmpObj.dir), o + range * Math.sin(tmpObj.dir));
                    mainContext.stroke();
                    mainContext.beginPath();
                    mainContext.arc(s + range * Math.cos(tmpObj.dir), o + range * Math.sin(tmpObj.dir), tmpObj.scale / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    mainContext.closePath();
                    mainContext.stroke();
                    mainContext.restore();
                  }
                }
                mainContext.save();
                mainContext.translate(s, o);
                mainContext.rotate(tmpObj.dir);
                mainContext.drawImage(n, -n.width / 2, -n.height / 2);
                if (tmpObj.blocker) {
                  mainContext.strokeStyle = "#db6e6e";
                  mainContext.globalAlpha = 0.3;
                  mainContext.lineWidth = 6;
                  renderCircle(0, 0, tmpObj.blocker, mainContext, false, true);
                }
                mainContext.restore();
                if (menu.getModelActive("building-mark") && player?.alive) {
                  const distance = Math.hypot(tmpObj.y - player.y, tmpObj.x - player.x);
                  if (distance <= parseInt(menu.getModelValue("building-mark-target-radius")) * 150) {
                    const color = isClanMember(tmpObj.owner.sid) ? menu.getModelValue("building-mark-color-ally") : menu.getModelValue("building-mark-color-enemy");
                    const scale = tmpObj.scale * 0.65 / 2;
                    mainContext.save();
                    mainContext.fillStyle = color;
                    mainContext.translate(s, o);
                    mainContext.beginPath();
                    mainContext.arc(0, 0, scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    mainContext.fill();
                    mainContext.restore();
                  }
                }
                if (tmpObj.name === "turret") {
                  if (menu.getModelActive("turret-reload-bar")) {
                    mainContext.shootCooldown ??= 2200;
                    const width = config.healthBarWidth / 2;
                    const yOffset = config.nameY / 1.5;
                    let shootReload = (Date.now() - tmpObj.shootTime) / tmpObj.shootCooldown;
                    if (!tmpObj.shootTime || Date.now() - tmpObj.shootTime >= tmpObj.shootCooldown) {
                      shootReload = 1;
                    }
                    mainContext.save();
                    mainContext.fillStyle = darkOutlineColor;
                    mainContext.roundRect(s - width - config.healthBarPad, o + tmpObj.scale + yOffset, width * 2 + config.healthBarPad * 2, 17, 8);
                    mainContext.fill();
                    mainContext.fillStyle = menu.getModelValue("turret-reload-bar-color");
                    mainContext.roundRect(s - width, o + tmpObj.scale + yOffset + config.healthBarPad, width * 2 * shootReload, 17 - config.healthBarPad * 2, 7);
                    mainContext.fill();
                    mainContext.restore();
                  }
                }
                if (!tmpObj.isDestroying) {
                  for (const player1 of players) {
                    if (!player1.alive || !player1.active) {
                      continue;
                    }
                    const angle = Math.atan2(tmpObj.y - player1.y, tmpObj.x - player1.x);
                    const distance = Math.hypot(tmpObj.y - player1.y, tmpObj.x - player1.x);
                    if ([9, 11, 12, 13, 15].includes(player1.weaponIndex)) {
                      continue;
                    }
                    const targetRange = items.weapons[player1.weaponIndex].range * parseInt(menu.getModelValue("building-health-bar-range"));
                    if (distance > targetRange) {
                      continue;
                    }
                    if (menu.getModelActive("building-health-bar-use-angle-view")) {
                      if (getAngleDist(angle, player1.dir) > gatherAngle) {
                        continue;
                      }
                    }
                    if (menu.getModelActive("building-health-bar")) {
                      if (menu.getModelActive("building-health-bar-use-round")) {
                        const endAngle = player1.health / player1.maxHealth * 360 * (Math.PI / 180);
                        const width = 14;
                        const scale = 22;
                        mainContext.save();
                        mainContext.strokeStyle = darkOutlineColor;
                        mainContext.lineWidth = width;
                        mainContext.lineCap = "round";
                        mainContext.translate(s, o);
                        mainContext.rotate(tmpObj.dir);
                        mainContext.beginPath();
                        mainContext.arc(0, 0, scale, 0, endAngle);
                        mainContext.stroke();
                        mainContext.restore();
                        mainContext.save();
                        mainContext.strokeStyle = isClanMember(tmpObj.owner.sid) ? "#8ecc51" : "#cc5151";
                        mainContext.lineWidth = width / 2.5;
                        mainContext.lineCap = "round";
                        mainContext.translate(s, o);
                        mainContext.rotate(tmpObj.dir);
                        mainContext.beginPath();
                        mainContext.arc(0, 0, scale, 0, endAngle);
                        mainContext.stroke();
                        mainContext.restore();
                      } else {
                        const width = config.healthBarWidth / 2 - config.healthBarPad / 2;
                        const height = 17;
                        const radius = 8;
                        const color = isClanMember(tmpObj.owner.sid) ? "#8ecc51" : "#cc5151";
                        mainContext.save();
                        mainContext.fillStyle = darkOutlineColor;
                        mainContext.roundRect(s - width - config.healthBarPad, o - height / 2, width * 2 + config.healthBarPad * 2, height, radius);
                        mainContext.fill();
                        mainContext.fillStyle = color;
                        mainContext.roundRect(s - width, o - height / 2 + config.healthBarPad, width * 2 * (tmpObj.health / tmpObj.maxHealth), height - config.healthBarPad * 2, radius - 1);
                        mainContext.fill();
                        mainContext.restore();
                      }
                    }
                    if (menu.getModelActive("buildings-health-text") && tmpObj.maxHealth) {
                      mainContext.save();
                      mainContext.font = "18px Hammersmith One";
                      mainContext.fillStyle = "#fff";
                      mainContext.textBaseline = "middle";
                      mainContext.textAlign = "center";
                      mainContext.lineWidth = 8;
                      mainContext.lineJoin = "round";
                      mainContext.strokeText(`${~~tmpObj.health}/${~~tmpObj.maxHealth}`, s, o);
                      mainContext.fillText(`${~~tmpObj.health}/${~~tmpObj.maxHealth}`, s, o);
                      mainContext.restore();
                    }
                  }
                }
              } else {
                n = getResSprite(tmpObj);
                if (player?.alive && player?.active) {
                  if (!minimapResources.has(tmpObj.sid)) {
                    minimapResources.set(tmpObj.sid, {
                      target: tmpObj,
                      render(context, xOffset, yOffset) {
                        const biomeID = this.target.y >= config.mapScale - config.snowBiomeTop ? 2 : this.target.y <= config.snowBiomeTop ? 1 : 0;
                        function getPosition(position) {
                          return position / config.mapScale * ((mapDisplay.width + mapDisplay.height) / 2);
                        }
                        function randomInt(min, max) {
                          return Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min + 1)) + min;
                        }
                        context.save();
                        context.translate(getPosition(this.target.x), getPosition(this.target.y));
                        context.strokeStyle = "#525252";
                        context.lineWidth = 1;
                        switch (this.target.type) {
                          case 0:
                            {
                              const color = biomeID ? yOffset ? "#fff" : "#e3f1f4" : yOffset ? "#b4db62" : "#9ebf57";
                              for (let i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
                                const scale = 5.85;
                                renderStar(context, 7, scale, scale * 0.7); // render star
                                context.fillStyle = color;
                                context.fill();
                                if (!i) {
                                  context.stroke();
                                }
                              }
                            }
                            break;
                          case 1:
                            {
                              const scale = 8.25;
                              if (biomeID === 2) {
                                context.fillStyle = "#606060";
                                renderStar(context, 6, scale * 0.3, scale * 0.71);
                                context.fill();
                                context.stroke();
                                context.fillStyle = "#89a54c";
                                renderCircle(0, 0, scale * 0.55, context);
                                context.fillStyle = "#a5c65b";
                                renderCircle(0, 0, scale * 0.3, context, true);
                              } else {
                                const spikes = 6;
                                const blobSteps = Math.PI / spikes;
                                let blobRotate = Math.PI / 2 * 3;
                                let blobOuter = 0;
                                context.beginPath();
                                context.moveTo(0, -(scale * 0.7));
                                for (let i = 0; i < spikes; i++) {
                                  blobOuter = (scale + 0.9 + scale * 1.2) / 4;
                                  context.quadraticCurveTo(Math.cos(blobRotate + blobSteps) * blobOuter, Math.sin(blobRotate + blobSteps) * blobOuter, Math.cos(blobRotate + blobSteps * 2) * 0.7 * scale, Math.sin(blobRotate + blobSteps * 2) * 0.7 * scale);
                                  blobRotate += blobSteps * 2;
                                }
                                context.lineTo(0, -(scale * 0.7));
                                context.closePath();
                                context.fillStyle = biomeID ? "#e3f1f4" : "#89a54c";
                                context.fill();
                                context.stroke();
                                context.fillStyle = biomeID ? "#6a64af" : "#c15555";
                                const rotateValue = mathPI2 / 4;
                                for (let i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                                  const range = (scale / 3 + scale / 2.3) / 2;
                                  renderCircle(range * Math.cos(rotateValue * i), range * Math.sin(rotateValue * i), scale / range, context);
                                }
                              }
                            }
                            break;
                          case 2:
                          case 3:
                            {
                              const scale = 5.5;
                              const color1 = this.target.type == 2 ? biomeID == 2 ? "#938d77" : "#939393" : "#e0c655";
                              const color2 = this.target.type == 2 ? biomeID == 2 ? "#b2ab90" : "#bcbcbc" : "#ebdca3";
                              context.fillStyle = color1;
                              renderStar(context, 3, scale, scale);
                              context.fill();
                              context.stroke();
                              context.fillStyle = color2;
                              renderStar(context, 3, scale * 0.55, scale * 0.65);
                              context.fill();
                            }
                            break;
                        }
                        context.restore();
                      }
                    });
                  }
                }
                mainContext.drawImage(n, s - n.width / 2, o - n.height / 2);
              }
            }
          }
        } // GATHER ANIMATION:
        function gatherAnimation(sid, didHit, index) {
          tmpObj = findPlayerBySID(sid);
          if (tmpObj) {
            tmpObj.startAnim(didHit, index);
          }
        } // RENDER PLAYERS:
        function renderPlayers(xOffset, yOffset, zIndex) {
          mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
          for (let n = 0; n < players.length; ++n) {
            tmpObj = players[n];
            if (tmpObj.zIndex === zIndex) {
              tmpObj.animate(delta);
            }
            if (!tmpObj.visible) {
              continue;
            }
            tmpObj.skinRot += delta * 0.002;
            tmpDir = (tmpObj == player ? getAttackDir() : tmpObj.dir) + tmpObj.dirPlus;
            mainContext.save();
            mainContext.translate(tmpObj.x - xOffset, tmpObj.y - yOffset);
            mainContext.rotate(tmpDir);
            renderPlayer(tmpObj, mainContext);
            mainContext.restore();
            const shameHat = menu.getModelActive("shame-indicators") && menu.getModelActive("shame-hat");
            if (shameHat && skinSprites.shameImg.isLoaded && player.alive && player.active) {
              const shameCountAlpha = tmpObj.shameCount / 8;
              mainContext.save();
              mainContext.globalAlpha = shameCountAlpha;
              mainContext.translate(tmpObj.x - xOffset, tmpObj.y - yOffset);
              mainContext.rotate(tmpDir + Math.PI / 2);
              mainContext.drawImage(skinSprites.shameImg, -skinSprites.shameImg.scale / 2, -skinSprites.shameImg.scale / 2, skinSprites.shameImg.scale, skinSprites.shameImg.scale);
              mainContext.restore();
            }
          }
        } // RENDER PLAYER:
        function renderPlayer(obj, ctxt) {
          ctxt = ctxt || mainContext;
          ctxt.lineWidth = outlineWidth;
          ctxt.lineJoin = "miter";
          var handAngle = Math.PI / 4 * (items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].armS || 1);
          var oHandAngle = obj.buildIndex < 0 ? items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].hndS || 1 : 1;
          var oHandDist = obj.buildIndex < 0 ? items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].hndD || 1 : 1; // TAIL/CAPE:
          if (obj.tailIndex > 0) {
            renderTail(obj.tailIndex, ctxt, obj);
          } // WEAPON BELLOW HANDS:
          (function () {
            if (menu.getModelActive("weapon-indicators") && obj.buildIndex < 0) {
              const color = obj.isAlly ? menu.getModelValue("weapon-indicators-color-ally") : menu.getModelValue("weapon-indicators-color-enemy");
              if (![9, 12, 13, 15].includes(obj.weaponIndex)) {
                if (menu.getModelActive("weapon-melee-indicator")) {
                  const range = items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].range;
                  ctxt.save();
                  ctxt.fillStyle = color;
                  ctxt.strokeStyle = color;
                  ctxt.globalAlpha = 0.3;
                  ctxt.lineWidth = 4;
                  ctxt.beginPath();
                  ctxt.arc(0, 0, range + 30, 0 - tmpDir + tmpObj.dir - Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2 - tmpDir + tmpObj.dir);
                  ctxt.fill();
                  ctxt.globalAlpha = 0.7;
                  ctxt.stroke();
                  ctxt.closePath();
                  ctxt.restore();
                }
              } else if (menu.getModelActive("weapon-longrange-indicator")) {
                const weapon = items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex];
                const range = items.projectiles[weapon.projectile].range;
                const startX = Math.cos(tmpObj.dir - tmpDir) * 40;
                const startY = Math.sin(tmpObj.dir - tmpDir) * 40;
                const endX = range * Math.cos(tmpObj.dir - tmpDir);
                const endY = range * Math.sin(tmpObj.dir - tmpDir);
                ctxt.save();
                ctxt.strokeStyle = color;
                ctxt.lineWidth = 4;
                ctxt.lineCap = "round";
                ctxt.beginPath();
                ctxt.moveTo(startX, startY);
                ctxt.lineTo(endX, endY);
                ctxt.stroke();
                ctxt.restore();
              }
              ctxt.globalAlpha = 1;
            }
          })();
          if (obj.buildIndex < 0 && !items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].aboveHand) {
            renderTool(items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex], config.weaponVariants[obj.weaponVariant].src, obj.scale, 0, ctxt);
            if (items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].projectile != undefined && !items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].hideProjectile) {
              renderProjectile(obj.scale, 0, items.projectiles[items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].projectile], mainContext);
            }
          } // HANDS:
          ctxt.fillStyle = config.skinColors[obj.skinColor];
          renderCircle(obj.scale * Math.cos(handAngle), obj.scale * Math.sin(handAngle), 14);
          renderCircle(obj.scale * oHandDist * Math.cos(-handAngle * oHandAngle), obj.scale * oHandDist * Math.sin(-handAngle * oHandAngle), 14); // WEAPON ABOVE HANDS:
          if (obj.buildIndex < 0 && items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].aboveHand) {
            renderTool(items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex], config.weaponVariants[obj.weaponVariant].src, obj.scale, 0, ctxt);
            if (items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].projectile != undefined && !items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].hideProjectile) {
              renderProjectile(obj.scale, 0, items.projectiles[items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].projectile], mainContext);
            }
          } // BUILD ITEM:
          if (obj.buildIndex >= 0) {
            var tmpSprite = getItemSprite(items.list[obj.buildIndex]);
            ctxt.drawImage(tmpSprite, obj.scale - items.list[obj.buildIndex].holdOffset, -tmpSprite.width / 2);
          } // BODY:
          renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, ctxt); // SKIN:
          if (obj.skinIndex > 0) {
            ctxt.rotate(Math.PI / 2);
            renderSkin(obj.skinIndex, ctxt, null, obj);
          }
        } // RENDER SKINS:
        var skinSprites = {};
        var skinPointers = {};
        var tmpSkin;
        function renderSkin(index, ctxt, parentSkin, owner) {
          tmpSkin = skinSprites[index];
          if (!tmpSkin) {
            var tmpImage = new Image();
            tmpImage.onload = function () {
              this.isLoaded = true;
              this.onload = null;
            };
            tmpImage.src = ".././img/hats/hat_" + index + ".png";
            skinSprites[index] = tmpImage;
            tmpSkin = tmpImage;
          }
          var tmpObj = parentSkin || skinPointers[index];
          if (!tmpObj) {
            for (var i = 0; i < hats.length; ++i) {
              if (hats[i].id == index) {
                tmpObj = hats[i];
                break;
              }
            }
            skinPointers[index] = tmpObj;
          }
          if (tmpSkin.isLoaded) {
            ctxt.drawImage(tmpSkin, -tmpObj.scale / 2, -tmpObj.scale / 2, tmpObj.scale, tmpObj.scale);
          }
          if (!parentSkin && tmpObj.topSprite) {
            ctxt.save();
            ctxt.rotate(owner.skinRot);
            renderSkin(index + "_top", ctxt, tmpObj, owner);
            ctxt.restore();
          }
        } // RENDER TAIL:
        var accessSprites = {};
        var accessPointers = {};
        function renderTail(index, ctxt, owner) {
          tmpSkin = accessSprites[index];
          if (!tmpSkin) {
            var tmpImage = new Image();
            tmpImage.onload = function () {
              this.isLoaded = true;
              this.onload = null;
            };
            tmpImage.src = ".././img/accessories/access_" + index + ".png";
            accessSprites[index] = tmpImage;
            tmpSkin = tmpImage;
          }
          var tmpObj = accessPointers[index];
          if (!tmpObj) {
            for (var i = 0; i < accessories.length; ++i) {
              if (accessories[i].id == index) {
                tmpObj = accessories[i];
                break;
              }
            }
            accessPointers[index] = tmpObj;
          }
          if (tmpSkin.isLoaded) {
            ctxt.save();
            ctxt.translate(-20 - (tmpObj.xOff || 0), 0);
            if (tmpObj.spin) {
              ctxt.rotate(owner.skinRot);
            }
            ctxt.drawImage(tmpSkin, -(tmpObj.scale / 2), -(tmpObj.scale / 2), tmpObj.scale, tmpObj.scale);
            ctxt.restore();
          }
        } // RENDER TOOL:
        var toolSprites = {};
        function renderTool(obj, variant, x, y, ctxt) {
          var tmpSrc = obj.src + (variant || "");
          var tmpSprite = toolSprites[tmpSrc];
          if (!tmpSprite) {
            tmpSprite = new Image();
            tmpSprite.onload = function () {
              this.isLoaded = true;
            };
            tmpSprite.src = ".././img/weapons/" + tmpSrc + ".png";
            toolSprites[tmpSrc] = tmpSprite;
          }
          if (tmpSprite.isLoaded) {
            ctxt.drawImage(tmpSprite, x + obj.xOff - obj.length / 2, y + obj.yOff - obj.width / 2, obj.length, obj.width);
          }
        } // RENDER GAME OBJECTS:
        var gameObjectSprites = {};
        function getResSprite(obj) {
          var biomeID = obj.y >= config.mapScale - config.snowBiomeTop ? 2 : obj.y <= config.snowBiomeTop ? 1 : 0; // biomeID
          var tmpIndex = obj.type + "_" + obj.scale + "_" + biomeID;
          var tmpSprite = gameObjectSprites[tmpIndex];
          if (!tmpSprite) {
            var tmpCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
            tmpCanvas.width = tmpCanvas.height = obj.scale * 2.1 + outlineWidth;
            var tmpContext = tmpCanvas.getContext("2d");
            tmpContext.translate(tmpCanvas.width / 2, tmpCanvas.height / 2);
            tmpContext.rotate(UTILS.randFloat(0, Math.PI));
            tmpContext.strokeStyle = outlineColor;
            tmpContext.lineWidth = outlineWidth;
            if (obj.type == 0) {
              var tmpScale;
              for (var i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
                tmpScale = tmpObj.scale * (!i ? 1 : 0.5);
                renderStar(tmpContext, 7, tmpScale, tmpScale * 0.7);
                tmpContext.fillStyle = !biomeID ? !i ? "#9ebf57" : "#b4db62" : !i ? "#e3f1f4" : "#fff";
                tmpContext.fill();
                if (!i) {
                  tmpContext.stroke();
                }
              }
            } else if (obj.type == 1) {
              if (biomeID == 2) {
                tmpContext.fillStyle = "#606060";
                renderStar(tmpContext, 6, obj.scale * 0.3, obj.scale * 0.71);
                tmpContext.fill();
                tmpContext.stroke();
                tmpContext.fillStyle = "#89a54c";
                renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.55, tmpContext);
                tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a5c65b";
                renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.3, tmpContext, true);
              } else {
                renderBlob(tmpContext, 6, tmpObj.scale, tmpObj.scale * 0.7);
                tmpContext.fillStyle = biomeID ? "#e3f1f4" : "#89a54c";
                tmpContext.fill();
                tmpContext.stroke();
                tmpContext.fillStyle = biomeID ? "#6a64af" : "#c15555";
                var tmpRange;
                var berries = 4;
                var rotVal = mathPI2 / berries;
                for (var i = 0; i < berries; ++i) {
                  tmpRange = UTILS.randInt(tmpObj.scale / 3.5, tmpObj.scale / 2.3);
                  renderCircle(tmpRange * Math.cos(rotVal * i), tmpRange * Math.sin(rotVal * i), UTILS.randInt(10, 12), tmpContext);
                }
              }
            } else if (obj.type == 2 || obj.type == 3) {
              tmpContext.fillStyle = obj.type == 2 ? biomeID == 2 ? "#938d77" : "#939393" : "#e0c655";
              renderStar(tmpContext, 3, obj.scale, obj.scale);
              tmpContext.fill();
              tmpContext.stroke();
              tmpContext.fillStyle = obj.type == 2 ? biomeID == 2 ? "#b2ab90" : "#bcbcbc" : "#ebdca3";
              renderStar(tmpContext, 3, obj.scale * 0.55, obj.scale * 0.65);
              tmpContext.fill();
            }
            tmpSprite = tmpCanvas;
            gameObjectSprites[tmpIndex] = tmpSprite;
          }
          return tmpSprite;
        } // GET ITEM SPRITE:
        var itemSprites = [];
        function getItemSprite(obj, asIcon) {
          var tmpSprite = itemSprites[obj.id];
          if (!tmpSprite || asIcon) {
            var tmpCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
            tmpCanvas.width = tmpCanvas.height = obj.scale * 2.5 + outlineWidth + (items.list[obj.id].spritePadding || 0);
            var tmpContext = tmpCanvas.getContext("2d");
            tmpContext.translate(tmpCanvas.width / 2, tmpCanvas.height / 2);
            tmpContext.rotate(asIcon ? 0 : Math.PI / 2);
            tmpContext.strokeStyle = outlineColor;
            tmpContext.lineWidth = outlineWidth * (asIcon ? tmpCanvas.width / 81 : 1);
            if (obj.name == "apple") {
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#c15555";
              renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, tmpContext);
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#89a54c";
              var leafDir = -(Math.PI / 2);
              renderLeaf(obj.scale * Math.cos(leafDir), obj.scale * Math.sin(leafDir), 25, leafDir + Math.PI / 2, tmpContext);
            } else if (obj.name == "cookie") {
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#cca861";
              renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, tmpContext);
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#937c4b";
              var chips = 4;
              var rotVal = mathPI2 / chips;
              var tmpRange;
              for (var i = 0; i < chips; ++i) {
                tmpRange = UTILS.randInt(obj.scale / 2.5, obj.scale / 1.7);
                renderCircle(tmpRange * Math.cos(rotVal * i), tmpRange * Math.sin(rotVal * i), UTILS.randInt(4, 5), tmpContext, true);
              }
            } else if (obj.name == "cheese") {
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#f4f3ac";
              renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, tmpContext);
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#c3c28b";
              var chips = 4;
              var rotVal = mathPI2 / chips;
              var tmpRange;
              for (var i = 0; i < chips; ++i) {
                tmpRange = UTILS.randInt(obj.scale / 2.5, obj.scale / 1.7);
                renderCircle(tmpRange * Math.cos(rotVal * i), tmpRange * Math.sin(rotVal * i), UTILS.randInt(4, 5), tmpContext, true);
              }
            } else if (obj.name == "wood wall" || obj.name == "stone wall" || obj.name == "castle wall") {
              tmpContext.fillStyle = obj.name == "castle wall" ? "#83898e" : obj.name == "wood wall" ? "#a5974c" : "#939393";
              var sides = obj.name == "castle wall" ? 4 : 3;
              renderStar(tmpContext, sides, obj.scale * 1.1, obj.scale * 1.1);
              tmpContext.fill();
              tmpContext.stroke();
              tmpContext.fillStyle = obj.name == "castle wall" ? "#9da4aa" : obj.name == "wood wall" ? "#c9b758" : "#bcbcbc";
              renderStar(tmpContext, sides, obj.scale * 0.65, obj.scale * 0.65);
              tmpContext.fill();
            } else if (obj.name == "spikes" || obj.name == "greater spikes" || obj.name == "poison spikes" || obj.name == "spinning spikes") {
              tmpContext.fillStyle = obj.name == "poison spikes" ? "#7b935d" : "#939393";
              var tmpScale = obj.scale * 0.6;
              renderStar(tmpContext, obj.name == "spikes" ? 5 : 6, obj.scale, tmpScale);
              tmpContext.fill();
              tmpContext.stroke();
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a5974c";
              renderCircle(0, 0, tmpScale, tmpContext);
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#c9b758";
              renderCircle(0, 0, tmpScale / 2, tmpContext, true);
            } else if (obj.name == "windmill" || obj.name == "faster windmill" || obj.name == "power mill") {
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a5974c";
              renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, tmpContext);
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#c9b758";
              renderRectCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 1.5, 29, 4, tmpContext);
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a5974c";
              renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.5, tmpContext);
            } else if (obj.name == "mine") {
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#939393";
              renderStar(tmpContext, 3, obj.scale, obj.scale);
              tmpContext.fill();
              tmpContext.stroke();
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#bcbcbc";
              renderStar(tmpContext, 3, obj.scale * 0.55, obj.scale * 0.65);
              tmpContext.fill();
            } else if (obj.name == "sapling") {
              for (var i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
                var tmpScale = obj.scale * (!i ? 1 : 0.5);
                renderStar(tmpContext, 7, tmpScale, tmpScale * 0.7);
                tmpContext.fillStyle = !i ? "#9ebf57" : "#b4db62";
                tmpContext.fill();
                if (!i) {
                  tmpContext.stroke();
                }
              }
            } else if (obj.name == "pit trap") {
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a5974c";
              renderStar(tmpContext, 3, obj.scale * 1.1, obj.scale * 1.1);
              tmpContext.fill();
              tmpContext.stroke();
              tmpContext.fillStyle = outlineColor;
              renderStar(tmpContext, 3, obj.scale * 0.65, obj.scale * 0.65);
              tmpContext.fill();
            } else if (obj.name == "boost pad") {
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#7e7f82";
              renderRect(0, 0, obj.scale * 2, obj.scale * 2, tmpContext);
              tmpContext.fill();
              tmpContext.stroke();
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#dbd97d";
              renderTriangle(obj.scale * 1, tmpContext);
            } else if (obj.name == "turret") {
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a5974c";
              renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, tmpContext);
              tmpContext.fill();
              tmpContext.stroke();
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#939393";
              var tmpLen = 50;
              renderRect(0, -tmpLen / 2, obj.scale * 0.9, tmpLen, tmpContext);
              renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.6, tmpContext);
              tmpContext.fill();
              tmpContext.stroke();
            } else if (obj.name == "platform") {
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#cebd5f";
              var tmpCount = 4;
              var tmpS = obj.scale * 2;
              var tmpW = tmpS / tmpCount;
              var tmpX = -(obj.scale / 2);
              for (var i = 0; i < tmpCount; ++i) {
                renderRect(tmpX - tmpW / 2, 0, tmpW, obj.scale * 2, tmpContext);
                tmpContext.fill();
                tmpContext.stroke();
                tmpX += tmpS / tmpCount;
              }
            } else if (obj.name == "healing pad") {
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#7e7f82";
              renderRect(0, 0, obj.scale * 2, obj.scale * 2, tmpContext);
              tmpContext.fill();
              tmpContext.stroke();
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#db6e6e";
              renderRectCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.65, 20, 4, tmpContext, true);
            } else if (obj.name == "spawn pad") {
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#7e7f82";
              renderRect(0, 0, obj.scale * 2, obj.scale * 2, tmpContext);
              tmpContext.fill();
              tmpContext.stroke();
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#71aad6";
              renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.6, tmpContext);
            } else if (obj.name == "blocker") {
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#7e7f82";
              renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, tmpContext);
              tmpContext.fill();
              tmpContext.stroke();
              tmpContext.rotate(Math.PI / 4);
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#db6e6e";
              renderRectCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.65, 20, 4, tmpContext, true);
            } else if (obj.name == "teleporter") {
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#7e7f82";
              renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, tmpContext);
              tmpContext.fill();
              tmpContext.stroke();
              tmpContext.rotate(Math.PI / 4);
              tmpContext.fillStyle = "#d76edb";
              renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.5, tmpContext, true);
            }
            tmpSprite = tmpCanvas;
            if (!asIcon) {
              itemSprites[obj.id] = tmpSprite;
            }
          }
          return tmpSprite;
        } // RENDER LEAF:
        function renderLeaf(x, y, l, r, ctxt) {
          var endX = x + l * Math.cos(r);
          var endY = y + l * Math.sin(r);
          var width = l * 0.4;
          ctxt.moveTo(x, y);
          ctxt.beginPath();
          ctxt.quadraticCurveTo((x + endX) / 2 + width * Math.cos(r + Math.PI / 2), (y + endY) / 2 + width * Math.sin(r + Math.PI / 2), endX, endY);
          ctxt.quadraticCurveTo((x + endX) / 2 - width * Math.cos(r + Math.PI / 2), (y + endY) / 2 - width * Math.sin(r + Math.PI / 2), x, y);
          ctxt.closePath();
          ctxt.fill();
          ctxt.stroke();
        } // RENDER CIRCLE:
        function renderCircle(x, y, scale, tmpContext, dontStroke, dontFill) {
          tmpContext = tmpContext || mainContext;
          tmpContext.beginPath();
          tmpContext.arc(x, y, scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          if (!dontFill) {
            tmpContext.fill();
          }
          if (!dontStroke) {
            tmpContext.stroke();
          }
        } // RENDER STAR SHAPE:
        function renderStar(ctxt, spikes, outer, inner) {
          var rot = Math.PI / 2 * 3;
          var x;
          var y;
          var step = Math.PI / spikes;
          ctxt.beginPath();
          ctxt.moveTo(0, -outer);
          for (var i = 0; i < spikes; i++) {
            x = Math.cos(rot) * outer;
            y = Math.sin(rot) * outer;
            ctxt.lineTo(x, y);
            rot += step;
            x = Math.cos(rot) * inner;
            y = Math.sin(rot) * inner;
            ctxt.lineTo(x, y);
            rot += step;
          }
          ctxt.lineTo(0, -outer);
          ctxt.closePath();
        } // RENDER RECTANGLE:
        function renderRect(x, y, w, h, ctxt, stroke) {
          ctxt.fillRect(x - w / 2, y - h / 2, w, h);
          if (!stroke) {
            ctxt.strokeRect(x - w / 2, y - h / 2, w, h);
          }
        } // RENDER RECTCIRCLE:
        function renderRectCircle(x, y, s, sw, seg, ctxt, stroke) {
          ctxt.save();
          ctxt.translate(x, y);
          seg = Math.ceil(seg / 2);
          for (var i = 0; i < seg; i++) {
            renderRect(0, 0, s * 2, sw, ctxt, stroke);
            ctxt.rotate(Math.PI / seg);
          }
          ctxt.restore();
        } // RENDER BLOB:
        function renderBlob(ctxt, spikes, outer, inner) {
          var rot = Math.PI / 2 * 3;
          var x;
          var y;
          var step = Math.PI / spikes;
          var tmpOuter;
          ctxt.beginPath();
          ctxt.moveTo(0, -inner);
          for (var i = 0; i < spikes; i++) {
            tmpOuter = UTILS.randInt(outer + 0.9, outer * 1.2);
            ctxt.quadraticCurveTo(Math.cos(rot + step) * tmpOuter, Math.sin(rot + step) * tmpOuter, Math.cos(rot + step * 2) * inner, Math.sin(rot + step * 2) * inner);
            rot += step * 2;
          }
          ctxt.lineTo(0, -inner);
          ctxt.closePath();
        } // RENDER TRIANGLE:
        function renderTriangle(s, ctx) {
          ctx = ctx || mainContext;
          var h = s * (Math.sqrt(3) / 2);
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(0, -h / 2);
          ctx.lineTo(-s / 2, h / 2);
          ctx.lineTo(s / 2, h / 2);
          ctx.lineTo(0, -h / 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.closePath();
        } // PREPARE MENU BACKGROUND:
        function prepareMenuBackground() {
          const tmpMid = config.mapScale / 2;
          objectManager.add(0, tmpMid, tmpMid + 200, 0, config.treeScales[3], 0);
          objectManager.add(1, tmpMid, tmpMid - 480, 0, config.treeScales[3], 0);
          objectManager.add(2, tmpMid + 300, tmpMid + 450, 0, config.treeScales[3], 0);
          objectManager.add(3, tmpMid - 950, tmpMid - 130, 0, config.treeScales[2], 0);
          objectManager.add(4, tmpMid - 750, tmpMid - 400, 0, config.treeScales[3], 0);
          objectManager.add(5, tmpMid - 700, tmpMid + 400, 0, config.treeScales[2], 0);
          objectManager.add(6, tmpMid + 800, tmpMid - 200, 0, config.treeScales[3], 0);
          objectManager.add(7, tmpMid - 260, tmpMid + 340, 0, config.bushScales[3], 1);
          objectManager.add(8, tmpMid + 760, tmpMid + 310, 0, config.bushScales[3], 1);
          objectManager.add(9, tmpMid - 800, tmpMid + 100, 0, config.bushScales[3], 1);
          objectManager.add(10, tmpMid - 800, tmpMid + 300, 0, items.list[4].scale, items.list[4].id, items.list[10]);
          objectManager.add(11, tmpMid + 650, tmpMid - 390, 0, items.list[4].scale, items.list[4].id, items.list[10]);
          objectManager.add(12, tmpMid - 400, tmpMid - 450, 0, config.rockScales[2], 2);
          objectManager.add(13, tmpMid + 400, tmpMid - 250, 0, config.rockScales[2], 2);
          if (backgroundPlayer.active && (pets.isOnwerAlreadyInTrap || pets.isOwnerInTrap)) {
            backgroundPlayer.stop();
            pets.forEach(pet => {
              pet.reset();
            });
          }
          backgroundPlayer.start();
        } // LOAD GAME OBJECT:
        function loadGameObject(data) {
          for (var i = 0; i < data.length;) {
            objectManager.add(data[i], data[i + 1], data[i + 2], data[i + 3], data[i + 4], data[i + 5], items.list[data[i + 6]], true, data[i + 7] >= 0 ? {
              sid: data[i + 7]
            } : null);
            i += 8;
          }
        } // WIGGLE GAME OBJECT:
        function wiggleGameObject(angle, sid) {
          tmpObj = findObjectBySid(sid);
          if (!tmpObj) {
            return;
          }
          if (!menu.getModelActive("disable-object-wiggle")) {
            tmpObj.xWiggle += config.gatherWiggle * Math.cos(angle);
            tmpObj.yWiggle += config.gatherWiggle * Math.sin(angle);
          }
        } // SHOOT TURRET:
        function shootTurret(sid, dir) {
          tmpObj = findObjectBySid(sid);
          if (!tmpObj) {
            return;
          }
          tmpObj.dir = dir;
          if (!menu.getModelActive("disable-object-wiggle")) {
            tmpObj.xWiggle += config.gatherWiggle * Math.cos(dir + Math.PI);
            tmpObj.yWiggle += config.gatherWiggle * Math.sin(dir + Math.PI);
          }
          tmpObj.shootTime = Date.now();
        } // ADD PROJECTILE:
        function addProjectile(x, y, dir, range, speed, indx, layer, sid, original) {
          if (!inWindow) {
            return;
          }
          if (range === 1400 && menu.getModelActive("shot-particles")) {
            for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
              const offset = 85;
              particles.create("shot", x + offset * Math.cos(dir), y + offset * Math.sin(dir), 4, menu.getModelValue("shot-particles-color"), 0.8);
            }
          }
          projectileManager.addProjectile(x, y, dir, range, speed, indx, null, null, layer).sid = sid;
          if (!menu.getModelActive("reload-bars") || !menu.getModelActive("reload-bars-secondary")) {
            return;
          }
          const isTurret = range === 700 && speed === 1.5;
          for (const player1 of players) {
            if (!player1.visible || !player1.alive) {
              continue;
            }
            const item = window.weaponsConfig[player1.weaponIndex];
            const distance = Math.hypot(x - player1.x, y - player1.y);
            /*if (isTurret) {
            if (player1.skinIndex == 53 && distance <= 5) {
            player1.startTurretReload(item)
            }
            }*/
            if (typeof item.projectile === "undefined" || player.d2 - dir > 0.4 || distance < 69 && distance > 72) {
              continue;
            }
            player1.startSecondaryReload(item);
          }
        } // REMOVE PROJECTILE:
        function remProjectile(sid, range) {
          for (var i = 0; i < projectiles.length; ++i) {
            if (projectiles[i].sid == sid) {
              projectiles[i].range = range;
            }
          }
        } // ANIMATE AI:
        let la = 0;
        function animateAI(sid) {
          tmpObj = findAIBySID(sid);
          if (!tmpObj) {
            return;
          }
          tmpObj.startAnimTimes ??= [];
          if (tmpObj.lastAnimTime) {
            tmpObj.startAnimTimes.push(Math.min(Date.now() - tmpObj.lastAnimTime, 3500));
          }
          tmpObj.startAnim();
          tmpObj.lastAnimTime = Date.now();
        } // ADD AI:
        function loadAI(data) {
          for (var i = 0; i < ais.length; ++i) {
            ais[i].forcePos = !ais[i].visible;
            ais[i].visible = false;
          }
          if (data) {
            var tmpTime = Date.now();
            for (var i = 0; i < data.length;) {
              tmpObj = findAIBySID(data[i]);
              if (tmpObj) {
                tmpObj.index = data[i + 1];
                tmpObj.t1 = tmpObj.t2 === undefined ? tmpTime : tmpObj.t2;
                tmpObj.t2 = tmpTime;
                tmpObj.x1 = tmpObj.x;
                tmpObj.y1 = tmpObj.y;
                tmpObj.x2 = data[i + 2];
                tmpObj.y2 = data[i + 3];
                tmpObj.d1 = tmpObj.d2 === undefined ? data[i + 4] : tmpObj.d2;
                tmpObj.d2 = data[i + 4];
                tmpObj.health = data[i + 5];
                tmpObj.dt = 0;
                tmpObj.visible = true;
              } else {
                tmpObj = aiManager.spawn(data[i + 2], data[i + 3], data[i + 4], data[i + 1]);
                tmpObj.x2 = tmpObj.x;
                tmpObj.y2 = tmpObj.y;
                tmpObj.d2 = tmpObj.dir;
                tmpObj.health = data[i + 5];
                if (!aiManager.aiTypes[data[i + 1]].name) {
                  tmpObj.name = config.cowNames[data[i + 6]];
                }
                tmpObj.forcePos = true;
                tmpObj.sid = data[i];
                tmpObj.visible = true;
              }
              i += 7;
            }
          }
        } // RENDER AI:
        var aiSprites = {};
        function renderAI(obj, ctxt) {
          var tmpIndx = obj.index;
          var tmpSprite = aiSprites[tmpIndx];
          if (!tmpSprite) {
            var tmpImg = new Image();
            tmpImg.onload = function () {
              this.isLoaded = true;
              this.onload = null;
            };
            tmpImg.src = ".././img/animals/" + obj.src + ".png";
            tmpSprite = tmpImg;
            aiSprites[tmpIndx] = tmpSprite;
          }
          if (tmpSprite.isLoaded) {
            var tmpScale = obj.scale * 1.2 * (obj.spriteMlt || 1);
            ctxt.drawImage(tmpSprite, -tmpScale, -tmpScale, tmpScale * 2, tmpScale * 2);
          }
        } // OBJECT ON SCREEN:
        function isOnScreen(x, y, s) {
          return x + s >= 0 && x - s <= maxScreenWidth && y + s >= 0 && y - s <= maxScreenHeight;
        } // ADD NEW PLAYER:
        function addPlayer(data, isYou) {
          var tmpPlayer = findPlayerByID(data[0]);
          if (!tmpPlayer) {
            tmpPlayer = new Player(data[0], data[1], config, UTILS, projectileManager, objectManager, players, ais, items, hats, accessories);
            players.push(tmpPlayer);
          }
          tmpPlayer.spawn(isYou ? moofoll : null);
          tmpPlayer.visible = false;
          tmpPlayer.x2 = undefined;
          tmpPlayer.y2 = undefined;
          tmpPlayer.setData(data);
          if (isYou) {
            player = tmpPlayer;
            camX = player.x;
            camY = player.y;
            updateItems();
            updateStatusDisplay();
            updateAge();
            updateUpgrades(0);
            gameUI.style.display = "block";
          }
        } // REMOVE PLAYER:
        function removePlayer(id) {
          for (var i = 0; i < players.length; i++) {
            if (players[i].id == id) {
              players.splice(i, 1);
              break;
            }
          }
        } // UPDATE PLAYER ITEM VALUES:
        function updateItemCounts(index, value) {
          if (player) {
            player.itemCounts[index] = value;
          }
        } // UPDATE PLAYER VALUE:
        function updatePlayerValue(index, value, updateView) {
          if (!player) {
            return;
          }
          if (menu.getModelActive("resource-gain-text")) {
            const amount = Math.abs(player[index] - value);
            const color = index === "points" ? "#ccb928" : index === "wood" ? "#5ac828" : index === "food" ? "#c92626" : "#999999";
            const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            textManager.showText(player.x - player.scale * Math.cos(angle), player.y - player.scale * Math.sin(angle), 35, 0.125, 400, (player[index] > value ? "-" : "+") + amount, color);
          }
          player[index] = value;
          if (updateView) {
            updateStatusDisplay();
          }
        } // UPDATE HEALTH:
        function updateHealth(sid, health) {
          tmpObj = findPlayerBySID(sid);
          if (!tmpObj) {
            return;
          }
          tmpObj.newHealth = health;
          tmpObj.oldHealth = tmpObj.health;
          if (!menu.getModelActive("health-animation")) {
            tmpObj.health = health;
          }
          if (tmpObj.oldHealth < health) {
            if (tmpObj.sid === player.sid) {
              if (health >= player.maxHealth) {
                pets.forEach(pet => {
                  pet.addMessage(`Ⴚტ◕‿◕ტჂ Fine. Now your health is full`, "rgba(18, 165, 43, 0.5)");
                });
              }
            }
            player.updateShameCount();
            player.isHealing = true;
            if (menu.getModelActive("health-particles")) {
              const amount = Math.abs(tmpObj.newHealth - tmpObj.oldHealth);
              for (let i = 0; i < amount; i++) {
                particles.create("health", tmpObj.x, tmpObj.y, 40, menu.getModelValue("health-particles-color"), Math.random() * 2 + 1, 600, true, "+");
              }
            }
          } else {
            if (health <= 0) {
              tmpObj.alive = false;
              tmpObj.active = false;
              return;
            }
            if (tmpObj.sid === player.sid && health <= 35) {
              pets.forEach(pet => {
                pet.addMessage(`◝(๑꒪່౪̮꒪່๑)◜ ${player.name.toUpperCase()}! You need to restore health! 💊`, "rgba(174, 10, 10, 0.65)");
              });
            }
            if (menu.getModelActive("sounds")) {
              const soundsVolume = parseFloat(menu.getModelValue("sounds-volume")) / 10;
              let volume = Math.max(soundsVolume - 0.3, 0.085);
              if (tmpObj.sid === player.sid) {
                soundManager.play("gotDamage", volume);
              } else {
                const distance = Math.hypot(player.y - tmpObj.y, player.x - tmpObj.x);
                const minDistance = 750;
                volume = soundsVolume - Math.max(distance / minDistance, 0);
                soundManager.play("gotDamage", Math.max(volume - 0.1, 0));
              }
              console.log(123, tmpObj.name);
            }
            tmpObj.hitTime = window.ticks;
            tmpObj.isHealing = false;
            if (menu.getModelActive("blood-particles")) {
              const amount = Math.abs(tmpObj.newHealth - tmpObj.oldHealth);
              for (let i = 0; i < amount; i++) {
                particles.create("blood", tmpObj.x, tmpObj.y, 40, menu.getModelValue("blood-particles-color"), Math.random() * 2 + 1, 600, true, "-");
              }
            }
          }
          if (menu.getModelActive("health-animation")) {
            tmpObj.lossHealth = Math.abs(tmpObj.oldHealth - health);
            tmpObj.updateHealthTime = Date.now();
          }
        } // UPDATE PLAYER DATA:
        window.ticks = 0;
        window.fps = 0;
        function BuildPosition(id, x, y, building, angle, buildRadius) {
          this.id = id;
          this.x = x;
          this.y = y;
          this.building = building;
          this.angle = angle;
          this.buildRadius = buildRadius;
          this.radius = 2;
          this.color = "#479e00";
          this.canBuild = true;
          this.obstacle = null;
          this.phantomObstacle = null;
          this.setTo = function (x, y) {
            this.x = x;
