            this.y = y;
            this.buildX = this.x - (this.building.scale / 2 + Math.abs(this.building.placeOffset * 2)) * Math.cos(this.angle);
            this.buildY = this.y - (this.building.scale / 2 + Math.abs(this.building.placeOffset * 2)) * Math.sin(this.angle);
          };
          this.setTo(this.x, this.y);
          this.render = function () {
            mainContext.save();
            mainContext.fillStyle = !this.canBuild ? "#b41d1d" : "#48b41d";
            mainContext.beginPath();
            mainContext.arc(this.x - window.xOffset, this.y - window.yOffset, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            mainContext.fill();
            mainContext.restore();
            mainContext.save();
            mainContext.strokeStyle = !this.canBuild ? "#b41d1d" : "#48b41d";
            mainContext.lineWidth = 1;
            mainContext.beginPath();
            mainContext.moveTo(this.x - window.xOffset, this.y - window.yOffset);
            mainContext.lineTo(this.buildX - window.xOffset, this.buildY - window.yOffset);
            mainContext.stroke();
            mainContext.restore();
            mainContext.save();
            mainContext.fillStyle = !this.canBuild ? "#b41d1d" : "#aeb238";
            mainContext.beginPath();
            mainContext.arc(this.buildX - window.xOffset, this.buildY - window.yOffset, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            mainContext.fill();
            mainContext.restore();
          };
          this.update = function () {
            this.render();
            for (let i = 0; i < gameObjects.length; i++) {
              const building = gameObjects[i];
              if (!building.active) {
                continue;
              }
              const distance = Math.hypot(this.y - building.y, this.x - building.x) - (building.getScale ? building.getScale() : building.scale);
              const angle = Math.atan2(building.y - this.y, building.x - this.x);
              if (!isOnScreen(building.x - window.xOffset, building.y - window.yOffset, building.scale + (building.blocker || 0))) {
                continue;
              }
              if (!this.canBuild && this.obstacle) {
                if (building.sid === this.obstacle.sid) {
                  if (distance > this.radius) {
                    this.canBuild = true;
                    this.obstacle = null;
                    building.isObstacle = false;
                    continue;
                  } else {
                    break;
                  }
                } else {
                  continue;
                }
              }
              if (!this.canBuild && this.phantomObstacle) {
                if (building.sid === this.phantomObstacle.sid) {
                  if (distance > this.radius) {
                    this.canBuild = true;
                    this.phantomObstacle = null;
                    continue;
                  } else {
                    break;
                  }
                } else {
                  continue;
                }
              }
              if (distance > this.radius) {
                continue;
              }
              this.canBuild = false;
              this.phantomObstacle = building;
              if (!building.isObstacle) {
                this.obstacle = building;
              }
              building.isObstacle = true;
            }
          };
        }
        const buildPositions = new Map();
        function updateBuildPosition() {
          buildPositions.active = false;
          const building = items.list[player.buildIndex];
          if (!building) {
            return;
          }
          if (building.id !== buildPositions.oldBuilding?.id) {
            buildPositions.clear();
          }
          if (!building.group.place) {
            return;
          }
          buildPositions.oldBuilding = building;
          const radius = buildPositions.radius = player.scale * 2 + building.scale + Math.abs(building.placeOffset);
          const steps = radius;
          for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
            const angle = Math.PI * 2 * i / steps;
            const x = player.x + radius * Math.cos(angle);
            const y = player.y + radius * Math.sin(angle);
            if (buildPositions.has(i)) {
              buildPositions.get(i).setTo(x, y);
              continue;
            }
            buildPositions.set(i, new BuildPosition(i, x, y, building, angle, radius));
          }
          buildPositions.active = true;
        }
        function renderFreeBuildPositions() {
          const building = items.list[player.buildIndex];
          if (!building) {
            return;
          }
          if (!building.group.place) {
            return;
          }
          const freePositions = Array.from(buildPositions.values()).filter(buildPosition => buildPosition.canBuild);
          for (let i = 0; i < freePositions.length; i++) {
            const freePosition = freePositions[i];
            const positions = freePositions.filter(position => position.id !== freePosition.id && position.isCanBuild);
            const nearPosition = positions.sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.buildY - freePosition.buildY, a.buildX - freePosition.buildX) - Math.hypot(b.buildY - freePosition.buildY, b.buildX - freePosition.buildX))[0];
            if (nearPosition) {
              const distance = Math.hypot(nearPosition.buildY - freePosition.buildY, nearPosition.buildX - freePosition.buildX);
              if (distance <= freePosition.building.scale) {
                continue;
              }
            }
            const isCanBuild = objectManager.checkItemLocation(freePosition.buildX, freePosition.buildY, freePosition.building.scale, 0.6, freePosition.building.id, false);
            if (isCanBuild) {
              buildPositions.get(freePosition.id).isCanBuild = true;
              mainContext.save();
              mainContext.fillStyle = "#3896ad";
              mainContext.strokeStyle = "#2a7183";
              mainContext.lineWidth = freePosition.radius;
              mainContext.beginPath();
              mainContext.globalAlpha = 0.25;
              mainContext.arc(freePosition.buildX - window.xOffset, freePosition.buildY - window.yOffset, freePosition.building.scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
              mainContext.fill();
              mainContext.globalAlpha = 0.55;
              mainContext.arc(freePosition.buildX - window.xOffset, freePosition.buildY - window.yOffset, freePosition.building.scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
              mainContext.stroke();
              mainContext.restore();
            } else {
              buildPositions.get(freePosition.id).isCanBuild = false;
            }
          }
        }
        function updatePlayers(data) {
          var tmpTime = Date.now();
          for (var i = 0; i < players.length; ++i) {
            players[i].forcePos = !players[i].visible;
            players[i].visible = false;
          }
          for (var i = 0; i < data.length;) {
            tmpObj = findPlayerBySID(data[i]);
            if (tmpObj) {
              tmpObj.t1 = tmpObj.t2 === undefined ? tmpTime : tmpObj.t2;
              tmpObj.t2 = tmpTime;
              tmpObj.x1 = tmpObj.x;
              tmpObj.y1 = tmpObj.y;
              tmpObj.x2 = data[i + 1];
              tmpObj.y2 = data[i + 2];
              tmpObj.moveAngle = Math.atan2(tmpObj.y - tmpObj.y2, tmpObj.x - tmpObj.x2);
              tmpObj.moveSpeed = Math.hypot(tmpObj.y1 - tmpObj.y2, tmpObj.x1 - tmpObj.x2);
              tmpObj.d1 = tmpObj.d2 === undefined ? data[i + 3] : tmpObj.d2;
              tmpObj.d2 = data[i + 3];
              tmpObj.dt = 0;
              tmpObj.buildIndex = data[i + 4];
              tmpObj.weaponIndex = data[i + 5];
              tmpObj.weaponVariant = data[i + 6];
              tmpObj.team = data[i + 7];
              tmpObj.isLeader = data[i + 8];
              tmpObj.skinIndex = data[i + 9];
              tmpObj.tailIndex = data[i + 10];
              tmpObj.iconIndex = data[i + 11];
              tmpObj.zIndex = data[i + 12];
              tmpObj.visible = true;
              tmpObj.isAlly = tmpObj == player || tmpObj.team && tmpObj.team === player.team;
              tmpObj.tick(window.delta);
            }
            i += 13;
          }
          window.ticks += 1;
        } // FIND OBJECTS BY ID/SID:
        function isClanMember(sid) {
          if (player && player.sid == sid) {
            return true;
          }
          if (!player || !player.team || sid < 0) {
            return false;
          }
          for (var i = 0; i < alliancePlayers.length; i += 2) {
            let allySid = alliancePlayers[i];
            if (sid == allySid) {
              return true;
            }
          }
          return false;
        }
        function findPlayerByID(id) {
          for (var i = 0; i < players.length; ++i) {
            if (players[i].id == id) {
              return players[i];
            }
          }
          return null;
        }
        function findPlayerBySID(sid) {
          for (var i = 0; i < players.length; ++i) {
            if (players[i].sid == sid) {
              return players[i];
            }
          }
          return null;
        }
        function findAIBySID(sid) {
          for (var i = 0; i < ais.length; ++i) {
            if (ais[i].sid == sid) {
              return ais[i];
            }
          }
          return null;
        }
        function findObjectBySid(sid) {
          for (var i = 0; i < gameObjects.length; ++i) {
            if (gameObjects[i].sid == sid) {
              return gameObjects[i];
            }
          }
          return null;
        } // PING:
        var lastPing = -1;
        function pingSocketResponse() {
          let pingDisplay = document.getElementById("pingDisplay");
          const gameUI = document.getElementById("gameUI");
          const ping = Date.now() - lastPing;
          if (pingDisplay.parentNode.id === "mainMenu") {
            pingDisplay.remove();
            document.body.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", pingDisplay.outerHTML);
            pingDisplay = document.getElementById("pingDisplay");
          }
          window.pingTime = ping;
          pingDisplay.style.textAlign = "center";
          pingDisplay.style.pointerEvets = "none";
          pingDisplay.style.zIndex = 1;
          pingDisplay.innerHTML = `Ping: ${ping} ms<br>FPS: ${window.fps.toFixed(0)}`;
        }
        function pingSocket() {
          lastPing = Date.now();
          io.send("0");
        } // SERVER SHUTDOWN NOTICE:
        function serverShutdownNotice(countdown) {
          if (countdown < 0) {
            return;
          }
          var minutes = Math.floor(countdown / 60);
          var seconds = countdown % 60;
          seconds = ("0" + seconds).slice(-2);
          shutdownDisplay.innerText = "Server restarting in " + minutes + ":" + seconds;
          shutdownDisplay.hidden = false;
        }
        const context = gameCanvas.getContext("2d");
        const gatherAngle = Math.PI / 2.6;
        function getAngleDist(a, b) {
          const angle = Math.abs(b - a) % (Math.PI * 2);
          if (angle > Math.PI) {
            return Math.PI * 2 - angle;
          } else {
            return angle;
          }
        }
        function Particle(id, type, x, y, radius, angle, color, power, deathCooldown, isText = false, text) {
          this.id = id;
          this.type = type;
          this.x = x;
          this.y = y;
          this.radius = radius;
          this.angle = angle;
          this.color = color;
          this.power = power;
          this.deathCooldown = deathCooldown;
          this.isText = isText;
          this.text = text;
          this.alpha = 1;
          this.lifeTime = Date.now();
          this.destroy = function () {
            particles.particles.delete(this.id);
          };
          this.render = function () {
            if (!this.isText) {
              context.begin(this.x - window.xOffset, this.y - window.yOffset).setFillColor(this.color).setAlpha(this.alpha).circle(this.radius).end();
            } else {
              context.begin(this.x - window.xOffset, this.y - window.yOffset).setFillColor(this.color).setFont(`${this.radius}px Hammersmith One`).setJoin("round").setBaseLine("middle").setAlign("center").setAlpha(this.alpha).text(this.text).end();
            }
          };
          this.update = function () {
            if (Date.now() - this.lifeTime >= this.deathCooldown - Math.max(window.fps, window.delta)) {
              return this.destroy();
            }
            const xVel = this.power * Math.cos(this.angle);
            const yVel = this.power * Math.sin(this.angle);
            this.x += xVel;
            this.y += yVel;
            this.alpha = 1 - (Date.now() - this.lifeTime) / this.deathCooldown;
            this.render();
          };
        }
        function Particles() {
          this.particles = new Map();
          this.create = function (type, x, y, radius, color, power, deathCooldown = 1000, isText, text) {
            const particle = new Particle(Date.now() * Math.random(), type, x, y, radius, Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, color, power, deathCooldown, isText, text);
            this.particles.set(particle.id, particle);
          };
          this.update = function (tmpPlayer, ownPlayer) {
            this.particles.forEach(particle => {
              particle.update(tmpPlayer, ownPlayer);
            });
          };
          return this;
        }
        const particles = new Particles();
        function magicFactory(_x, _y, _radius, tmpPlayer) {
          const x = _x;
          const y = _y;
          const radius = _radius;
          function fire(color) {
            let pointsAround = new Array(~~(radius / Math.PI * 3)).fill([NaN, NaN]);
            let pointsAroundStep = 0;
            context.begin(x - window.xOffset, y - window.yOffset).setStrokeColor(color).setLineWidth(4).setAlpha(0.4).setJoin("round").circle(radius * 1.85, "stroke").end();
            pointsAround = pointsAround.map(() => {
              const angle = pointsAroundStep * Math.PI * 2;
              const _x = x + Math.cos(angle) * radius * 1.85;
              const _y = y + Math.sin(angle) * radius * 1.85;
              pointsAroundStep += Math.sqrt(window.delta / (Math.PI * 2));
              return [_x, _y];
            });
            for (const point of pointsAround) {
              particles.create("attack", point[0], point[1], 4, color, 0.5);
            }
          }
          return {
            fire
          };
        }
        function ShorePath(startX, startY, endX, distance, float) {
          this.startX = startX;
          this.startY = startY;
          this.endX = endX;
          this.distance = distance;
          this.float = float;
          this.amountPaths = Math.ceil(this.endX / this.distance);
          this.path = new Map();
          this.generate = function () {
            for (let i = 1; i <= this.amountPaths; i += 1) {
              const offsetY = i % 2 === 0 ? this.distance : 0;
              const x = this.startX + this.distance * (i - 1);
              const randomOffsetY = Math.floor(Math.random() * 35) + 10;
              const y = this.startY + ((this.float === "down" ? offsetY : -offsetY) + (i % 2 === 0 ? Math.random() < 0.55 ? randomOffsetY : -randomOffsetY : 0));
              this.path.set(i, [x, y, offsetY, randomOffsetY]);
            }
          };
          this.render = function (color, xOffset, yOffset) {
            const path = Array.from(this.path.values()); // const player = player;
            if (!player?.active || !player?.alive) {
              return;
            }
            for (let i = 1; i < path.length; i++) {
              const oldPoint = path[i - 1];
              const currentPoint = path[i];
              if (!player.canSeePoint({
                x: oldPoint[0],
                y: oldPoint[1],
                scale: 10
              })) {
                continue;
              }
              if (!player.canSeePoint({
                x: currentPoint[0],
                y: currentPoint[1],
                scale: 10
              })) {
                continue;
              }
              const pointOffset = this.distance / 2;
              const sidePoint1 = [oldPoint[0] - pointOffset / 2, oldPoint[1] + (oldPoint[2] === 0 ? pointOffset : -pointOffset)];
              const sidePoint2 = [currentPoint[0] + pointOffset * 1.15, currentPoint[1] + pointOffset * 1.2];
              const sidePoint3 = [currentPoint[0] + pointOffset * 1.35, currentPoint[1] - pointOffset * 1.15];
              const sidePoint4 = [currentPoint[0] - pointOffset * 1.35, currentPoint[1] + pointOffset * 1.15];
              mainContext.save();
              mainContext.fillStyle = color;
              mainContext.lineCap = "round";
              mainContext.lineJoin = "round";
              mainContext.beginPath();
              mainContext.moveTo(oldPoint[0] - xOffset, oldPoint[1] - yOffset);
              mainContext.lineTo(oldPoint[0] + this.distance * 2 - xOffset, this.startY - yOffset);
              mainContext.lineTo(currentPoint[0] - xOffset, currentPoint[1] - yOffset);
              mainContext.fill();
              mainContext.beginPath();
              mainContext.moveTo(oldPoint[0] - xOffset, oldPoint[1] - yOffset);
              mainContext.bezierCurveTo(sidePoint1[0] - xOffset, sidePoint1[1] - yOffset, sidePoint2[0] - xOffset, sidePoint2[1] - yOffset, currentPoint[0] + (currentPoint[3] >= 10 ? 3.5 : 1) - xOffset, currentPoint[1] - yOffset);
              mainContext.fill();
              mainContext.beginPath();
              mainContext.moveTo(currentPoint[0] - xOffset, currentPoint[1] - yOffset);
              mainContext.bezierCurveTo(sidePoint2[0] - xOffset, sidePoint2[1] - yOffset, sidePoint3[0] - xOffset, sidePoint3[1] - yOffset, currentPoint[0] + this.distance * 2 - xOffset, this.startY - yOffset);
              mainContext.fill();
              mainContext.restore();
            }
          };
          return this.generate();
        }
        const snowPath = new ShorePath(-maxScreenWidth, config.snowBiomeTop - 1, config.mapScale + maxScreenWidth * 2, 50, "down");
        const desertPath = new ShorePath(-maxScreenWidth, config.mapScale - config.snowBiomeTop + 1, config.mapScale + maxScreenWidth * 2, 50, "up");
        function toVector(x, y) {
          let vector = null;
          if (arguments[0] instanceof Vector) {
            vector = new Vector(arguments[0].x, arguments[0].y);
          } else if (typeof arguments[0] === "number" && typeof arguments[1] === "undefined") {
            vector = new Vector(arguments[0], arguments[0]);
          } else if (typeof arguments[0] === "number" && typeof arguments[1] === "number") {
            vector = new Vector(x, y);
          } else {
            vector = new Vector(0, 0);
          }
          return vector;
        }
        class Vector {
          constructor(x = 0, y = 0) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
          }
          static random2D(angle, length = 1) {
            return new Vector(length * Math.cos(angle), length * Math.sin(angle));
          }
          get magnitude() {
            return Math.sqrt(this.x ** 2 + this.y ** 2);
          }
          get copy() {
            return new Vector(this.x, this.y);
          }
          setMag(length) {
            return this.normalize().mult(length);
          }
          set(x = 0, y = 0) {
            const vector = toVector(x, y);
            this.x = vector.x;
            this.y = vector.y;
            return this;
          }
          add(x = 0, y = 0) {
            const vector = toVector(x, y);
            this.x += vector.x;
            this.y += vector.y;
            return this;
          }
          sub(x, y) {
            const vector = toVector(x, y);
            this.x -= vector.x;
            this.y -= vector.y;
            return this;
          }
          mult(x, y) {
            const vector = toVector(x, y);
            this.x *= vector.x;
            this.y *= vector.y;
            return this;
          }
          div(x, y) {
            const vector = toVector(x, y);
            this.x /= vector.x;
            this.y /= vector.y;
            return this;
          }
          mulScalar(scalar) {
            const vector = toVector(scalar);
            this.x *= vector.x;
            this.y *= vector.y;
            return this;
          }
          normalize() {
            const magnitude = this.magnitude;
            if (magnitude <= 0) {
              return this;
            }
            return new Vector(this.x, this.y).div(magnitude || 1);
          }
          projection(vector) {
            const normalized = vector.normalize();
            const scalar = this.mulScalar(vector);
            normalized.mult(scalar);
            return normalized;
          }
          clamp(min, max) {
            this.x = Math.max(min.x, Math.min(max.x, this.x));
            this.y = Math.max(min.y, Math.min(max.y, this.y));
            return this;
          }
          floor() {
            this.x = Math.floor(this.x);
            this.y = Math.floor(this.y);
            return this;
          }
          dot(vector) {
            return this.x * vector.x + this.y * vector.y;
          }
          cross(vector) {
            return this.x * vector.y - this.y * vector.x;
          }
          lengthSq() {
            return this.x * this.x + this.y * this.y;
          }
          length() {
            return Math.sqrt(this.x * this.x + this.y * this.y);
          }
          lerp(vector, alpha) {
            this.x += (vector.x - this.x) * -alpha;
            this.y += (vector.y - this.y) * -alpha;
            return this;
          }
          lerpVectors(vector1, vector2, alpha) {
            this.x = vector1.x + (vector2.x - vector1.x) * alpha;
            this.y = vector1.y + (vector2.y - vector1.y) * alpha;
            return this;
          }
          distanceTo(x, y) {
            const vector = toVector(x, y);
            return this.copy.sub(vector).length();
          }
          angleTo(x, y) {
            const vector = toVector(x, y);
            const copy = vector.copy.sub(this);
            return Math.atan2(copy.y, copy.x);
          }
          random() {
            this.x = Math.random();
            this.y = Math.random();
            return this;
          }
          reset() {
            this.x = 0;
            this.y = 0;
            return this;
          }
          log() {
            console.log(this.x, this.y);
          }
        }
        class Physics {
          constructor(x, y, mass = 5, time = 0.9) {
            this.mass = mass;
            this.time = time;
            this.position = new Vector(x, y);
            this.velocity = new Vector();
            this.acceleration = new Vector();
            this.force = new Vector();
            this.position.lastX = this.position.x;
            this.position.lastY = this.position.y;
            this.velocity.lastX = this.velocity.x;
            this.velocity.lastY = this.velocity.y;
          }
          updatePhysics() {
            this.position.lastX = this.position.x;
            this.position.lastY = this.position.y;
            this.velocity.lastX = this.velocity.x;
            this.velocity.lastY = this.velocity.y;
            this.force.div(this.mass);
            this.acceleration.add(this.force.x, this.force.y);
            this.acceleration.mult(this.time);
            this.velocity.add(this.acceleration.x, this.acceleration.y);
            this.velocity.mult(this.time);
            this.position.add(this.velocity.x, this.velocity.y);
          }
          resetPhysics() {
            this.force.reset();
            this.acceleration.reset();
            this.velocity.reset();
          }
        }
        class Point extends Physics {
          constructor(x, y, width, height) {
            height = height || width;
            super(x, y);
            this.width = width;
            this.height = height;
            this.scale = (this.width + this.height) / 2;
          }
          get x() {
            return this.position.x - this.width / 2;
          }
          get y() {
            return this.position.y - this.height / 2;
          }
          get lastX() {
            return this.position.lastX - this.width / 2;
          }
          get lastY() {
            return this.position.lastY - this.width / 2;
          }
          set x(number) {
            this.position.set(number + this.width / 2, this.position.y);
          }
          set y(number) {
            this.position.set(this.position.x, number + this.height / 2);
          }
          get clone() {
            return new Point(this.position.x, this.position.y, this.width, this.height);
          }
          setTo(x, y) {
            const vector = toVector(x, y);
            this.position.set(vector);
          }
          copyFrom(point) {
            this.setTo(point.position.x, point.position.y);
          }
          copyTo(point) {
            point.setTo(point.position.x, point.position.y);
          }
          distanceTo(x, y) {
            if (x instanceof Point) {
              x = new Vector(x.x, x.y);
            }
            const myPoistion = toVector(this.x, this.y);
            const otherPosition = toVector(x, y);
            return myPoistion.distanceTo(otherPosition);
          }
          angleTo(x, y) {
            if (x instanceof Point) {
              x = new Vector(x.x, x.y);
            }
            const myPoistion = toVector(this.x, this.y);
            const otherPosition = toVector(x, y);
            return myPoistion.angleTo(otherPosition);
          }
        }
        class Pet extends Point {
          constructor(id) {
            super(window.randInt(0, 14400), window.randInt(0, 14400), 20);
            this.id = id;
            this.isFollowOwner = true;
            this.minDistanceToOwner = (player?.scale || config.playerScale) * 4 - this.scale / 2;
            this.distanceToOwner = 0;
            this.owner = 0;
            this.dir = 0;
            this.lastDir = this.dir;
            this.dirPlus = 0;
            this.moveAngle = 0;
            this.weapon = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.weaponsConfig[8]));
            this.weapon.width = this.weapon.length = this.scale * 3.5;
            this.messages = new Map();
            this.sendAfkMessage = {
              messages: [() => {
                return `I ❤️ ${player.name}`;
              }, () => {
                return `(๑💗ᗜ💗)`;
              }, () => {
                return `╭∩╮༼ ◕_◕༽╭∩╮`;
              }, () => {
                return `I am a good pet ♡⸜(˃ ᵕ ˂ )⸝`;
              }, () => {
                return `(⌐□_□) Hey ${player.name}! Why did you stop moving!`;
              }, () => {
                return `Hey ${player.name}! Stop AFK! Let's keep playing! 🎮`;
              }, () => {
                return `Hey owner! You have: ${player.food} 🍎, ${player.wood} 🌳, ${player.stone} 🗿, ${player.points} 💰`;
              }, () => {
                return `Interesting fact. My developer can't play moomoo.io. All he can do is write visual effects because his FPS is very low and his ping is quite high.`;
              }, () => {
                const operationIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
                const operation = ["+", "-", "*", "/"][operationIndex];
                const a = window.randInt(1, 100);
                const b = window.randInt(1, 100);
                const result = eval(`${a}${operation}${b}`);
                return `${a} ${operation} ${b} = ${result.toFixed(operation === "/" ? 2 : 0)}`;
              }],
              time: Date.now(),
              delay: 9000
            };
            this.canSeeEnemies = new Map();
            this.isOwnerInTrap = false;
            this.isOnwerAlreadyInTrap = false;
            this.biome = "";
            this.isAttack = false;
            this.attackPosition = null;
            this.animAttackTime = 0;
            this.animAttackIndex = 0;
            this.animAttackRatio = 0;
            this.isHoldAttack = null;
            this.targetAttackObject = null;
            this.forceStopAttack = false;
            this.targetAngle = 0;
            this.isOwnerHoldAttack = 0;
            this.forceSpeed = null;
            this.rndGameObject = null;
            this.infinityAttack = false;
            this.isPet = true;
            this.isActive = true;
          }
          startAttackAnimation(moveX, moveY, objectType) {
            if (this.isAttack) {
              return;
            }
            this.isAttack = true;
            this.isFollowOwner = false;
            this.attackPosition = new Vector(moveX, moveY);
            this.startAttackTime = Date.now();
            this.lastDir = this.dir;
            this.dirPlus = 0;
            this.animAttackTime = 0;
            this.animAttackRatio = 0;
            this.animAttackIndex = 0;
            this.animAttackTime = this.animSpeed = this.weapon.speed;
            this.targetAngle = -config.hitAngle;
            this.targetAttackObject = objectType;
            if (this.isHoldAttack !== this.isOwnerHoldAttack) {
              switch (objectType) {
                case 0:
                  this.addMessage(`Hey ${player.name}! I'll help you farm resources!`, "rgba(0, 0, 0, .2)", 1500);
                  break;
                case 1:
                  this.addMessage(`This building is badly placed. We should break it...`, "rgba(0, 0, 0, .2)", 1500);
                  break;
                case 2:
                  this.addMessage(`This guy obviously wants to die.`, "rgba(0, 0, 0, .2)", 1500);
                  break;
                case 3:
                  this.addMessage(`Why are we destroying our own buildings ?_?`, "rgba(0, 0, 0, .2)", 1500);
                  break;
              }
            }
          }
          stopAttackAnimation(isForce) {
            this.isAttack = false;
            if (this.isHoldAttack === null && !this.infinityAttack) {
              this.isFollowOwner = true;
              this.attackPosition = null;
            }
            this.startAttackTime = null;
            this.dirPlus = 0;
            this.dir = isForce ? this.dir : this.lastDir;
            this.animAttackTime = 0;
            this.animAttackRatio = 0;
            this.animAttackIndex = 0;
            if (!this.infinityAttack) {
              this.targetAttackObject = null;
            }
          }
          attackAnimation() {
            if (this.animAttackTime > 0) {
              this.animAttackTime -= window.delta;
              if (this.animAttackTime <= 0) {
                this.animAttackTime = 0;
                this.dirPlus = 0;
                this.animAttackRatio = 0;
                this.animAttackIndex = 0;
                this.stopAttackAnimation();
              } else if (this.animAttackIndex == 0) {
                this.animAttackRatio += window.delta / (this.animSpeed * config.hitReturnRatio);
                this.dirPlus = lerp(0, this.targetAngle, Math.min(1, this.animAttackRatio));
                if (this.animAttackRatio >= 1) {
                  this.animAttackRatio = 1;
                  this.animAttackIndex = 1;
                }
              } else {
                this.animAttackRatio -= window.delta / (this.animSpeed * (1 - config.hitReturnRatio));
                this.dirPlus = lerp(0, this.targetAngle, Math.max(0, this.animAttackRatio));
              }
            }
          }
          followAttackPosition() {
            if (!this.isAttack && this.isHoldAttack === null) {
              return;
            }
            const distance = Math.max(this.distanceTo(this.attackPosition), 0);
            const angle = this.angleTo(this.attackPosition);
            const speed = Math.max(Math.min(distance * 0.01 * window.delta, distance), 0);
            this.moveAngle = angle;
            this.position.add(speed * Math.cos(this.moveAngle), speed * Math.sin(this.moveAngle));
          }
          addMessage(content, bgColor = "rgba(0, 0, 0, .2)", deleteDelay = 3000) {
            if (!content) {
              return;
            }
            const id = Math.floor(Math.random() * Date.now()) / Math.floor(Math.random() * 100);
            this.messages.set(id, {
              id: id,
              content: content,
              bgColor: bgColor,
              createdAt: Date.now(),
              deleteDelay: deleteDelay
            });
          }
          updateMessage() {
            this.messages.forEach(message => {
              if (Date.now() - message.createdAt >= message.deleteDelay) {
                return this.messages.delete(message.id);
              }
            });
          }
          followOwner() {
            const distance = Math.max(this.owner.distanceTo(this) - this.minDistanceToOwner, 0);
            const angle = this.angleTo(this.owner);
            const speed = this.forceSpeed ?? Math.max(Math.min(distance * 0.01 * window.delta, distance), 0);
            this.moveAngle = angle;
            this.dir = this.moveAngle;
            if (distance <= this.minDistanceToOwner) {
              if (distance > 10) {
                this.velocity = this.velocity.normalize();
              } else if (distance <= 0 && player.x === player.x2 && player.y === player.y2) {
                this.velocity = this.velocity.normalize();
                if (Date.now() - this.sendAfkMessage.time >= this.sendAfkMessage.delay) {
                  const messageContent = this.sendAfkMessage.messages[window.randInt(0, this.sendAfkMessage.messages.length - 1)]();
                  this.addMessage(messageContent);
                  this.sendAfkMessage.time = Date.now();
                }
              }
              this.velocity.add(speed * Math.cos(this.moveAngle), speed * Math.sin(this.moveAngle));
            } else {
              this.position.add(speed * Math.cos(this.moveAngle), speed * Math.sin(this.moveAngle));
            }
          }
          checkCollisions() {
            const gameObjects1 = [...gameObjects, ...players, ...pets.values()];
            for (let i = 0; i < gameObjects1.length; i++) {
              const gameObject = gameObjects1[i];
              if (gameObject.isPet && gameObject.id === this.id) {
                continue;
              }
              if (!gameObject.isPlayer && !gameObject.isPet) {
                if (gameObject.ignoreCollision || !gameObject.active || gameObject.isDestroying) {
                  continue;
                }
                if (!isOnScreen(gameObject.x - window.xOffset, gameObject.y - window.yOffset, gameObject.scale)) {
                  continue;
                }
              }
              const dx = this.x - gameObject.x;
              const dy = this.y - gameObject.y;
              const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
              const distance = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
              let tmpLen = this.scale + gameObject.scale;
              if (Math.abs(dx) <= tmpLen || Math.abs(dy) <= tmpLen) {
                tmpLen = this.scale + (gameObject.getScale ? gameObject.getScale() : gameObject.scale);
                let tmpInt = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) - tmpLen;
                if (tmpInt <= 0) {
                  tmpInt = tmpInt * -1.5 / 2;
                  this.position.add(tmpInt * Math.cos(angle), tmpInt * Math.sin(angle));
                }
              }
            }
          }
          render() {
            const handAngle = Math.PI / 4 * (this.weapon.armS || 1);
            const handScale = this.scale / 2;
            const oHandAngle = this.weapon.hndS || 1;
            const oHandDist = this.weapon.hndD || 1;
            const lineWidth = 4;
            mainContext.save();
            mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
            mainContext.fillStyle = menu.getModelValue("pet-color");
            mainContext.strokeStyle = "#3d3f42";
            mainContext.lineWidth = lineWidth;
            mainContext.lineJoin = "miter";
            mainContext.translate(this.x - window.xOffset, this.y - window.yOffset);
            mainContext.rotate(this.dir + (this.isAttack ? this.dirPlus : 0));
            enterGame(this.weapon, config.weaponVariants[0].src, this.scale, 0, mainContext);
            renderCircle1(this.scale * Math.cos(handAngle), this.scale * Math.sin(handAngle), handScale);
            mainContext.fill();
            mainContext.stroke();
            renderCircle1(this.scale * oHandDist * Math.cos(-handAngle * oHandAngle), this.scale * oHandDist * Math.sin(-handAngle * oHandAngle), handScale);
            mainContext.fill();
            mainContext.stroke();
            renderCircle1(0, 0, this.scale, mainContext);
            mainContext.fill();
            mainContext.stroke();
            mainContext.restore();
          }
          update() {
            this.width = this.height = parseInt(menu.getModelValue("pet-scale"));
            this.scale = (this.width + this.height) / 2;
            this.weapon.width = this.weapon.length = this.scale * 3.5;
            for (let i = 0; i < players.length; i++) {
              const player1 = players[i];
              if (player1.isAlly || player1.sid === player.sid) {
                continue;
              }
              if (!player.canSeeByWH(player)) {
                if (this.canSeeEnemies.has(player.sid)) {
                  this.canSeeEnemies.delete(player.sid);
                }
              } else if (!this.canSeeEnemies.has(player.sid)) {
                this.canSeeEnemies.set(player.sid, true);
                this.addMessage(`⚔️ ${player.name} - Enemy here!. Get ready for battle! ⚔️`, "rgba(133, 15, 15, .5)", 5000);
              }
            }
            const traps = gameObjects.filter(object => object.id === 15 && !isClanMember(object.owner.sid) && isOnScreen(object.x - window.xOffset, object.y - window.yOffset, object.scale));
            const nearTrap = traps.length > 1 ? traps.sort((a, b) => {
              a = Math.hypot(a.y - player.y, a.x - player.x);
              b = Math.hypot(b.y - player.y, b.x - player.x);
              return a - b;
            })[0] : traps[0];
            if (nearTrap?.sid) {
              const distance = Math.hypot(nearTrap.y - player.y, nearTrap.x - player.x) - nearTrap.getScale() - player.scale;
              this.isOwnerInTrap = distance <= 0;
              if (!this.isOwnerInTrap) {
                this.isOnwerAlreadyInTrap = false;
              }
            }
            if (!this.isOnwerAlreadyInTrap && this.isOwnerInTrap) {
              this.addMessage(`⚠️ Oh no, my owner has fallen into a trap! Break it down!!! ⚠️`, "rgba(133, 15, 15, .5)", 6000);
              this.isOnwerAlreadyInTrap = true;
            }
            if (player.biome !== this.biome && this.biome) {
              const messageColor = hexToRGB(player.biomeColor, 0.5);
              switch (player.biome) {
                case "snow":
                  this.addMessage(`❄️ It's pretty chilly here ❄️`, messageColor, 1750);
                  break;
                case "grass":
                  this.addMessage(`🌾 There is nothing better than grass 🌾`, messageColor, 1750);
                  break;
                case "river":
                  this.addMessage(`🌊 I'm not a very good swimmer... And the water is cold... 🌊`, messageColor, 1750);
                  break;
                case "desert":
                  this.addMessage(`🏜️ This desert is very hot. I hope we don't fall into quicksand 🏜️`, messageColor, 1750);
                  break;
              }
            }
            player.oldBiome = this.biome = player.biome;
            if (!this.rndGameObject && !this.noFollowOwner) {
              this.owner = new Point(0, 0, player.scale);
              this.owner.position = new Vector(player.x + player.scale / 2, player.y + player.scale / 2);
            }
            if (this.isFollowOwner) {
              this.followOwner();
            } else if (this.isAttack) {
              this.followAttackPosition();
              this.attackAnimation();
              let nearObject = ([0, 1].includes(this.targetAttackObject) ? gameObjects : players).sort((a, b) => {
                a = Math.hypot(a.y - player.y, a.x - player.x);
                b = Math.hypot(b.y - player.y, b.x - player.x);
                return a - b;
              })[0];
              nearObject = new Vector(nearObject.x, nearObject.y);
              this.dir = this.angleTo(nearObject);
              this.isOwnerHoldAttack = this.isHoldAttack = attackState || window.isAutoAttackActive || 0;
            }
            if (this.isOwnerHoldAttack === 0 && this.isHoldAttack !== null && this.animAttackTime <= 0 && window.isAutoAttackActive === 0 || this.forceStopAttack) {
              this.isHoldAttack = null;
              this.isFollowOwner = true;
              this.attackPosition = null;
              this.stopAttackAnimation(this.forceStopAttack);
              this.forceStopAttack = false;
            }
            this.checkCollisions();
            this.updatePhysics();
            this.updateMessage();
            this.render();
          }
          reset() {
            this.stopAttackAnimation();
            this.isOnwerAlreadyInTrap = false;
            this.isOwnerInTrap = false;
            this.messages = new Map();
          }
        }
        const pets = window.pets = new Map();
        for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
          pets.set(i, new Pet(i));
        }
        class SoundManager {
          constructor() {
            const audioPath = "https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1117260744426262648";
            this.soundsList = {
              weaponAttack: `${audioPath}/1134284384690778182/fb5b527adcfa08b_mp3cut.net.mp3`,
              gatherFood: `${audioPath}/1134285470877098106/54232664b00c9ae_mp3cut.net.mp3`,
              gatherTree: `${audioPath}/1134282882974744686/impact-plywood-hit-by-hatchet-02.mp3`,
              gatherStone: `${audioPath}/1134285698179010600/d7ef2cf1c7b9c5d_mp3cut.net.mp3`,
              gotDamage: `${audioPath}/1134298366721937478/6bf7bd9dfca4efe.mp3`
            };
            this.sounds = new Map();
          }
          play(key, volume) {
            const soundURL = this.soundsList[key];
            const id = parseInt(Date.now() * Math.random());
            this.sounds.set(id, new Audio(soundURL));
            const sound = this.sounds.get(id);
            sound.onended = () => {
              this.sounds.delete(id);
            };
            sound.volume = volume;
            sound.play();
          }
        }
        const soundManager = new SoundManager();
        class BackgroundPlayer extends Point {
          constructor() {
            const mapMiddle = config.mapScale / 2;
            super(mapMiddle, mapMiddle, 35);
            const weapons = window.weaponsConfig.filter(weapon => !weapon.projectile && weapon.gather);
            this.weapon = weapons[window.randInt(0, weapons.length - 1)];
            this.dir = 0;
            this.dirPlus = 0;
            this.isSmoothRotate = false;
            this.smoothTargetDir = 0;
            this.smoothRotateRatio = 0;
            this.smoothRotateTime = null;
            this.active = false;
            this.skinColor = config.skinColors[window.randInt(0, config.skinColors.length - 1)];
            this.doAttacks = true;
            this.isAttack = false;
            this.animAttackTime = 0;
            this.animAttackIndex = 0;
            this.animAttackRatio = 0;
            this.targetAngle = 0;
            this.wood = 0;
            this.stone = 0;
            this.woodLimit = window.randInt(13, 27) * (1 + this.weapon.gather / 2);
            this.stoneLimit = window.randInt(13, 27) * (1 + this.weapon.gather / 2);
            this.targetObject = null;
            this.speed = 0.43;
            this.windmillPlaced = false;
            this.spikePlaced = false;
          }
          start() {
            this.active = true;
          }
          stop() {
            this.active = false;
          }
          startAttackAnimation() {
            if (this.isAttack) {
              return;
            }
            this.isAttack = true;
            this.startAttackTime = Date.now();
            this.lastDir = this.dir;
            this.dirPlus = 0;
            this.animAttackTime = 0;
            this.animAttackRatio = 0;
            this.animAttackIndex = 0;
            this.animAttackTime = this.animSpeed = this.weapon.speed * 1.8;
            this.targetAngle = -config.hitAngle;
          }
          stopAttackAnimation() {
            this.isAttack = false;
            this.startAttackTime = null;
            this.dirPlus = 0;
            this.dir = this.dir;
            this.animAttackTime = 0;
            this.animAttackRatio = 0;
            this.animAttackIndex = 0;
          }
          attackAnimation(delta) {
            if (this.animAttackTime > 0) {
              this.animAttackTime -= delta;
              if (this.animAttackTime <= 0) {
                this.animAttackTime = 0;
                this.dirPlus = 0;
                this.animAttackRatio = 0;
                this.animAttackIndex = 0;
                this.stopAttackAnimation();
              } else if (this.animAttackIndex == 0) {
                this.animAttackRatio += delta / (this.animSpeed * config.hitReturnRatio);
                this.dirPlus = lerp(0, this.targetAngle, Math.min(1, this.animAttackRatio));
                if (this.animAttackRatio >= 1) {
                  this.animAttackRatio = 1;
                  this.animAttackIndex = 1;
                  if (this.checkHitCollision()) {
                    this.doHit();
                  }
                }
              } else {
                this.animAttackRatio -= delta / (this.animSpeed * (1 - config.hitReturnRatio));
                this.dirPlus = lerp(0, this.targetAngle, Math.max(0, this.animAttackRatio));
              }
            }
          }
          doHit() {
            if (this.targetObject.isPlace) {
              switch (this.targetObject.type) {
                case 11:
                  {
                    this.isSmoothRotate = false;
                    this.watchToTargetObject();
                    objectManager.add(this.targetObject.sid, this.targetObject.x, this.targetObject.y, 0, items.list[4].scale, items.list[4].id, items.list[10]);
                    this.doAttacks = false;
                    this.targetObject = null;
                    if (!this.spikePlaced) {
                      const spikeConfig = items.list[6];
                      this.targetObject = {
                        sid: 999212123,
                        x: this.x,
                        y: this.y + 75,
                        scale: spikeConfig.scale,
                        type: 12,
                        isPlace: true
                      };
                      this.doAttacks = true;
                      this.spikePlaced = true;
                    }
                  }
                  break;
                case 12:
                  {
                    this.isSmoothRotate = false;
                    this.watchToTargetObject();
                    objectManager.add(this.targetObject.sid, this.targetObject.x, this.targetObject.y, 0, items.list[4].scale, items.list[4].id, items.list[6]);
                    this.doAttacks = false;
                    this.skipePlaced = true;
                    this.targetObject = null;
                    if (!this.windmillPlaced) {
                      const windmillConfig = items.list[10];
                      this.targetObject = {
                        sid: 999212124,
                        x: this.x - 100,
                        y: this.y - 50,
                        scale: windmillConfig.scale,
                        type: 11,
                        isPlace: true
                      };
                      this.doAttacks = true;
                      this.windmillPlaced = true;
                    }
                  }
                  break;
              }
              return;
            }
            wiggleGameObject(this.dir, this.targetObject.sid);
            if (this.targetObject.type === 2) {
              this.stone += this.weapon.gather;
            } else if (this.targetObject.type === 0) {
              this.wood += this.weapon.gather;
            }
          }
          checkHitCollision() {
            for (const gameObject of gameObjects) {
              const angle = Math.atan2(gameObject.y - this.y, gameObject.x - this.x);
              const distance = Math.hypot(gameObject.y - this.y, gameObject.x - this.x) - (gameObject.scale || gameObject.getScale()) + config.collisionDepth;
              if (distance > this.weapon.range || getAngleDist(angle, this.dir) > gatherAngle) {
                continue;
              }
              return true;
            }
            return false;
          }
          updateCollisions() {
            const gameObjects1 = [...gameObjects];
            for (let i = 0; i < gameObjects1.length; i++) {
              const gameObject = gameObjects1[i];
              if (gameObject.ignoreCollision || !gameObject.active || gameObject.isDestroying) {
                continue;
              }
              const dx = this.x - gameObject.x;
              const dy = this.y - gameObject.y;
              const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
              const distance = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
              let tmpLen = this.scale + gameObject.scale;
              if (Math.abs(dx) <= tmpLen || Math.abs(dy) <= tmpLen) {
                tmpLen = this.scale + (gameObject.getScale ? gameObject.getScale() : gameObject.scale);
                let tmpInt = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) - tmpLen;
                if (tmpInt <= 0) {
                  tmpInt = tmpInt * -1.5 / 2;
                  this.position.add(tmpInt * Math.cos(angle), tmpInt * Math.sin(angle));
                }
              }
            }
          }
          startPlacing() {
            if (this.targetObject?.type !== 10) {
              return;
            }
            const windmillConfig = items.list[10];
            const mapMiddle = config.mapScale / 2;
            this.targetObject = {
              sid: 999212128,
              x: this.x + 50,
              y: this.y - 75,
              scale: windmillConfig.scale,
              type: 11,
              isPlace: true
            };
            this.doAttacks = true;
          }
          updateTargetObject() {
            if (this.targetObject?.type === 0 && this.wood > this.woodLimit) {
              const mapMiddle = config.mapScale / 2;
              this.targetObject = {
                sid: 24,
                x: mapMiddle - 700,
                y: mapMiddle + 200,
                scale: 20,
                type: 10,
                isPlace: false
              };
              this.doAttacks = false;
            } else if (this.targetObject?.type === 2 && this.stone > this.stoneLimit) {
              this.doSmoothRotate();
              this.targetObject = null;
            }
            if (!this.targetObject && !this.targetObject?.isPlace && this.doAttacks) {
              if (this.stone < this.stoneLimit) {
                const objects = gameObjects.filter(object => object.type === 2);
                this.targetObject = objects[window.randInt(0, objects.length - 1)];
              } else {
                const objects = gameObjects.filter(object => object.type === 0);
                this.targetObject = objects[window.randInt(0, objects.length - 1)];
              }
            }
          }
          doSmoothRotate() {
            this.isSmoothRotate = true;
            this.smoothRotateTime = 800;
            this.smoothRotateRatio = 0;
          }
          watchToTargetObject(delta) {
            if (!this.isSmoothRotate) {
              this.smoothRotateRatio = 0;
              this.smoothTargetDir = 0;
              this.dir = this.angleTo(new Vector(this.targetObject.x, this.targetObject.y));
            } else {
              this.smoothRotateTime -= delta;
              this.smoothTargetDir = this.angleTo(new Vector(this.targetObject.x, this.targetObject.y));
              this.smoothRotateRatio += delta / (this.smoothRotateTime * config.hitReturnRatio);
              if (this.dir - this.smoothTargetDir < 0.3) {
                this.isSmoothRotate = false;
                return;
              }
              this.dir = lerp(0, this.smoothTargetDir, Math.min(1, this.smoothRotateRatio));
            }
          }
          goToTargetObject(delta) {
            if (!this.targetObject) {
              return;
            }
            const scale = this.targetObject.getScale ? this.targetObject.getScale() : this.targetObject.scale;
            const angle = this.angleTo(new Vector(this.targetObject.x, this.targetObject.y));
            const distance = this.distanceTo(new Vector(this.targetObject.x, this.targetObject.y)) - scale - config.collisionDepth * 2 - this.scale / 2.25;
            if (distance <= this.scale) {
              if (this.doAttacks) {
                this.startAttackAnimation();
              }
              if (this.targetObject?.type === 10) {
                this.startPlacing();
              }
            } else {
              const speed = this.speed * (this.weapon?.spdMult || 1);
              this.velocity.add(speed * Math.cos(angle), speed * Math.sin(angle));
              this.watchToTargetObject(delta);
            }
          }
          render(xOffset, yOffset) {
            const handAngle = Math.PI / 4 * (this.weapon.armS || 1);
            const handScale = this.scale / 2;
            const oHandAngle = this.weapon.hndS || 1;
            const oHandDist = this.weapon.hndD || 1;
            const lineWidth = 5.5;
            mainContext.save();
            mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
            mainContext.fillStyle = this.skinColor;
            mainContext.strokeStyle = "#525252";
            mainContext.lineWidth = lineWidth;
            mainContext.lineJoin = "miter";
            mainContext.translate(this.x - xOffset, this.y - yOffset);
            mainContext.rotate(this.dir + (this.isAttack ? this.dirPlus : 0));
            renderTool(this.weapon, config.weaponVariants[0].src, this.scale, 0, mainContext);
            renderCircle1(this.scale * Math.cos(handAngle), this.scale * Math.sin(handAngle), handScale);
            mainContext.fill();
            mainContext.stroke();
            renderCircle1(this.scale * oHandDist * Math.cos(-handAngle * oHandAngle), this.scale * oHandDist * Math.sin(-handAngle * oHandAngle), handScale);
            mainContext.fill();
            mainContext.stroke();
            renderCircle1(0, 0, this.scale, mainContext);
            mainContext.fill();
            mainContext.stroke();
            mainContext.restore();
          }
          update(xOffset, yOffset, delta) {
            if (!this.active) {
              return;
            }
            this.updateTargetObject();
            this.goToTargetObject(delta);
            if (this.isAttack) {
              this.attackAnimation(delta);
            }
            this.updateCollisions();
            this.updatePhysics();
            this.render(xOffset, yOffset);
          }
        }
        const backgroundPlayer = new BackgroundPlayer();
        function renderCircle1(x, y, scale, tmpContext) {
          tmpContext = tmpContext || mainContext;
          tmpContext.beginPath();
          tmpContext.arc(x, y, scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          tmpContext.closePath();
        }
        function hexToRGB(hex, alpha) {
          const r = parseInt(hex.slice(1, 3), 16);
          const g = parseInt(hex.slice(3, 5), 16);
          const b = parseInt(hex.slice(5, 7), 16);
          return `rgb${alpha ? "a" : ""}(${r}, ${g}, ${b}${alpha ? `, ${alpha}` : ""})`;
        }
        function lerp(value1, value2, amount) {
          return value1 + (value2 - value1) * amount;
        } // UPDATE & ANIMATE:
        window.requestAnimFrame = function () {
          return window.requestAnimationFrame || window.webkitRequestAnimationFrame || window.mozRequestAnimationFrame || function (callback) {
            window.setTimeout(callback, 1000 / 60);
          };
        }();
        function doUpdate() {
          window.fps += (1000 / Math.max(Date.now() - lastUpdate, 1) - window.fps) / 10;
          now = Date.now();
          delta = now - lastUpdate;
          lastUpdate = now;
          window.delta = delta;
          updateGame();
          window.requestAnimFrame(doUpdate);
        } // START GAME:
        function startGame() {
          bindEvents();
          loadIcons();
          loadingText.style.display = "none";
          menuCardHolder.style.display = "block";
          nameInput.value = getSavedVal("moo_name") || "";
          prepareUI();
        }
        prepareMenuBackground();
        doUpdate(); // OPEN LINK:
        var openLink = window.openLink;
        /***/
      },
      /***/"./src/js/data/ai.js":
      /*!***************************!*\
              !*** ./src/js/data/ai.js ***!
              \***************************/
      /*! no static exports found */
      /***/
      function (module, exports) {
        var PI2 = Math.PI * 2;
        module.exports = function (sid, objectManager, players, items, UTILS, config, scoreCallback, server) {
          this.sid = sid;
          this.isAI = true;
          this.nameIndex = UTILS.randInt(0, config.cowNames.length - 1); // INIT:
          this.init = function (x, y, dir, index, data) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.startX = data.fixedSpawn ? x : null;
            this.startY = data.fixedSpawn ? y : null;
            this.xVel = 0;
            this.yVel = 0;
            this.zIndex = 0;
            this.dir = dir;
            this.dirPlus = 0;
            this.index = index;
            this.src = data.src;
            if (data.name) {
              this.name = data.name;
            }
            this.weightM = data.weightM;
            this.speed = data.speed;
            this.killScore = data.killScore;
            this.turnSpeed = data.turnSpeed;
            this.scale = data.scale;
            this.maxHealth = data.health;
            this.leapForce = data.leapForce;
            this.health = this.maxHealth;
            this.chargePlayer = data.chargePlayer;
            this.viewRange = data.viewRange;
            this.drop = data.drop;
            this.dmg = data.dmg;
            this.hostile = data.hostile;
            this.dontRun = data.dontRun;
            this.hitRange = data.hitRange;
            this.hitDelay = data.hitDelay;
            this.hitScare = data.hitScare;
            this.spriteMlt = data.spriteMlt;
            this.nameScale = data.nameScale;
            this.colDmg = data.colDmg;
            this.noTrap = data.noTrap;
            this.spawnDelay = data.spawnDelay;
            this.hitWait = 0;
            this.waitCount = 1000;
            this.moveCount = 0;
            this.targetDir = 0;
            this.active = true;
            this.alive = true;
            this.runFrom = null;
            this.chargeTarget = null;
            this.dmgOverTime = {};
          }; // UPDATE:
          var timerCount = 0;
          this.update = function (delta) {
            if (this.active) {
              // SPAWN DELAY:
              if (this.spawnCounter) {
                this.spawnCounter -= delta;
                if (this.spawnCounter <= 0) {
                  this.spawnCounter = 0;
                  this.x = this.startX || UTILS.randInt(0, config.mapScale);
                  this.y = this.startY || UTILS.randInt(0, config.mapScale);
                }
                return;
              } // REGENS AND AUTO:
              timerCount -= delta;
              if (timerCount <= 0) {
                if (this.dmgOverTime.dmg) {
                  this.changeHealth(-this.dmgOverTime.dmg, this.dmgOverTime.doer);
                  this.dmgOverTime.time -= 1;
                  if (this.dmgOverTime.time <= 0) {
                    this.dmgOverTime.dmg = 0;
                  }
                }
                timerCount = 1000;
              } // BEHAVIOUR:
              var charging = false;
              var slowMlt = 1;
              if (!this.zIndex && !this.lockMove && this.y >= config.mapScale / 2 - config.riverWidth / 2 && this.y <= config.mapScale / 2 + config.riverWidth / 2) {
                slowMlt = 0.33;
                this.xVel += config.waterCurrent * delta;
              }
              if (this.lockMove) {
                this.xVel = 0;
                this.yVel = 0;
              } else if (this.waitCount > 0) {
                this.waitCount -= delta;
                if (this.waitCount <= 0) {
                  if (this.chargePlayer) {
                    var tmpPlayer;
                    var bestDst;
                    var tmpDist;
                    for (var i = 0; i < players.length; ++i) {
                      if (players[i].alive && (!players[i].skin || !players[i].skin.bullRepel)) {
                        tmpDist = UTILS.getDistance(this.x, this.y, players[i].x, players[i].y);
                        if (tmpDist <= this.viewRange && (!tmpPlayer || tmpDist < bestDst)) {
                          bestDst = tmpDist;
                          tmpPlayer = players[i];
                        }
                      }
                    }
                    if (tmpPlayer) {
                      this.chargeTarget = tmpPlayer;
                      this.moveCount = UTILS.randInt(8000, 12000);
                    } else {
                      this.moveCount = UTILS.randInt(1000, 2000);
                      this.targetDir = UTILS.randFloat(-Math.PI, Math.PI);
                    }
                  } else {
                    this.moveCount = UTILS.randInt(4000, 10000);
                    this.targetDir = UTILS.randFloat(-Math.PI, Math.PI);
                  }
                }
              } else if (this.moveCount > 0) {
                var tmpSpd = this.speed * slowMlt;
                if (this.runFrom && this.runFrom.active && (!this.runFrom.isPlayer || !!this.runFrom.alive)) {
                  this.targetDir = UTILS.getDirection(this.x, this.y, this.runFrom.x, this.runFrom.y);
                  tmpSpd *= 1.42;
                } else if (this.chargeTarget && this.chargeTarget.alive) {
                  this.targetDir = UTILS.getDirection(this.chargeTarget.x, this.chargeTarget.y, this.x, this.y);
                  tmpSpd *= 1.75;
                  charging = true;
                }
                if (this.hitWait) {
                  tmpSpd *= 0.3;
                }
                if (this.dir != this.targetDir) {
                  this.dir %= PI2;
                  var netAngle = (this.dir - this.targetDir + PI2) % PI2;
                  var amnt = Math.min(Math.abs(netAngle - PI2), netAngle, this.turnSpeed * delta);
                  var sign = netAngle - Math.PI >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
                  this.dir += sign * amnt + PI2;
                }
                this.dir %= PI2;
                this.xVel += tmpSpd * delta * Math.cos(this.dir);
                this.yVel += tmpSpd * delta * Math.sin(this.dir);
                this.moveCount -= delta;
                if (this.moveCount <= 0) {
                  this.runFrom = null;
                  this.chargeTarget = null;
                  this.waitCount = this.hostile ? 1500 : UTILS.randInt(1500, 6000);
                }
              } // OBJECT COLL:
              this.zIndex = 0;
              this.lockMove = false;
              var tmpList;
              var tmpSpeed = UTILS.getDistance(0, 0, this.xVel * delta, this.yVel * delta);
              var depth = Math.min(4, Math.max(1, Math.round(tmpSpeed / 40)));
              var tMlt = 1 / depth;
              for (var i = 0; i < depth; ++i) {
                if (this.xVel) {
                  this.x += this.xVel * delta * tMlt;
                }
                if (this.yVel) {
                  this.y += this.yVel * delta * tMlt;
                }
                tmpList = objectManager.getGridArrays(this.x, this.y, this.scale);
                for (var x = 0; x < tmpList.length; ++x) {
                  for (var y = 0; y < tmpList[x].length; ++y) {
                    if (tmpList[x][y].active) {
                      objectManager.checkCollision(this, tmpList[x][y], tMlt);
                    }
                  }
                }
              } // HITTING:
              var hitting = false;
              if (this.hitWait > 0) {
                this.hitWait -= delta;
                if (this.hitWait <= 0) {
                  hitting = true;
                  this.hitWait = 0;
                  if (this.leapForce && !UTILS.randInt(0, 2)) {
                    this.xVel += this.leapForce * Math.cos(this.dir);
                    this.yVel += this.leapForce * Math.sin(this.dir);
                  }
                  var tmpList = objectManager.getGridArrays(this.x, this.y, this.hitRange);
                  var tmpObj;
                  var tmpDst;
                  for (var t = 0; t < tmpList.length; ++t) {
                    for (var x = 0; x < tmpList[t].length; ++x) {
                      tmpObj = tmpList[t][x];
                      if (tmpObj.health) {
                        tmpDst = UTILS.getDistance(this.x, this.y, tmpObj.x, tmpObj.y);
                        if (tmpDst < tmpObj.scale + this.hitRange) {
                          if (tmpObj.changeHealth(-this.dmg * 5)) {
                            objectManager.disableObj(tmpObj);
                          }
                          objectManager.hitObj(tmpObj, UTILS.getDirection(this.x, this.y, tmpObj.x, tmpObj.y));
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  }
                  for (var x = 0; x < players.length; ++x) {
                    if (players[x].canSee(this)) {
                      server.send(players[x].id, "aa", this.sid);
                    }
                  }
                }
              } // PLAYER COLLISIONS:
              if (charging || hitting) {
                var tmpObj;
                var tmpDst;
                var tmpDir;
                for (var i = 0; i < players.length; ++i) {
                  tmpObj = players[i];
                  if (tmpObj && tmpObj.alive) {
                    tmpDst = UTILS.getDistance(this.x, this.y, tmpObj.x, tmpObj.y);
                    if (this.hitRange) {
                      if (!this.hitWait && tmpDst <= this.hitRange + tmpObj.scale) {
                        if (hitting) {
                          tmpDir = UTILS.getDirection(tmpObj.x, tmpObj.y, this.x, this.y);
                          tmpObj.changeHealth(-this.dmg);
                          tmpObj.xVel += Math.cos(tmpDir) * 0.6;
                          tmpObj.yVel += Math.sin(tmpDir) * 0.6;
                          this.runFrom = null;
                          this.chargeTarget = null;
                          this.waitCount = 3000;
                          this.hitWait = !UTILS.randInt(0, 2) ? 600 : 0;
                        } else {
                          this.hitWait = this.hitDelay;
                        }
                      }
                    } else if (tmpDst <= this.scale + tmpObj.scale) {
                      tmpDir = UTILS.getDirection(tmpObj.x, tmpObj.y, this.x, this.y);
                      tmpObj.changeHealth(-this.dmg);
                      tmpObj.xVel += Math.cos(tmpDir) * 0.55;
                      tmpObj.yVel += Math.sin(tmpDir) * 0.55;
                    }
                  }
                }
              } // DECEL:
              if (this.xVel) {
                this.xVel *= Math.pow(config.playerDecel, delta);
              }
              if (this.yVel) {
                this.yVel *= Math.pow(config.playerDecel, delta);
              } // MAP BOUNDARIES:
              var tmpScale = this.scale;
              if (this.x - tmpScale < 0) {
                this.x = tmpScale;
                this.xVel = 0;
              } else if (this.x + tmpScale > config.mapScale) {
                this.x = config.mapScale - tmpScale;
                this.xVel = 0;
              }
              if (this.y - tmpScale < 0) {
                this.y = tmpScale;
                this.yVel = 0;
              } else if (this.y + tmpScale > config.mapScale) {
                this.y = config.mapScale - tmpScale;
                this.yVel = 0;
              }
            }
          }; // CAN SEE:
          this.canSee = function (other) {
            if (!other) {
              return false;
            }
            if (other.skin && other.skin.invisTimer && other.noMovTimer >= other.skin.invisTimer) {
              return false;
            }
            var dx = Math.abs(other.x - this.x) - other.scale;
            var dy = Math.abs(other.y - this.y) - other.scale;
            return dx <= config.maxScreenWidth / 2 * 1.3 && dy <= config.maxScreenHeight / 2 * 1.3;
          };
          var tmpRatio = 0;
          var animIndex = 0;
          this.animate = function (delta) {
            if (this.animTime > 0) {
              this.animTime -= delta;
              if (this.animTime <= 0) {
                this.animTime = 0;
                this.dirPlus = 0;
                tmpRatio = 0;
                animIndex = 0;
              } else if (animIndex == 0) {
                tmpRatio += delta / (this.animSpeed * config.hitReturnRatio);
                this.dirPlus = UTILS.lerp(0, this.targetAngle, Math.min(1, tmpRatio));
                if (tmpRatio >= 1) {
                  tmpRatio = 1;
                  animIndex = 1;
                }
              } else {
                tmpRatio -= delta / (this.animSpeed * (1 - config.hitReturnRatio));
                this.dirPlus = UTILS.lerp(0, this.targetAngle, Math.max(0, tmpRatio));
              }
            }
          }; // ANIMATION:
          this.startAnim = function () {
            const animTimesSum = this.startAnimTimes.reduce((acc, num) => acc + num, 0);
            const avarageReloadMax = this.startAnimTimes.length ? animTimesSum / this.startAnimTimes.length : this.hitDelay;
            this.reloadWeaponMax = Math.max(avarageReloadMax / 2, this.hitDelay);
            this.reloadWeaponCount = Date.now();
            this.animTime = this.animSpeed = 600;
            this.targetAngle = Math.PI * 0.8;
            tmpRatio = 0;
            animIndex = 0;
          }; // CHANGE HEALTH:
          this.changeHealth = function (val, doer, runFrom) {
            if (this.active) {
              this.health += val;
              if (runFrom) {
                if (this.hitScare && !UTILS.randInt(0, this.hitScare)) {
                  this.runFrom = runFrom;
                  this.waitCount = 0;
                  this.moveCount = 2000;
                } else if (this.hostile && this.chargePlayer && runFrom.isPlayer) {
                  this.chargeTarget = runFrom;
                  this.waitCount = 0;
                  this.moveCount = 8000;
                } else if (!this.dontRun) {
                  this.runFrom = runFrom;
                  this.waitCount = 0;
                  this.moveCount = 2000;
                }
              }
              if (val < 0 && this.hitRange && UTILS.randInt(0, 1)) {
                this.hitWait = 500;
              }
              if (doer && doer.canSee(this) && val < 0) {
                server.send(doer.id, "t", Math.round(this.x), Math.round(this.y), Math.round(-val), 1);
              }
              if (this.health <= 0) {
                if (this.spawnDelay) {
                  this.spawnCounter = this.spawnDelay;
                  this.x = -1000000;
                  this.y = -1000000;
                } else {
                  this.x = this.startX || UTILS.randInt(0, config.mapScale);
                  this.y = this.startY || UTILS.randInt(0, config.mapScale);
                }
                this.health = this.maxHealth;
                this.runFrom = null;
                if (doer) {
                  scoreCallback(doer, this.killScore);
                  if (this.drop) {
                    for (var i = 0; i < this.drop.length;) {
                      doer.addResource(config.resourceTypes.indexOf(this.drop[i]), this.drop[i + 1]);
                      i += 2;
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          };
        };
        /***/

      /*!***********************************!*\
              !*** ./src/js/data/gameObject.js ***!
              \***********************************/
      /*! no static exports found */
      /***/
      function (module, exports) {
        module.exports = function (sid) {
          this.sid = sid; // INIT:
          this.init = function (x, y, dir, scale, type, data, owner) {
            data = data || {};
            this.sentTo = {};
            this.gridLocations = [];
            this.active = true;
            this.doUpdate = data.doUpdate;
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.dir = dir;
            this.xWiggle = 0;
            this.yWiggle = 0;
            this.scale = scale;
            this.type = type;
            this.id = data.id;
            this.owner = owner;
            this.name = data.name;
            this.isItem = this.id != undefined;
            this.group = data.group;
            this.health = this.maxHealth = data.health;
            this.layer = 2;
            if (this.group != undefined) {
              this.layer = this.group.layer;
            } else if (this.type == 0) {
              this.layer = 3;
            } else if (this.type == 2) {
              this.layer = 0;
            } else if (this.type == 4) {
              this.layer = -1;
            }
            this.colDiv = data.colDiv || 1;
            this.blocker = data.blocker;
            this.ignoreCollision = data.ignoreCollision;
            this.dontGather = data.dontGather;
            this.hideFromEnemy = data.hideFromEnemy;
            this.friction = data.friction;
            this.projDmg = data.projDmg;
            this.dmg = data.dmg;
            this.pDmg = data.pDmg;
            this.pps = data.pps;
            this.zIndex = data.zIndex || 0;
            this.turnSpeed = data.turnSpeed;
            this.req = data.req;
            this.trap = data.trap;
            this.healCol = data.healCol;
            this.teleport = data.teleport;
            this.boostSpeed = data.boostSpeed;
            this.projectile = data.projectile;
            this.shootRange = data.shootRange;
            this.shootRate = data.shootRate;
            this.shootCount = this.shootRate;
            this.spawnPoint = data.spawnPoint;
            this.destroyTime = null;
            this.destroyDelay = 500;
            this.isDestroying = false;
            this.updateItemCount();
          };
          this.updateItemCount = function (isRemove) {
            if (!this.owner) {
              return;
            }
            if (this.owner.sid !== window.ownPlayer?.sid) {
              return;
            }
            const itemCount = document.getElementById(`itemCount_${this.id}`);
            const itemsCount = window.ownPlayer.itemCounts;
            const limit = window.inSandbox ? Math.max(this.group.limit * 3, 99) : this.group.limit;
            if (isRemove) {
              window.pets.forEach(pet => {
                pet.addMessage(`Hey ${window.ownPlayer.name}! ${this.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + this.name.slice(1)} was destroyed 💥`, "rgba(133, 15, 15, 0.5)", 4000);
              });
            }
            itemCount.innerText = `${itemsCount[this.group.id] + (isRemove ? -1 : 0)}/${limit}`;
          };
          this.startDestroyAnimation = function (objectManager, sid) {
            this.destroyTime = Date.now();
            this.isDestroying = true;
            this.health = 0;
            this.destroy = function () {
              objectManager.disableBySid(this.sid);
            };
          };
          this.getDestroyAlpha = function () {
            if (!this.isDestroying) {
              return 0;
            }
            const destroyTimer = Date.now() - this.destroyTime;
            if (destroyTimer >= this.destroyDelay) {
              return 1;
            }
            return destroyTimer / this.destroyDelay;
          }; // GET HIT:
          this.changeHealth = function (amount, doer) {
            this.health += amount;
            return this.health <= 0;
          }; // GET SCALE:
          this.getScale = function (sM, ig) {
            sM = sM || 1;
            return this.scale * (this.isItem || this.type == 2 || this.type == 3 || this.type == 4 ? 1 : sM * 0.6) * (ig ? 1 : this.colDiv);
          }; // VISIBLE TO PLAYER:
          this.visibleToPlayer = function (player) {
            return !this.hideFromEnemy || this.owner && (this.owner == player || this.owner.team && player.team == this.owner.team);
          }; // UPDATE:
          this.update = function (e) {
            if (this.active && this.xWiggle) {
              this.xWiggle *= Math.pow(0.99, e);
            }
            if (this.yWiggle) {
              this.yWiggle *= Math.pow(0.99, e);
            }
            if (!window.menu.getModelActive("disable-buildings-turn")) {
              if (this.turnSpeed) {
                this.dir += this.turnSpeed * e;
              }
            }
            if (this.isDestroying) {
              if (Date.now() - this.destroyTime >= this.destroyDelay) {
                this.destroy();
              }
            }
          };
        };
        /***/
      },

              [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
